articles.title_en: Interfacial structure, evolution and magnetic properties of NiO/Cr<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf>O<ce:inf loc=post>3</ce:inf> heterostructures
articles.title_cn: NiO/Cr<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf>O<ce:inf loc=post>3</ce:inf>异质结构的界面结构、演化和磁性能
articles.abstract_en: Interfacial structure and its evolution play an important role in determining the functional properties of advanced materials and devices. However, real oxide heterointerfaces are typically far more complex than idealized abrupt boundaries; thus clarifying how interfacial structures evolve and how such evolution affects physical properties is essential. In this work, NiO/Cr2O3 heterostructures were epitaxially grown on single-crystalline SrTiO3 substrates by pulsed laser deposition under different deposition temperatures and subsequent post-annealing treatment, both of which strongly influence the thermally driven interfacial evolution. Interfacial structures were comprehensively characterized by high-resolution X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy equipped with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy. The evolution is revealed as a transition from an ultrathin interfacial transition zone in the as-deposited NiO/Cr2O3 heterostructure to the formation of a NiCr2O4 reaction interlayer, and finally to a NiO/NiCr2O4 bilayer after high-temperature annealing. Magnetic hysteresis loops measured by a superconducting quantum interference device reveal that all heterostructures exhibit weak ferrimagnetism, accompanied by a non-monotonic change in saturation magnetization with interfacial structural changes. These findings demonstrate that thermally controlled interfacial reactions and structural evolution can generate distinct magnetic characteristics, thereby providing a practical strategy for material interfaces design and performance engineering in functional oxides.
articles.abstract_cn: 界面结构及其演化在决定先进材料和器件的功能特性方面发挥着重要作用。然而，真实的氧化物异质界面通常比理想化的突变边界复杂得多。因此，澄清界面结构如何演变以及这种演变如何影响物理性质至关重要。在这项工作中，通过不同沉积温度下的脉冲激光沉积和随后的退火后处理，在单晶SrTiO3衬底上外延生长NiO/Cr2O3异质结构，这两者都强烈影响热驱动的界面演化。通过高分辨率 X 射线衍射和配备能量色散 X 射线光谱的透射电子显微镜对界面结构进行了全面表征。该演化过程被揭示为从沉积态 NiO/Cr2O3 异质结构中的超薄界面过渡区到 NiCr2O4 反应中间层的形成，最后在高温退火后形成 NiO/NiCr2O4 双层的转变。通过超导量子干涉装置测量的磁滞回线表明，所有异质结构都表现出弱亚铁磁性，并伴随着饱和磁化强度随界面结构变化的非单调变化。这些发现表明，热控制界面反应和结构演化可以产生独特的磁特性，从而为功能氧化物的材料界面设计和性能工程提供实用策略。

articles.title_en: Unveiling the hidden diversity of <ce:italic>Croisettea</ce:italic> (Kallymeniaceae, Rhodophyta): Two new species, <ce:italic>C. lobata</ce:italic> and <ce:italic>C. rotundata</ce:italic> from the northwestern Pacific
articles.title_cn: 揭示Croisettea（胭脂藻科，红藻门）的隐藏多样性：来自西北太平洋的两个新种，C. lobata 和 C. rotundata
articles.abstract_en: The genus Croisettea (Kallymeniaceae) has undergone recent taxonomic revision based on molecular evidence, yet its diversity and distribution remain incompletely understood. In this study, we report the first occurrence of Croisettea from Korean waters and describe two new species, C. lobata sp. nov. and C. rotundata sp. nov., based on detailed morphological observations and molecular analyses of concatenated rbcL and COI-5P sequences. Phylogenetic analyses revealed the two species as distinct and well-supported lineages within the genus. Croisettea lobata is characterized by deeply lobed flabellate blades, whereas C. rotundata possesses orbicular to reniform blades. Both species are further distinguished from all currently recognized congeners by a combination of thallus thickness, blade morphology, and vegetative anatomical characters. The discovery of these two species revealed previously unrecognized diversity of Croisettea in Korean waters and highlights the value of integrative taxonomy for resolving species diversity within morphologically simple red algae. Continued subtidal surveys and molecular investigations will be important for improving our understanding of the diversity and distribution of the genus.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于分子证据，Croisettea属（胭脂藻科）近期经历了分类学修订，但其多样性和分布仍未被完全了解。在本研究中，我们首次报道了Croisettea在韩国水域的出现，并基于详细的形态学观察和rbcL与COI-5P序列的联合分子分析，描述了C. lobata sp. nov. 和 C. rotundata sp. nov. 两个新种。系统发育分析显示这两个种在属内形成独特且得到充分支持的分支。Croisettea lobata的特征是深裂的扇形叶片，而C. rotundata具有圆形至肾形叶片。这两个种通过叶状体厚度、叶片形态和营养解剖特征的组合，与所有目前公认的同属物种进一步区分。这两个种的发现揭示了韩国水域中Croisettea先前未被认识的多样性，并强调了整合分类学在解决形态简单的红藻物种多样性中的价值。持续的潮下带调查和分子研究对于提高我们对属的多样性和分布的理解将非常重要。

articles.title_en: Junction- and graph-based realisation of geometrical and topological features of the grains and its neighbours in polycrystalline microstructures
articles.title_cn: 基于结点和图的多晶微结构中晶粒及其邻居的几何与拓扑特征实现
articles.abstract_en: Comprehensive analysis of polycrystalline microstructures, at times, demands information on the size and face-class of individual grains along with its neighbours. In experimental studies, this level of grain- and neighbourhood-resolved information is less routinely available when compared to average grain-size statistics owing to the intricate features of polycrystalline microstructures, which are characterised by closed grains, shared interfaces, and definite neighbour relations. In this work, a junction based algorithm is developed that estimates these critical geometrical and topological features of grains and their neighbours by converting the grain boundary network into a navigable graph. Within this framework, the polycrystalline microstructure is reconstructed as closed loops around individual grains, permitting quantitative estimation of grain size and face-class together with a direct realisation of these geometrical and topological properties of the neighbours. The performance of the algorithm is assessed against manual estimations of grain area obtained from careful boundary tracing, and a convincing agreement is observed, with deviations remaining small for the majority of grains. The topological output is additionally validated by comparing the algorithm-predicted number of sides with manually counted face class, and the full workflow is further demonstrated on an experimentally observed alumina microstructure. A central outcome is the complete digitisation of the available grain boundary network from experimental micrographs, in a form that closely parallels the detailed descriptions usually associated with computational investigations. This enables grain- and neighbourhood-resolved analysis of experimental polycrystalline microstructures, supporting a more comprehensive characterisation than largely size-based statistics.
articles.abstract_cn: 对多晶微结构的全面分析有时需要单个晶粒及其邻居的尺寸和面类信息。在实验研究中，由于多晶微结构的复杂特征（以封闭晶粒、共享界面和明确的邻居关系为特征），与平均晶粒尺寸统计相比，这种晶粒和邻居分辨的信息通常不太容易获得。在本工作中，开发了一种基于结点的算法，通过将晶界网络转换为可导航的图来估计晶粒及其邻居的这些关键几何和拓扑特征。在此框架内，多晶微结构被重建为围绕单个晶粒的闭合回路，允许定量估计晶粒尺寸和面类，并直接实现邻居的这些几何和拓扑属性。该算法的性能通过与从仔细边界追踪获得的人工晶粒面积估计进行比较来评估，观察到令人信服的一致性，大多数晶粒的偏差保持较小。拓扑输出还通过将算法预测的边数与人工计数的面类进行比较来验证，并且整个工作流程进一步在实验观察的氧化铝微结构上得到展示。一个核心成果是从实验显微图中完全数字化可用的晶界网络，其形式与通常与计算研究相关的详细描述紧密相似。这使得实验多晶微结构的晶粒和邻居分辨分析成为可能，支持比主要基于尺寸的统计更全面的表征。

articles.title_en: Reconstruction of undersampled scanning ion conductance microscopy images through zero-shot learning-based super-resolution
articles.title_cn: 基于零样本学习超分辨率的欠采样扫描离子电导显微镜图像重建
articles.abstract_en: Scanning ion conductance microscopy (SICM) has emerged as an important technique in the biomedical field due to its non-contact, nanoscale imaging capabilities, but the slow imaging speed limits its ability to capture dynamic biological processes. Undersampling combined with computational reconstruction presents a promising paradigm to accelerate imaging. However, existing compressed sensing (CS) and deep learning methods either yield suboptimal reconstruction quality or require abundant training data that are difficult to acquire for SICM. To address these challenges, we propose a zero-shot super-resolution (SR) framework that uses artificial neural networks to reconstruct high-fidelity images from undersampled SICM measurements. By exploiting internal image statistics, the method extracts training samples solely from the input itself to train an image-specific SR network, eliminating the reliance on external datasets. Comparative experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior reconstruction accuracy compared to bicubic interpolation, CS, and the baseline zero-shot SR (ZSSR) algorithms, while exhibiting robust performance across random initialization. Furthermore, it attains comparable reconstruction quality with significantly fewer sampling points than CS methods, thereby enabling faster SICM imaging. Reconstruction experiments under noisy conditions further demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in practical SICM applications. This work offers a practical strategy for high-speed SICM imaging and suggests a promising pathway for enhancing imaging speed in other data-scarce scanning probe microscopy techniques.
articles.abstract_cn: 扫描离子电导显微镜（SICM）因其非接触、纳米级成像能力，已成为生物医学领域的重要技术，但成像速度慢限制了其捕捉动态生物过程的能力。欠采样结合计算重建为加速成像提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，现有的压缩感知（CS）和深度学习方法要么重建质量次优，要么需要大量难以获取的训练数据。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种零样本超分辨率（SR）框架，利用人工神经网络从欠采样的SICM测量中重建高保真图像。通过利用内部图像统计，该方法仅从输入本身提取训练样本，训练图像特定的SR网络，消除了对外部数据集的依赖。对比实验表明，与双三次插值、CS和基线零样本SR（ZSSR）算法相比，所提方法实现了更优的重建精度，并在随机初始化下表现出稳健性能。此外，与CS方法相比，它以显著更少的采样点达到了相当的重建质量，从而实现了更快的SICM成像。噪声条件下的重建实验进一步证明了所提方法在实际SICM应用中的有效性。这项工作为高速SICM成像提供了一种实用策略，并为其他数据稀缺的扫描探针显微镜技术提高成像速度提供了一条有前景的途径。

articles.title_en: Can policy design build trust in local taxation? Experimental evidence of property taxation in Mexican municipalities
articles.title_cn: 政策设计能否建立地方税收信任？墨西哥市政财产税的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Property taxes, the primary source of local revenue for municipal governments, are essential for improving urban service provision and resident welfare. Yet this tax is widely unpopular and often politically contentiuous. This study's descriptive findings reveal that property owners are not currently motivated to pay their property taxes by the promise of collective benefits, but rather by the desire to secure their property rights. Thus, this study asks: What dimensions of property tax design do property owners prioritize? How do they negotiate trade-offs? And can policy design establish credible commitment? I address these questions using an experimental conjoint survey with over 2,000 property owners in 34 urban municipalities in Mexico. I find that property owners are largely indifferent to the progressivity of property tax increases yet strongly prioritize policies that enhance accountability in how government administers, spends, and enforces taxes. Specifically, the presence of active oversight strategies in the use of funds increases the support for a policy by 11 percentage points, an effect greater than that of policies that offer more direct benefits. Individuals with high perceptions of government corruption disproportionately favor tax policies that incorporate active transparency strategies even if this implies a higher fiscal burden. Overall, this study demonstrates that public support for property taxation is not entirely inelastic and that adopting accountability measures that signal how funds are spent can make property owners more accepting of tax increases. This study contributes to literature on the fiscal contract by demonstrating how policy designs that enhance accountability can help establish credible commitment.
articles.abstract_cn: 财产税是市政府地方政府收入的主要来源，对于改善城市服务供给和居民福利至关重要。然而，这一税种普遍不受欢迎，且常常在政治上引发争议。本研究的描述性发现表明，业主目前并非因集体利益的承诺而缴纳财产税，而是出于保障其财产权的愿望。因此，本研究提出以下问题：业主优先考虑财产税设计的哪些维度？他们如何权衡取舍？政策设计能否建立可信承诺？我通过对墨西哥34个城市中超过2,000名业主进行的实验性联合调查来解决这些问题。我发现，业主对财产税增加的累进性基本不关心，但强烈优先考虑增强政府在税收管理、支出和执行方面问责性的政策。具体而言，资金使用中积极监督策略的存在使政策支持度提高11个百分点，这一效果大于提供更直接利益的政策。对政府腐败感知较高的个体不成比例地偏好包含积极透明策略的税收政策，即使这意味着更高的财政负担。总体而言，本研究证明，公众对财产税的支持并非完全无弹性，采取表明资金使用方式的问责措施可以使业主更接受税收增加。本研究通过展示增强问责性的政策设计如何帮助建立可信承诺，为财政契约文献做出贡献。

articles.title_en: Migration opportunities and human capital investments
articles.title_cn: 迁移机会与人力资本投资
articles.abstract_en: We examine how shocks to migration opportunities affect schooling outcomes in origin communities. We focus on the migration between Mexico and the United States, and exploit the expansion of the Secure Communities program in the US—a federal data-sharing program that substantially increased the risk of deportation for illegal migrants—as an exogenous shock to the attractiveness of illegal migration. Our results suggest that the Secure Communities program increased attendance, enrollment, and educational attainment in municipalities that had stronger migration-network links with counties in the US that adopted the program early-on relative to municipalities that had ties with US counties that introduced the policy somewhat later. These results are consistent with the interpretation that the Secure Communities program raised the returns to education for prospective migrants by making low-skill migration to the US less attractive.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了迁移机会的冲击如何影响原籍社区的教育成果。我们聚焦于墨西哥与美国之间的迁移，并利用美国“安全社区”计划的扩展——一项联邦数据共享计划，大幅增加了非法移民被驱逐出境的风险——作为非法迁移吸引力下降的外生冲击。我们的结果表明，“安全社区”计划提高了那些与美国早期采用该计划的县有更强迁移网络联系的市镇的出勤率、入学率和教育成就，相对于那些与美国较晚引入该政策的县有联系的市镇。这些结果与以下解释一致：“安全社区”计划通过降低低技能迁移到美国的吸引力，提高了潜在迁移者的教育回报。

articles.title_en: Softening of vero cells induced by measles vaccine virus
articles.title_cn: 麻疹疫苗病毒诱导的Vero细胞软化
articles.abstract_en: Although early biophysical changes in host cells may provide additional indicators of viral infection, the quantitative analysis of these changes is still in its early stages. In this study, we investigated the mechanical response of Vero cells following exposure to a Measles Vaccine Virus (MVV), employing atomic force microscopy (AFM) alongside confocal microscopy. We performed AFM force-distance and stress relaxation measurements in the perinuclear region to assess the elastic and viscoelastic properties of infected cells. Within 24 h post-infection (hpi), cells infected at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 0.5, exhibited a ∼35% reduction in median Young’s modulus compared to uninfected controls, indicating significant cellular softening. Variations in the viscoelastic parameters were also observed, including decreased relaxed modulus E0 and reduced viscosities η1 and η2, comparable to those measured in cells treated with the actin depolymerisation agent cytochalasin-D. Confocal microscopy showed a dose-dependent cytoskeletal reorganization characterized by redistribution of F-actin and changes in filament morphology. Quantitative analysis revealed coordinated shifts in structural and mechanical parameters across the experimental conditions. These findings suggested that MVV infection is associated to consistent remodelling of viscoelastic behaviour and actin organization. Overall, this study provides a quantitative biomechanical characterization of MVV associated cellular changes and establishes a descriptive framework for time resolved and mechanistic investigations of virus-host interactions.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管宿主细胞的早期生物物理变化可能为病毒感染提供额外的指标，但对这些变化的定量分析仍处于早期阶段。在本研究中，我们利用原子力显微镜（AFM）和共聚焦显微镜，研究了暴露于麻疹疫苗病毒（MVV）后Vero细胞的机械响应。我们在核周区域进行了AFM力-距离和应力松弛测量，以评估感染细胞的弹性和粘弹性特性。在感染后24小时内，以感染复数（MOI）为0.5感染的细胞，其杨氏模量中位数相比未感染对照组降低了约35%，表明细胞显著软化。还观察到粘弹性参数的变化，包括松弛模量E0降低以及粘度η1和η2减小，与用肌动蛋白解聚剂细胞松弛素-D处理的细胞所测得的参数相当。共聚焦显微镜显示，细胞骨架重组呈剂量依赖性，其特征为F-肌动蛋白的重新分布和丝状形态的变化。定量分析揭示了实验条件下结构和机械参数的协调变化。这些发现表明，MVV感染与粘弹性行为和肌动蛋白组织的一致重塑相关。总体而言，本研究提供了MVV相关细胞变化的定量生物力学表征，并为病毒-宿主相互作用的时间分辨和机制研究建立了描述性框架。

articles.title_en: Is irregular migration responsive to recent German asylum policy adjustments?
articles.title_cn: 非正规移民是否对德国近期庇护政策调整做出反应？
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors We investigate the extent to which asylum policies that aim to deter individuals from migrating irregularly in fact do so. We specifically consider effects of Germany's 2023 asylum policy adjustments, which include accelerated asylum decision processes, the prospect of asylum processing outside of Europe, the introduction of a payment card to replace cash benefits, and an extended waiting period for native-level benefits. To estimate the effects of these policy measures on irregular migration intent, we implement a conjoint experiment with 989 men aged 18–40 in four cities in Senegal, a country where irregular migration to Europe is highly salient. Offshoring the asylum process substantially lowers irregular migration intentions, and extending the waiting time for native-level benefits only has a small effect on intent. Neither reducing asylum processing times nor replacing cash benefits with a payment card alters intentions. Our study does not resolve political and normative questions concerning these policies.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 我们研究了旨在阻止个人非正规移民的庇护政策在多大程度上确实起到了这种作用。我们特别考虑了德国2023年庇护政策调整的影响，这些调整包括加速庇护决定程序、在欧洲以外处理庇护申请的前景、引入支付卡以取代现金福利，以及延长获得本地水平福利的等待期。为了估计这些政策措施对非正规移民意愿的影响，我们在塞内加尔四个城市对989名年龄在18-40岁的男性进行了一项联合实验，该国非正规移民到欧洲的现象非常突出。将庇护程序外包显著降低了非正规移民意愿，而延长获得本地水平福利的等待时间对意愿的影响很小。缩短庇护处理时间或用支付卡取代现金福利均未改变意愿。我们的研究并未解决有关这些政策的政治和规范性问题。

articles.title_en: Virtual tomography of a polymer gel’s structure from a single SEM image
articles.title_cn: 基于单张SEM图像的聚合物凝胶结构虚拟断层扫描
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd We present a computational framework for converting a 2D image obtained via electron scanning microscopy to a 3D object with reconstructed invisible interconnections. The approach consists of depth estimation using a perspective- and depth-of-field-corrected grayscale level, followed by the skeletonization of images corresponding to a set of equal depths. The obtained skeletons are further adjusted against their visible counterparts using the Gaussian convolution transform, and the resulting set of images is assembled into a stack of slices that satisfies the requirements of DICOM (Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine), allowing efficient exploration of spatial structures via software developed for computed tomography. The approach is implemented as computer code and applied to porous structures comprising the polymer component of a recently created organogel exhibiting efficient chemomechanical behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 我们提出了一种计算框架，用于将通过电子扫描显微镜获得的二维图像转换为具有重建不可见互连结构的三维物体。该方法包括使用透视和景深校正的灰度级进行深度估计，然后对对应于一组等深度的图像进行骨架化。获得的骨架进一步通过高斯卷积变换与其可见对应物进行调整，并将生成的图像集合组装成满足DICOM（医学数字成像和通信）要求的切片堆栈，从而允许通过为计算机断层扫描开发的软件高效探索空间结构。该方法以计算机代码实现，并应用于最近创建的一种表现出高效化学机械行为的有机凝胶的聚合物组分所构成的多孔结构。

articles.title_en: Revolutionizing the underworld: Can the digital economy shrink the informal economy?
articles.title_cn: 革新地下经济：数字经济能否缩小非正规经济？
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd The informal economy has come under increasing scrutiny. Rather than relying on coercive measures, efforts should focus on formalizing the informal economy by expanding the formal sector, with the digital economy playing a pivotal role in this transition. This study examines the influence of the digital economy on the informal economy across 89 countries from 2003 to 2017, using a two-way fixed effects regression method. The study draws the following conclusions. Firstly, the digital economy contributes to a significant reduction in the size of the informal economy, a result supported by robustness tests. Secondly, the mechanism test results reveal that this reduction is driven by improvements in institutional quality and financial inclusion. Finally, the heterogeneity test suggests that the influence of the digital economy is particularly strong in countries with higher levels of economic development and educational attainment. Overall, these findings complement existing studies, deliver helpful implications for policymakers, and suggest some new lines for future research.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 非正规经济日益受到关注。与其依赖强制措施，不如通过扩大正规部门来实现非正规经济正规化，而数字经济在这一转型中发挥着关键作用。本研究利用双向固定效应回归方法，考察了2003年至2017年间89个国家数字经济对非正规经济的影响。研究得出以下结论。首先，数字经济显著缩小了非正规经济的规模，这一结果得到了稳健性检验的支持。其次，机制检验结果表明，这种缩小是由制度质量和金融包容性的提升所驱动的。最后，异质性检验表明，在经济发展水平和教育程度较高的国家，数字经济的影响尤为显著。总体而言，这些发现补充了现有研究，为政策制定者提供了有益启示，并为未来研究提出了一些新方向。

articles.title_en: Estimating the strain and composition dependence of the mean inner potential of alloyed semiconductors
articles.title_cn: 估算合金半导体平均内势的应变和成分依赖性
articles.abstract_en: In this publication, we study the influence of strain and alloying on the mean inner potential (MIP) using density functional theory (DFT) within an augmented plane waves plus local orbitals (APW+LO) basis set. Two major effects have been identified allowing to model the influence of strain and alloying on the mean inner potential with a reasonable accuracy. First, alloying for constant volume results in a linear relationship between the MIP and the concentration. Second, the MIP scales with changes in volume as we already pointed out in an earlier publication [Appl. Phys. Lett. 85, 4938–4940 (2004)]. Specifically, a linear relationship between MIP and concentration x was found for Al x Ga 1 − x As (nearly no change in lattice parameter), whereas In x Ga 1 − x P and Ge x Si 1 − x (volume changes with concentration x ) exhibits a clear bowing. The bowing can be modelled by taking the rescaling of the MIP with the varying volume additionally into account. The rescaling could be also used to model the dependence of the MIP on strained binary cells and the density dependence of e.g. amorphous materials.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们使用增强平面波加局域轨道（APW+LO）基组内的密度泛函理论（DFT）研究了应变和合金化对平均内势（MIP）的影响。已确定两个主要效应，使得能够以合理的精度模拟应变和合金化对平均内势的影响。首先，在恒定体积下的合金化导致MIP与浓度之间存在线性关系。其次，正如我们早前出版物[Appl. Phys. Lett. 85, 4938-4940 (2004)]中所指出的，MIP随体积变化而缩放。具体来说，对于Al x Ga 1 − x As（晶格参数几乎不变），发现MIP与浓度x之间存在线性关系，而In x Ga 1 − x P和Ge x Si 1 − x（体积随浓度x变化）则表现出明显的弯曲。这种弯曲可以通过额外考虑MIP随体积变化的重新缩放来建模。该重新缩放也可用于模拟应变二元电池中MIP的依赖性以及例如非晶材料的密度依赖性。

articles.title_en: Growing global shipping costs increase population mortality in Africa
articles.title_cn: 全球航运成本上升增加非洲人口死亡率
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd Reducing mortality is vital for Africa, whose economy depends on global shipping. This paper provides novel insights into the effects of global shipping costs on population mortality, which has been largely overlooked. For the first time, we investigated the relationship between shipping costs and population mortality across 45 African countries from 2000 to 2020. We found that the rising dry bulk shipping cost was significantly associated with higher population mortality, particularly among women in African countries, which were net importers of dry bulk commodities. It was revealed that East Africa was more vulnerable to shipping cost shocks than West Africa. Furthermore, by integrating climate factors with a long short-term memory model, we predicted the trends in shipping costs for 2040, 2070, and 2100 under different climate change scenarios and investigated the potential threats these changes pose to population mortality in Africa. The results show that population mortality in Africa is likely to face increasing challenges due to the rise in shipping costs under future climate change scenarios and global disruptions such as pandemics and financial crises. The population mortality in Africa may reach 10.06143 - 12.1939 deaths per 1,000 people, with total deaths ranging from 15.90 to 31.36 million. These findings provide new insights into the potential benefits of reducing global shipping costs for improving health outcomes in Africa.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 降低死亡率对非洲至关重要，其经济依赖于全球航运。本文对全球航运成本对人口死亡率的影响提供了新颖的见解，这一影响在很大程度上被忽视了。我们首次调查了45年至2000年间2020个非洲国家航运成本与人口死亡率之间的关系。我们发现，干散货航运成本的上升与人口死亡率的显著增加相关，尤其是在作为干散货商品净进口国的非洲国家中的女性群体中。研究揭示，东非比西非更容易受到航运成本冲击的影响。此外，通过将气候因素与长短期记忆模型相结合，我们预测了不同气候变化情景下2040年、2070年和2100年的航运成本趋势，并调查了这些变化对非洲人口死亡率构成的潜在威胁。结果表明，在未来气候变化情景以及疫情和金融危机等全球性干扰下，非洲人口死亡率可能因航运成本上升而面临日益严峻的挑战。非洲人口死亡率可能达到每10.06143人中12.1939至1,000人死亡，总死亡人数在15.90万至31.36万之间。这些发现为降低全球航运成本对改善非洲健康结果的潜在益处提供了新的见解。

articles.title_en: Balloon dilation of the eustachian tube in pediatric patients: A systematic review and meta-analysis of functional, audiological, and safety outcomes
articles.title_cn: 儿科患者咽鼓管球囊扩张：功能、听力和安全结果的系统评价和荟萃分析
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Objectives: To systematically review and meta-analyze the efficacy and safety of balloon dilation of the Eustachian tube (BDET) in pediatric patients with Eustachian tube dysfunction (ETD). Methods: PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched from inception to October 25, 2025. Original studies of any design evaluating BDET in pediatric patients were included. Outcomes included air-bone gap (ABG), pure-tone average (PTA), Eustachian tube scores, tubomanometry, Valsalva maneuver, tympanometry, tympanic membrane findings, efficacy, and complications. Mean differences (MD) and odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were pooled using fixed- or random-effects models. Results: Twenty studies (18 retrospective, 2 prospective) involving 1175 children (1868 ears; mean age 9.1 years) were included. Within-cohort analyses showed significant ABG improvement at 6 months (MD −14.84 dB; 95% CI: −26.11 to −3.57) and 12 months (MD −10.60 dB; 95% CI: −18.29 to −2.90). Eustachian tube scores significantly improved (MD 3.78; 95% CI: 2.85–4.71), and negative Valsalva results were significantly reduced after BDET (OR 17.21; 95% CI: 6.87–43.12). However, comparative analyses versus controls showed no significant differences in ABG or efficacy/cure rates (OR 1.08; 95% CI: 0.31–3.73). PTA and tubomanometric resistance scores showed no significant changes. The pooled efficacy rate was 67%, and the pooled complication rate was 3% (95% CI, 2–4%). Heterogeneity was high, and most studies were of fair quality. Conclusion: BDET may improve functional and audiological outcomes in pediatric ETD, but current comparative evidence does not confirm superiority over standard management. Higher-quality prospective randomized studies are needed.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 目标：系统评价和荟萃分析咽鼓管球囊扩张术 (BDET) 对咽鼓管功能障碍 (ETD) 儿科患者的疗效和安全性。方法：从开始到 十月 25、2025 检索 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science。任何评估儿科患者 BDET 的设计的原始研究都包括在内。结果包括气骨间隙（ABG）、纯音平均（PTA）、咽鼓管评分、管压测量、瓦氏动作、鼓室测量、鼓膜检查结果、疗效和并发症。使用固定效应或随机效应模型汇总具有 95% 置信区间 (CI) 的平均差 (MD) 和比值比 (OR)。结果：纳入了 二十 项研究（18 回顾性，2 前瞻性），涉及 1175 儿童（1868 耳；平均年龄 9.1 岁）。队列内分析显示，ABG 在 6 个月（MD −14.84 dB；95% CI：−26.11 至 −3.57）和 12 个月（MD −10.60 dB；95% CI：−18.29 至 −2.90 时显着改善。 BDET 后咽鼓管评分显着改善（MD 3.78；95% CI：2.85-4.71），阴性 Valsalva 结果显着减少（OR 17.21；95% CI：6.87-43.12）。然而，与对照相比的比较分析显示，ABG 或疗效/治愈率没有显着差异（OR 1.08；95% CI：0.31-3.73）。 PTA 和输卵管测压阻力评分未显示显着变化。汇总有效率为67%，汇总并发症率为3%（95% CI，2-4%）。异质性很高，大多数研究质量一般。结论：BDET 可以改善儿科 ETD 的功能和听力结果，但目前的比较证据并未证实优于标准管理。需要更高质量的前瞻性随机研究。

articles.title_en: Refugees, camps, and host communities: Evidence from Bangladesh’s humanitarian hosting system
articles.title_cn: 难民、营地与收容社区：来自孟加拉国人道主义收容体系的证据
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 By 2025, over 42 million refugees will be hosted in low- and middle-income countries, which rely on one of two models: a humanitarian model centered on international aid and camp-based restrictions on integration, or a development-based model promoting self-reliance and gradual integration. We study the local development impacts of a pure humanitarian model, focusing on Rohingya refugees in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh. Combining remote sensing data with longitudinal household surveys, we exploit variation in distance to refugee camps before and after the refugee influx to explore the effects of this refugee hosting model. We find that areas closer to camps experienced higher economic growth following the arrival of the Rohingya. Household-level evidence points to humanitarian aid as the key mechanism: host communities near camps exhibit higher job formality, aid access, and food consumption. However, proximity to camps is also associated with adverse effects, including increased safety concerns and a higher prevalence of communicable diseases among host populations. These results are consistent with epidemiological spillovers and increased pressure on local infrastructure offsetting gains from expanded service provision.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 到 2025 年，超过 42 百万难民将被收容在中低收入国家，这些国家依赖两种模式之一：一种是以国际援助和基于营地的融合限制为中心的人道主义模式，另一种是促进自力更生和逐步融合的发展型模式。我们研究纯粹人道主义模式对当地发展的影响，重点关注孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔的罗兴亚难民。结合遥感数据和纵向家庭调查，我们利用难民涌入前后距离难民营的差异来探讨这种难民收容模式的影响。我们发现，在罗兴亚人到来后，靠近难民营的地区经历了更高的经济增长。家庭层面的证据表明人道主义援助是关键机制：靠近难民营的收容社区表现出更高的就业正规性、援助获取和食品消费。然而，靠近难民营也与不利影响相关，包括收容人口中安全担忧增加和传染病患病率上升。这些结果与流行病学溢出效应以及当地基础设施压力增加抵消了服务提供扩展带来的收益相一致。

articles.title_en: Swallowing dysfunction and quality of life in children with tonsillar hypertrophy and sleep-disordered breathing: A prospective cohort study
articles.title_cn: 扁桃体肥大和睡眠呼吸障碍儿童的吞咽功能障碍与生活质量：一项前瞻性队列研究
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundTonsillar hypertrophy is a common cause of sleep-disordered breathing (SDB) in children and may contribute to swallowing dysfunction through upper airway obstruction. However, its impact on swallowing-related quality of life has not been well characterized. ObjectiveTo evaluate swallowing-related quality of life in children with tonsillar hypertrophy and SDB, assess the effect of surgical treatment, and validate an Arabic version of the Pediatric SWAL-QOL questionnaire. MethodsIn this prospective cohort study, 50 children with SDB and Brodsky grade ≥2 tonsillar hypertrophy were compared with 53 healthy controls. Swallowing-related quality of life was assessed using the Pediatric SWAL-QOL questionnaire. Surgical patients completed the questionnaire before and three months after surgery; controls completed it once. Forty-six children completed postoperative follow-up. The Arabic questionnaire underwent forward-backward translation and psychometric validation. ResultsChildren with tonsillar hypertrophy and SDB demonstrated significantly worse preoperative SWAL-QOL scores than controls (31.74 ± 25.05 vs. 2.47 ± 4.00; p < 0.001). Following surgical treatment, scores improved significantly to 0.98 ± 1.69 (p < 0.001) and were no longer different from controls (p = 0.211). Significant improvement was observed across all SWAL-QOL domains. Dysphagia severity was not associated with Brodsky tonsil grade or recurrent tonsillitis. The Arabic SWAL-QOL demonstrated excellent test–retest reliability (ICC = 0.996) and high internal consistency (Cronbach's α > 0.80). ConclusionsChildren with tonsillar hypertrophy and SDB experience significant swallowing dysfunction that improves substantially following surgical treatment. Dysphagia severity appears to be more closely related to functional upper airway obstruction than tonsil size alone. The Arabic Pediatric SWAL-QOL is a reliable tool for assessing swallowing dysfunction in Arabic-speaking pediatric populations.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景扁桃体肥大是儿童睡眠呼吸障碍（SDB）的常见原因，并可能通过上气道阻塞导致吞咽功能障碍。然而，其对吞咽相关生活质量的影响尚未得到充分描述。目的评估扁桃体肥大和SDB儿童的吞咽相关生活质量，评估手术治疗的效果，并验证阿拉伯语版儿科SWAL-QOL问卷。方法在这项前瞻性队列研究中，将50名患有SDB且Brodsky分级≥2的扁桃体肥大儿童与53名健康对照进行比较。使用儿科SWAL-QOL问卷评估吞咽相关生活质量。手术患者在术前和术后三个月完成问卷；对照组仅完成一次。四十六名儿童完成了术后随访。阿拉伯语问卷经过正向-反向翻译和心理测量学验证。结果扁桃体肥大和SDB儿童的术前SWAL-QOL评分显著差于对照组（31.74 ± 25.05 对比 2.47 ± 4.00；p < 0.001）。手术治疗后，评分显著改善至0.98 ± 1.69（p < 0.001），且与对照组不再有差异（p = 0.211）。所有SWAL-QOL领域均观察到显著改善。吞咽困难严重程度与Brodsky扁桃体分级或复发性扁桃体炎无关。阿拉伯语SWAL-QOL显示出极好的重测信度（ICC = 0.996）和高内部一致性（Cronbach's α > 0.80）。结论扁桃体肥大和SDB儿童经历显著的吞咽功能障碍，手术治疗后显著改善。吞咽困难严重程度似乎与功能性上气道阻塞的关系比单纯扁桃体大小更密切。阿拉伯语儿科SWAL-QOL是评估阿拉伯语儿科人群吞咽功能障碍的可靠工具。

articles.title_en: RPSR theory based multi-feature decision fusion for apple grading
articles.title_cn: 基于RPSR理论的多特征决策融合苹果分级
articles.abstract_en: Most existing studies on apple quality grading focus solely on a single modality-either internal physicochemical indicators such as soluble solids content (SSC) or moisture content (MC), or external visual appearance images-yet insufficient attention has been devoted to multimodal fusion. To address this issue, the Random Permutation Set (RPS) theory is introduced into the comprehensive evaluation of apple internal and external quality, which can effectively characterize the ordinal and rank-order relationships among diverse features and achieve decision-level fusion of heterogeneous features. Moreover, internal quality indicators rely on prediction models established between near-infrared spectroscopy and corresponding quality parameters. However, the imbalanced collected data distributions often result in inaccurate Gaussian mass functions generated by traditional data-driven methods, thus weakening the applicability of Gaussian distribution functions in the RPSR model. To overcome this limitation, a triangular function for the Gaussian function is proposed fitting to optimize the generation of feature sources. Meanwhile, a strategy of constructing multiple feature sources from a single feature is developed, enabling one feature to correspond to multiple feature sources. Furthermore, to address the issue where high conflicts frequently invalidate the left orthogonal combination rule in the original model, an improved left orthogonal combination rule based on Proportional Conflict Redistribution (PCR) is proposed. This rule allocates conflicts proportionally to alleviate severe inconsistencies between features Finally, a multimodal decision-level fusion framework for apple quality grading is successfully constructed and implemented.
articles.abstract_cn: 现有大多数苹果品质分级研究仅关注单一模态——要么是内部理化指标，如可溶性固形物含量（SSC）或水分含量（MC），要么是外部视觉外观图像——但对多模态融合的关注不足。为解决这一问题，将随机排列集（RPS）理论引入苹果内外品质的综合评价中，该理论能有效刻画不同特征间的序关系和秩次关系，实现异构特征的决策级融合。此外，内部品质指标依赖于近红外光谱与相应品质参数之间建立的预测模型。然而，采集数据分布的不均衡常导致传统数据驱动方法生成的高斯质量函数不准确，从而削弱了高斯分布函数在RPSR模型中的适用性。为克服这一局限，提出了一种针对高斯函数的三角函数拟合，以优化特征源的生成。同时，开发了一种从单一特征构建多个特征源的策略，使一个特征能够对应多个特征源。进一步，为解决原始模型中高冲突常导致左正交组合规则失效的问题，提出了一种基于比例冲突再分配（PCR）的改进左正交组合规则。该规则按比例分配冲突，以缓解特征间的严重不一致。最后，成功构建并实现了苹果品质分级的多模态决策级融合框架。

articles.title_en: Selective subspace unlearning for text to image diffusion models
articles.title_cn: 选择性子空间遗忘用于文本到图像扩散模型
articles.abstract_en: Machine unlearning seeks to selectively erase the influence of particular data or concepts from a trained model without degrading its performance on unrelated information. In large generative models such as latent diffusion models, this task is formulated as a bi-objective optimization problem balancing the trade-off between a forgetting objective (removing targeted concepts) and a retention objective (preserving overall model utility). Machine unlearning methods focusing on the naive optimization of these objectives often lead to gradient conflict and gradient dominance, where one objective overwhelms the other, resulting in ineffective forgetting or degradation of model quality. We propose a two-stage selective subspace unlearning (SSU) framework that reduces the active parameter space and balances the bi-objective optimization problem. A dual empirical Fisher-based scoring first identifies parameters with minimum overlap of forgetting and retention objectives. On the selected parameter space, a conflict-aware strategy is applied to balance the gradients and resolve residual directional conflict. Our approach suppresses gradient noise from irrelevant dimensions, enabling effective concept removal while preserving generation quality and overall model utility.
articles.abstract_cn: 机器遗忘旨在从训练模型中选择性消除特定数据或概念的影响，而不降低其对无关信息的性能。在大型生成模型（如潜在扩散模型）中，该任务被表述为一个双目标优化问题，平衡遗忘目标（移除目标概念）与保留目标（保持整体模型效用）之间的权衡。专注于这些目标朴素优化的机器遗忘方法常常导致梯度冲突和梯度主导，其中一个目标压倒另一个，导致遗忘无效或模型质量下降。我们提出了一种两阶段选择性子空间遗忘（SSU）框架，该框架减少活动参数空间并平衡双目标优化问题。基于双经验Fisher评分首先识别遗忘和保留目标重叠最小的参数。在选定的参数空间上，应用冲突感知策略来平衡梯度并解决残余方向冲突。我们的方法抑制了来自无关维度的梯度噪声，从而在保持生成质量和整体模型效用的同时实现有效的概念移除。

articles.title_en: Intraspecific trait variation of a floating macrophyte, <ce:italic>Nymphaea rudgeana</ce:italic> G.Mey. (Nymphaeaceae), across different river basins in the Eastern Amazon
articles.title_cn: 漂浮大型植物红睡莲（睡莲科）在亚马逊东部不同河流流域的种内性状变异
articles.abstract_en: The variability of plant traits within a single species, driven by adaptation and phenotypic plasticity, enhances an individual's ability to survive under changing conditions. While intraspecific trait variation (ITV) is recognized as a key driver of plant adaptation, how aquatic plants modulate their functional strategies across distinct regional and local environmental gradients remains poorly understood. We evaluated the ITV of Nymphaea rudgeana across two Amazonian River basins (Acará-Guamá and Gurupi), measuring leaf morphological traits and petiole length in 56 individuals across 19 sites. Our results showed that ITV varied across traits, with leaf area (LA) and specific leaf area (SLA) exhibiting greater plasticity than leaf dry matter content (LDMC) and petiole length. Interestingly, large-scale regional differences (river basins) weakly explained trait variation. Instead, local environmental factors were the primary drivers of ITV. Environmental conditions such as water depth, temperature, and sediment chemical composition (e.g., sodium and aluminum), triggered distinct shifts in strategies, by modulating leaf expansion and resource investment toward either acquisitive or conservative strategies. Overall, N. rudgeana exhibited varying phenotypic responses to environmental variation rather than regional boundaries. Our findings emphasize the importance of local environmental factors over regional differences in shaping aquatic plant ITV, with implications for predicting macrophyte responses to habitat alterations and climate change. Further research should consider genetic differentiation and plasticity to better understand ITV patterns in widely distributed aquatic species.
articles.abstract_cn: 植物性状在同一物种内的变异性，由适应和表型可塑性驱动，增强了个体在变化条件下生存的能力。尽管种内性状变异（ITV）被认为是植物适应的关键驱动因素，但水生植物如何在不同的区域和局部环境梯度中调节其功能策略仍知之甚少。我们评估了红睡莲在两个亚马逊河流域（Acará-Guamá和Gurupi）的ITV，测量了56个个体在19个地点的叶片形态性状和叶柄长度。结果表明，ITV在不同性状间存在差异，叶面积（LA）和比叶面积（SLA）表现出比叶片干物质含量（LDMC）和叶柄长度更大的可塑性。有趣的是，大尺度的区域差异（河流流域）对性状变异的解释力较弱。相反，局部环境因素是ITV的主要驱动因素。环境条件如水深、温度和沉积物化学组成（例如钠和铝），通过调节叶片扩展和资源投资，触发了向获取性或保守性策略的明显转变。总体而言，红睡莲对环境变异表现出不同的表型响应，而非区域边界。我们的发现强调了局部环境因素在塑造水生植物ITV中相对于区域差异的重要性，这对预测大型植物对栖息地改变和气候变化的响应具有意义。进一步的研究应考虑遗传分化和可塑性，以更好地理解广泛分布的水生物种的ITV模式。

articles.title_en: Enforcing discipline in China: Countering internal misinformation with public disclosure
articles.title_cn: 中国执行纪律：以公开披露应对内部虚假信息
articles.abstract_en: Governments around the world need internal discipline to ensure the implementation of policies and delivery of governance outputs, and this need is more severe in authoritarian systems that govern top-down and without bottom-up electoral pressures. Conventional wisdom suggests that autocrats rely on punishment to discipline subordinates who fail to obey orders, but we argue that public disclosure of such malfeasance can also be effective, even when unaccompanied by punishment. In the case of internal misinformation—the tampering of government data and statistics by local agents to distort central authorities’ decisions—we find that the Chinese government successfully adopted public disclosure to combat the manipulation of local GDP numbers by lower-level governments. Our evidence indicates that publicly disclosing a prior act of falsification reduced future manipulation and did so at various levels of local governments, even as officials implicated by the disclosure faced no career setbacks. Hinting at downstream impacts, such disclosure also improved confidence among economic actors, evidenced by increased business activity in localities involved in public disclosures.
articles.abstract_cn: 世界各地的政府需要内部纪律以确保政策实施和治理成果的交付，而这种需求在自上而下治理且缺乏自下而上选举压力的威权体制中更为迫切。传统观点认为，威权者依赖惩罚来约束不服从命令的下属，但我们认为，公开披露此类不当行为即使不伴随惩罚也能有效。在内部虚假信息——即地方代理人篡改政府数据和统计以扭曲中央决策——的情况下，我们发现中国政府成功采用公开披露来打击下级政府对地方GDP数据的操纵。我们的证据表明，公开披露先前的造假行为减少了未来的操纵，并在各级地方政府中均有效，即使被披露涉及的官员并未面临职业挫折。暗示下游影响，此类披露还提高了经济参与者的信心，表现为公开披露涉及地区的商业活动增加。

articles.title_en: Preseptal cellulitis versus orbital spectrum disease in children: Early predictors and impact on hospital costs
articles.title_cn: 儿童眶隔前蜂窝织炎与眶部谱系疾病：早期预测因素及其对住院费用的影响
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundPeriorbital infections in children encompass a clinical spectrum from preseptal cellulitis (PC) to orbital spectrum disease (OSD), with markedly different management requirements and outcomes. The economic consequences of this distinction remain poorly characterized. ObjectivesTo identify independent predictors of orbital involvement in children presenting with periorbital infection, and to quantify the impact of disease severity on hospital costs across five expenditure categories. MethodsThis retrospective cohort study included 219 pediatric patients managed at a tertiary center between 2016 and 2022. Patients were classified as PC (n = 177) or OSD (n = 42) using the modified Chandler Classification. Clinical, laboratory, radiological, and detailed cost data were collected. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify independent predictors of OSD and of high-cost hospitalization. ResultsOSD patients were significantly older (median 7.5 vs. 5.0 years, p < 0.001), presented more frequently with pain, fever, and presenting symptom count ≥3, and had higher rates of extensive sinus involvement (54.8% vs. 20.3%, p < 0.001). C-reactive protein (CRP) and neutrophil counts were markedly elevated in OSD, while lymphocyte counts were significantly lower (median 2.6 vs. 4.0 × 103/μL, p < 0.001). Four variables independently predicted OSD: presenting symptom count ≥3 (adjusted OR [aOR] 4.90), extensive sinus involvement (aOR 3.01), age (aOR 1.12 per year), and CRP (aOR 1.09 per 10 mg/L); model AUC was 0.825. Median total cost was 8.3-fold higher in OSD than PC (USD 140.3 vs. 16.9, p < 0.001). OSD, sinusitis, and elevated CRP independently predicted high-cost hospitalization. ConclusionsAge, presenting symptom count, extensive sinus involvement, and CRP assessed during the initial diagnostic evaluation support early identification of children at risk for orbital involvement. Although lymphopenia was associated with orbital spectrum disease on univariate analysis, it was not retained as an independent predictor in the final multivariable model; its potential clinical utility should be considered exploratory and warrants further investigation in larger prospective studies. Orbital involvement is associated with substantially higher hospital costs, driven primarily by service and medication expenditures.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景儿童眶周感染涵盖从眶隔前蜂窝织炎（PC）到眶部谱系疾病（OSD）的临床谱系，其管理要求和结局显著不同。这种区分的经济后果仍缺乏充分描述。目的识别儿童眶周感染中眶部受累的独立预测因素，并量化疾病严重程度对五个支出类别中住院费用的影响。方法本回顾性队列研究纳入2016年至2022年间在三级中心管理的219例儿科患者。采用改良Chandler分类将患者分为PC（n = 177）或OSD（n = 42）。收集临床、实验室、放射学和详细费用数据。使用多变量逻辑回归识别OSD和高费用住院的独立预测因素。结果OSD患者年龄显著较大（中位数7.5岁对比5.0岁，p < 0.001），更常出现疼痛、发热和症状数量≥3，且广泛鼻窦受累率更高（54.8%对比20.3%，p < 0.001）。OSD中C反应蛋白（CRP）和中性粒细胞计数显著升高，而淋巴细胞计数显著较低（中位数2.6对比4.0 × 103/μL，p < 0.001）。四个变量独立预测OSD：症状数量≥3（调整后比值比[aOR] 4.90）、广泛鼻窦受累（aOR 3.01）、年龄（aOR 1.12每年）和CRP（aOR 1.09每10 mg/L）；模型AUC为0.825。OSD的中位总费用比PC高8.3倍（USD 140.3对比16.9，p < 0.001）。OSD、鼻窦炎和CRP升高独立预测高费用住院。结论初次诊断评估期间评估的年龄、症状数量、广泛鼻窦受累和CRP支持早期识别有眶部受累风险的儿童。尽管单变量分析中淋巴细胞减少与眶部谱系疾病相关，但在最终多变量模型中未保留为独立预测因素；其潜在临床实用性应视为探索性的，并需在更大规模的前瞻性研究中进一步验证。眶部受累与显著更高的住院费用相关，主要由服务和药物支出驱动。

articles.title_en: Subtotal petrosectomy in children: Indications, outcomes, and age-related patterns in a pediatric cohort
articles.title_cn: 儿童次全岩骨切除术：儿科队列中的适应症、结果及年龄相关模式
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Background: Subtotal petrosectomy (STP) is a radical otologic procedure aimed at complete eradication of diseased temporal bone air cells and creation of a closed, sterile cavity. While well established in adult otology, its role in pediatric patients remains insufficiently described. Objectives: To analyze current indications, outcomes and complication rates of subtotal petrosectomy in a pediatric population, with particular emphasis in age – related patterns of indications. Materials and methods: A retrospective review was conducted of 20 children (<18 years) who underwent STP between 2010 and 2024 at two tertiary referral centers. Patients were analyzed according to age groups (≤6 years vs. >6 years) and etiology, categorized as congenital (including congenital malformations, CHARGE syndrome and congenital CSF leaks) or acquired (cholesteatoma, chronic otitis media, traumatic and oncological lesions). Major and minor complications were recorded and analyzed using non – parametric statistical methods. Results: The cohort included 15 boys and 5 girls with a mean follow-up of 4.3 ± 1.2 years. Congenital indications predominated in children ≤6 years, whereas acquired pathologies were significantly more common in older children (>6 years) (Fisher's exact test, p = 0.018). Patients treated for congenital indications were significantly younger than those with acquired pathologies (p = 0.0095). Major complications occurred in 2 of 20 patients (10%, 95% confidence interval 1,2-31,7%), including cholesteatoma recurrence requiring revision surgery and conversion to an open technique. Minor complications were observed in one patient (5%) and consisted of an abdominal hematoma). No cases of implant loss, permanent facial nerve palsy or wound dehiscence were observed. Conclusions: STP is a safe and effective procedure in selected pediatric patients, with low rates of major complications. Indications differ significantly by age, with congenital pathology predominating in younger children and acquired in older patients. In children, STP should be regarded not as salvage procedure but as a reconstructive strategy providing a stable anatomical foundation for long term hearing rehabilitation and disease control.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 背景：次全岩骨切除术（STP）是一种根治性耳科手术，旨在彻底清除病变的颞骨气房并形成封闭的无菌腔。虽然该手术在成人耳科中已得到充分确立，但其在儿科患者中的作用仍描述不足。目的：分析儿科人群中次全岩骨切除术的当前适应症、结果和并发症发生率，特别关注适应症的年龄相关模式。材料与方法：对2010年至2024年间在两个三级转诊中心接受STP的20名儿童（<18岁）进行了回顾性审查。根据年龄组（≤6岁 vs. >6岁）和病因对患者进行分析，病因分为先天性（包括先天性畸形、CHARGE综合征和先天性脑脊液漏）和获得性（胆脂瘤、慢性中耳炎、创伤性和肿瘤性病变）。记录主要和次要并发症，并使用非参数统计方法进行分析。结果：队列包括15名男孩和5名女孩，平均随访时间为4.3 ± 1.2年。先天性适应症在≤6岁儿童中占主导，而获得性病理在年龄较大的儿童（>6岁）中显著更常见（Fisher精确检验，p = 0.018）。因先天性适应症接受治疗的患者显著年轻于获得性病理患者（p = 0.0095）。主要并发症发生在20名患者中的2名（10%，95%置信区间一，2-31，7%），包括需要翻修手术并转为开放技术的胆脂瘤复发。次要并发症在1名患者（5%）中观察到，为腹部血肿。未观察到植入物丢失、永久性面神经麻痹或伤口裂开的病例。结论：STP在选定的儿科患者中是一种安全有效的手术，主要并发症发生率低。适应症因年龄而异，先天性病理在年幼儿童中占主导，而获得性病理在年长患者中更常见。在儿童中，STP不应被视为挽救性手术，而应被视为一种重建策略，为长期听力康复和疾病控制提供稳定的解剖基础。

articles.title_en: The effectiveness of theory of mind intervention in Persian-speaking 5–7-year-old children using hearing aids and cochlear implants: A randomized controlled trial
articles.title_cn: 心理理论干预对使用助听器和人工耳蜗的波斯语5-7岁儿童的有效性：一项随机对照试验
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Background: Theory of mind refers to the ability to attribute mental states to oneself and others and is foundational for effective social interaction. Children with hearing impairments often experience delays in theory of mind development, potentially due to limited access to language-based communication. While cochlear implants (CIs) and hearing aids (HAs) improve auditory access, the extent to which theory of mind skills can be enhanced through targeted intervention remains underexplored—particularly in Persian-speaking populations. Objective: To evaluate the effectiveness of a structured theory of mind intervention in improving theory of mind skills, comprehension of mental verbs, and mean length of utterance in Persian-speaking children aged 5–7 years with hearing impairments using CIs or HAs. Methods: A randomized controlled trial was conducted with 60 children (n = 15 per group), stratified into four groups: CI-Intervention, CI-Control, HA-Intervention, and HA-Control. The 8-week intervention (16 sessions) was adapted from existing theory of mind training programs and delivered by trained facilitators in rehabilitation centers across Kerman, Iran. Primary outcomes were theory of mind skills assessed using a validated Persian version of the theory of mind. Secondary outcomes included comprehension of mental verbs and mean length of utterance. Assessments were conducted at baseline, mid-intervention, post-intervention, and one-month follow-up. Repeated-measures ANOVA and post hoc tests were used for data analysis. Results: Both intervention groups demonstrated significant improvements in theory of mind performance across all three levels (p < 0.001), with moderate to large effect sizes (0.58–0.75). Comprehension of mental verbs significantly improved in the CI-intervention group post-intervention (p = 0.03). While mean length of utterance increased over time in both intervention groups, no statistically significant difference was observed between groups post-intervention. Children with cochlear implants consistently outperformed those using hearing aids across multiple outcome measures. Gains in theory of mind and mental verb comprehension were maintained at one-month follow-up, though some attenuation was observed. Conclusion: Structured theory of mind intervention is effective in enhancing theory of mind skills and mental verb comprehension in Persian-speaking children with hearing impairments, particularly those using cochlear implants. However, the limited impact on MLU and the partial maintenance of gains at follow-up suggest that sustained and linguistically enriched interventions may be necessary to consolidate and generalize improvements. Trial registration: IRCT20230827059274N1.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 背景：心理理论是指将心理状态归因于自己和他人并以此为基础进行有效社会互动的能力。听力受损儿童通常在心理理论发展上存在延迟，这可能是因为他们接触基于语言的交流机会有限。虽然人工耳蜗和助听器改善了听觉通路，但通过针对性干预能在多大程度上提升心理理论技能仍未得到充分探索——尤其是在波斯语人群中。目的：评估结构化心理理论干预在改善使用人工耳蜗或助听器的波斯语5-7岁听力受损儿童的心理理论技能、心理动词理解和平均话语长度方面的有效性。方法：进行了一项随机对照试验，共60名儿童（每组n = 15），分为四组：人工耳蜗干预组、人工耳蜗对照组、助听器干预组和助听器对照组。为期8周的干预（16次课程）改编自现有的心理理论训练项目，由经过培训的协调员在伊朗克尔曼的康复中心实施。主要结局是使用经过验证的波斯语版心理理论测试评估的心理理论技能。次要结局包括心理动词理解和平均话语长度。评估在基线、干预中期、干预后和一个月随访时进行。数据分析采用重复测量方差分析和事后检验。结果：两个干预组在所有三个水平上的心理理论表现均有显著改善（p < 0.001），效应量中等至较大（0.58-0.75）。人工耳蜗干预组在干预后心理动词理解显著改善（p = 0.03）。虽然两个干预组的平均话语长度随时间增加，但干预后组间差异无统计学意义。使用人工耳蜗的儿童在多项结局指标上始终优于使用助听器的儿童。心理理论和心理动词理解的改善在一个月随访时得以维持，但观察到部分衰减。结论：结构化心理理论干预能有效提升波斯语听力受损儿童的心理理论技能和心理动词理解，尤其是使用人工耳蜗的儿童。然而，对平均话语长度的影响有限以及随访时收益的部分维持表明，可能需要持续且语言丰富的干预来巩固和推广这些改善。试验注册号：IRCT20230827059274N1。

articles.title_en: Risk prediction model for adverse outcomes during and after cochlear implantation in children with inner ear abnormalities
articles.title_cn: 内耳异常儿童人工耳蜗植入术中和术后不良结局的风险预测模型
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Background: To construct a risk prediction model for adverse outcomes during and after cochlear implantation (CI) in children of different ages with inner ear abnormalities. Methods: This retrospective study included children with inner ear abnormalities (including large vestibular aqueduct syndrome, incomplete partition, cochlear hypoplasia, and cochlear common cavity malformation) who underwent CI from January 2011 to December 2023 at the First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University. The patients were divided into two groups based on the occurrence of adverse outcomes during the perioperative and postoperative periods. The patients were divided into age groups (<3, 3-6, and >6 years) to construct three predictive models. Baseline data were collected. Stepwise regression analysis was performed using the entire dataset, and internal validation was carried out using bootstrap resampling. Results: This study analyzed 609 children with inner ear abnormalities, divided into three age groups: <3, 3-6, and >6 years. Adverse outcomes were associated with various factors, including cochlear ossification, longer surgical time, cochlear hypoplasia, and cochlear common cavity malformation in the <3-year group (AUC = 0.68). In the 3-6-year group, factors included mastoiditis, middle ear malformation, cochlear ossification, and incomplete partition (AUC = 0.75). In the >6-year group, associations were found with middle ear malformation, cochlear ossification, and a high jugular bulb (AUC = 0.69). Conclusions: This study developed three nomograms for predicting adverse CI outcomes in patients aged <3, 3-6, and >6 years. These models demonstrate moderate discriminative ability and may serve as exploratory tools to assist in age-specific risk assessment and perioperative counseling for children with inner ear abnormalities.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 背景：构建不同年龄段内耳异常儿童人工耳蜗植入（CI）术中和术后不良结局的风险预测模型。方法：本回顾性研究纳入2011年一月至2023年十二月在安徽医科大学第一附属医院接受CI的内耳异常儿童（包括大前庭水管综合征、不完全分隔、耳蜗发育不良和耳蜗共同腔畸形）。根据围手术期和术后期间不良结局的发生情况将患者分为两组。将患者分为年龄组（<3岁、3-6岁和>6岁）以构建三个预测模型。收集基线数据。使用整个数据集进行逐步回归分析，并通过bootstrap重采样进行内部验证。结果：本研究分析了609名内耳异常儿童，分为三个年龄组：<3岁、3-6岁和>6岁。不良结局与多种因素相关，包括<3岁组的耳蜗骨化、较长手术时间、耳蜗发育不良和耳蜗共同腔畸形（AUC = 0.68）。在3-6岁组中，因素包括乳突炎、中耳畸形、耳蜗骨化和不完全分隔（AUC = 0.75）。在>6岁组中，发现与中耳畸形、耳蜗骨化和高位颈静脉球相关（AUC = 0.69）。结论：本研究开发了三个列线图，用于预测年龄<3岁、3-6岁和>6岁患者CI不良结局。这些模型显示出中等区分能力，可作为辅助内耳异常儿童年龄特异性风险评估和围手术期咨询的探索性工具。

articles.title_en: Full-day school programs and higher education: Evidence from Peru
articles.title_cn: 全日制学校项目与高等教育：来自秘鲁的证据
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd Full-day school programs aim to promote development by improving students’ learning outcomes. We estimate the impact of Peru's full-day secondary school reform, Jornada Escolar Completa (JEC), on higher education attainment. Using data from the Young Lives Study, we construct a grouped-sibling sample linking younger siblings who could attend JEC secondary schools with their older siblings who did not attend. The identification strategy relies on within-household variation and a difference-in-differences framework comparing changes in higher education attainment between households affected and not affected by the JEC program. We find that JEC increases the likelihood of pursuing higher education, with effects concentrated in technical rather than university studies. Our findings also suggest larger gains among students from disadvantaged backgrounds, pointing to the potential of JEC to narrow inequalities in access to higher education. Time-use data show that JEC students remain engaged in learning, with no increase in absenteeism or decline in study time at home. Rather, they compensate for longer school days by cutting back on leisure and work activities. Overall, the evidence indicates that the JEC program increases educational attainment, with extended instructional time likely being one contributing factor among other improvements in school resources. JEC's effects on upward mobility, however, may remain limited without complementary measures that ease access to university education.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 全日制学校项目旨在通过改善学生的学习成果来促进发展。我们评估了秘鲁的全日制中学改革——完整学校日（JEC）——对高等教育获得的影响。利用“青年生活研究”的数据，我们构建了一个分组兄弟姐妹样本，将可能就读JEC中学的较年幼兄弟姐妹与其未就读的较年长兄弟姐妹联系起来。识别策略依赖于家庭内部变异和双重差分框架，比较受JEC项目影响和未受影响的家庭在高等教育获得方面的变化。我们发现JEC增加了追求高等教育的可能性，其效应集中在技术类而非大学类学习上。我们的发现还表明，来自弱势背景的学生获益更大，这指向JEC在缩小高等教育入学机会不平等方面的潜力。时间使用数据显示，JEC学生保持学习参与，缺勤率没有增加，在家学习时间也没有减少。相反，他们通过减少休闲和工作活动来补偿更长的在校时间。总体而言，证据表明JEC项目提高了教育获得，延长教学时间可能是学校资源其他改善中的一个促成因素。然而，如果没有便利大学入学机会的补充措施，JEC对向上流动的影响可能仍然有限。

articles.title_en: Probabilistic image-based joint embedding predictive architecture
articles.title_cn: 基于概率的图像联合嵌入预测架构
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors. In the field of self-supervised learning, the Image-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (I-JEPA) has shown impressive results in capturing semantic information from images without the need for strong augmentations between views. I-JEPA learns to predict the representations of multiple masked target blocks within the same image, using the representation of a single unmasked context block. To achieve this, I-JEPA reconstructs the masked patches in the representation space rather than at the pixel level, as done in previous works. However, accurately reconstructing abstract representations of patches is a challenging task, as pointwise matching focuses on exact reconstruction of individual target representations rather than the preservation of their local geometric structure. In this work, we present a probabilistic matching approach that can be applied to I-JEPA’s learning process to encourage the output of semantically richer representations. Specifically, we propose a probabilistic formulation of I-JEPA, which involves efficiently modeling and matching the probability distributions of the missing patches between the target block representations and the network’s predictions based solely on the context block. Through rigorous evaluations, we demonstrate that the proposed methodology provides consistent improvements over I-JEPA in downstream classification and transfer learning tasks.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者。在自监督学习领域，基于图像的联合嵌入预测架构（I-JEPA）在无需视图间强增强的情况下，从图像中捕获语义信息方面展现了显著成果。I-JEPA 学习预测同一图像内多个掩蔽目标块的表示，仅使用单个未掩蔽上下文块的表示。为此，I-JEPA 在表示空间而非像素级别重建掩蔽补丁，这与先前的工作不同。然而，准确重建补丁的抽象表示是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为逐点匹配侧重于精确重建单个目标表示，而非保留其局部几何结构。在本工作中，我们提出了一种概率匹配方法，可应用于 I-JEPA 的学习过程，以促进输出语义更丰富的表示。具体而言，我们提出了 I-JEPA 的概率公式，涉及高效建模和匹配目标块表示与网络仅基于上下文块的预测之间的缺失补丁的概率分布。通过严格评估，我们证明了所提出的方法在下游分类和迁移学习任务中相较于 I-JEPA 提供了一致的改进。

articles.title_en: Disentangling shared and specific features in deep multimodal clustering with contrastive-complementary learning
articles.title_cn: 深度多模态聚类中共享与特定特征的解缠：对比-互补学习
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 . Multi-modal representation learning must integrate heterogeneous inputs while preserving both shared semantics and modality-specific complementary cues. Many deep multi-view clustering methods instead assume conditional independence between shared and private latents or enforce strict decorrelation, which can discard informative cross-view dependencies and reduce effectiveness when complementary information is important. We introduce C3U-MVC, a contrastive–complementary framework that learns an optimization-biased separation between aligned common representations and view-specific complementary information without imposing independence or orthogonality constraints. The model combines (i) cross-view contrastive alignment in the shared subspace, (ii) reconstruction from concatenated shared and view-specific latents to preserve complementary signals, and (iii) prototype-conditioned reconstruction with per-instance best-view selection for adaptive assignment. Training proceeds in two stages: contrastive pretraining followed by positives-only prototype refinement. Simple counterexamples show why independence assumptions need not hold in realistic multi-view settings. Experiments on seven benchmarks, including constructed image-pair datasets, true multi-view datasets, and heterogeneous Caltech-101 subsets, show that C3U-MVC achieves state-of-the-art or competitive clustering performance, with the clearest gains appearing when view-dependent complementary information is informative. Ablations further support the roles of complementary reconstruction, latent-capacity allocation, and prototype-guided refinement.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026。多模态表示学习必须整合异构输入，同时保留共享语义和模态特定的互补线索。许多深度多视图聚类方法反而假设共享和私有潜在变量之间的条件独立性或强制严格去相关，这可能会丢弃信息丰富的跨视图依赖，并在互补信息重要时降低有效性。我们引入了C3U-MVC，一种对比-互补框架，学习对齐的公共表示和视图特定互补信息之间的优化偏置分离，而不施加独立性或正交性约束。该模型结合了(i)共享子空间中的跨视图对比对齐，(ii)从拼接的共享和视图特定潜在变量进行重建以保留互补信号，以及(iii)原型条件重建与每实例最佳视图选择以实现自适应分配。训练分两个阶段进行：对比预训练，随后是仅正样本的原型细化。简单的反例说明了为什么在现实多视图设置中独立性假设不一定成立。在七个基准上的实验，包括构建的图像对数据集、真实多视图数据集和异构Caltech-101子集，表明C3U-MVC实现了最先进或具有竞争力的聚类性能，当视图依赖的互补信息具有信息性时，增益最为明显。消融研究进一步支持了互补重建、潜在容量分配和原型引导细化的作用。

articles.title_en: High-resolution underwater camouflaged object detection: GBU-UCOD dataset and topology-aware and frequency-decoupled networks
articles.title_cn: 高分辨率水下伪装目标检测：GBU-UCOD数据集与拓扑感知及频率解耦网络
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Underwater Camouflaged Object Detection (UCOD) is challenging because marine targets often share similar appearance with their surroundings across different ocean depths. Existing methods may suffer from fragmented predictions for slender deep-sea organisms and weak responses to transparent targets. In this paper, we introduce GBU-UCOD, a high-resolution benchmark tailored for marine vertical zonation, and propose DeepTopo-Net as a feasible framework for high-resolution UCOD. DeepTopo-Net combines the Water-Conditioned Adaptive Perceptor (WCAP) for degradation-aware feature perception with the Abyssal-Topology Refinement Module (ATRM) for topology-sensitive structural refinement. Experiments on MAS3K, RMAS, and GBU-UCOD show that the proposed framework improves segmentation quality while keeping the computational overhead limited. The datasets and codes will be released at https://github.com/Wuwenji18/GBU-UCOD .
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 水下伪装目标检测（UCOD）具有挑战性，因为海洋目标在不同海洋深度下通常与其周围环境具有相似的外观。现有方法可能对细长的深海生物产生碎片化预测，并对透明目标的响应较弱。在本文中，我们引入了GBU-UCOD，一个针对海洋垂直分带定制的高分辨率基准，并提出了DeepTopo-Net作为高分辨率UCOD的可行框架。DeepTopo-Net结合了用于退化感知特征感知的水况自适应感知器（WCAP）和用于拓扑敏感结构细化的深渊拓扑细化模块（ATRM）。在MAS3K、RMAS和GBU-UCOD上的实验表明，所提出的框架在保持有限计算开销的同时提高了分割质量。数据集和代码将在https://github.com/Wuwenji18/GBU-UCOD发布。

articles.title_en: Certified robustness with class-conditional randomized smoothing
articles.title_cn: 基于类别条件随机平滑的可认证鲁棒性
articles.abstract_en: We propose a new randomized smoothing-based algorithm for certifiably robust classification. The main motivation for this algorithm comes from a recent observation that neural networks do not fit classes in a uniform way. Furthermore, differences between class-conditional distributions of network activations correlate with empirical performance of smoothed classifiers. This suggests that smoothing-based certification can be improved by accounting for the differences between the classes. Following this observation, we propose to treat the strength of the smoothing noise as a per-class model parameter. We then derive a simple objective to estimate class-specific noise levels and extend the certification procedure to account for the learned noise parameters. The resulting class-conditional randomized smoothing can be easily incorporated into popular smoothing-based robust classifiers, such as CAT-RS and MACER. Extensive experimental evaluation demonstrates that class-conditional smoothing provides a major boost in certification metrics across all evaluated smoothed classifiers. It also outperforms certification algorithms that attempt to adjust the noise level for an already trained classifier. Overall, we improve state-of-the-art certification results on several standard benchmarks by a wide margin.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新的基于随机平滑的算法，用于可认证的鲁棒分类。该算法的主要动机来自于最近的观察，即神经网络并非以统一的方式拟合各个类别。此外，网络激活的类别条件分布之间的差异与平滑分类器的经验性能相关。这表明，通过考虑类别之间的差异，可以改进基于平滑的认证。基于这一观察，我们提出将平滑噪声的强度视为每个类别的模型参数。然后，我们推导出一个简单的目标函数来估计类别特定的噪声水平，并扩展认证程序以考虑学习到的噪声参数。由此产生的类别条件随机平滑可以轻松地整合到流行的基于平滑的鲁棒分类器中，如CAT-RS和MACER。广泛的实验评估表明，类别条件平滑在所有评估的平滑分类器中显著提升了认证指标。它还优于试图为已训练分类器调整噪声水平的认证算法。总体而言，我们在多个标准基准上大幅提升了最先进的认证结果。

articles.title_en: Character recognition on continuous casting slabs via rotated detection and corner regression
articles.title_cn: 基于旋转检测与角点回归的连铸坯字符识别
articles.abstract_en: In the realm of billet production and industrial automation, character recognition poses significant challenges due to complex multi-line arrangements and arbitrary orientations. Although traditional rotation detection methods are capable of detecting tilted targets, they often neglect the full orientation of the objects, which results in misidentification of similar characters and prevents the generation of an accurate reading order for arbitrarily oriented multi-line character sequences. This study proposes a novel and robust approach that integrates rotation detection and corner regression, while further incorporating a differentiable rotation IoU loss to effectively address these issues. By accurately determining the 360° orientation of characters, our method enhances detection and establishes the correct reading order. Experiments on billet and synthetic datasets demonstrate superior recognition accuracy, achieving up to 94.1% on synthetic data, outperforming existing methods. This advancement not only improves management and production efficiency in billet production but also contributes to the broader field of character recognition.
articles.abstract_cn: 在方坯生产和工业自动化领域，字符识别因复杂的多行排列和任意方向而面临重大挑战。尽管传统的旋转检测方法能够检测倾斜目标，但它们往往忽略了物体的完整方向，导致相似字符的误识别，并阻碍了为任意方向的多行字符序列生成准确的阅读顺序。本研究提出了一种新颖且稳健的方法，将旋转检测与角点回归相结合，并进一步引入可微的旋转IoU损失以有效解决这些问题。通过精确确定字符的360°方向，我们的方法增强了检测能力并建立了正确的阅读顺序。在方坯和合成数据集上的实验表明，识别精度优越，在合成数据上达到94.1%，优于现有方法。这一进展不仅提高了方坯生产中的管理和生产效率，也为更广泛的字符识别领域做出了贡献。

articles.abstract_en: Compacted bentonite is known for its low permeability and high contaminant retention capacity and considered as engineered barrier in deep geological repositories (DGRs). In compacted clay, diffusion is the dominant solute and radionuclide transport mechanism, making the determination of accurate diffusion coefficients critical for safety assessment. The diffusion behaviour of HTO, 36Cl−, 35SO42−, and 75SeO32− in compacted bentonite was studied as a function of dry density (1.40 and 1.65 g/cm3) and temperature (25 to 80 °C), addressing the scarcity of experimental diffusion data under variable thermal conditions.Apparent diffusion coefficients (Da) were determined using two experimental methodologies: In-Diffusion for 75SeO32− and 35SO42−, and Instantaneous Planar Source for HTO and 36Cl−. Results indicated that Da increased with temperature and decreased with compaction density, following the order: Da (HTO) > Da (Cl−) > Da (SO42−) > Da (SeO32−).Da values as a function of temperature followed the Arrhenius’ law and the determined activation energies reflects the effective energy barrier for solute transport in the material. For anionic species, Da values were lower than those of HTO due to anion exclusion, more pronounced for divalent (SO42−) than monovalent (Cl−) ones. The lower diffusion of selenite relative to sulfate is attributed to its higher surface reactivity, possibly involving sorption through ternary Ca–surface–SeO3 complexes increasing diffusion energy barriers. These results clarify anion transport in compacted bentonite and provide diffusion and activation energy data across temperatures for DGR performance assessment.
articles.abstract_cn: 压实膨润土以其低渗透性和高污染物截留能力而闻名，被认为是深层地质处置库 (DGR) 中的工程屏障。在压实粘土中，扩散是主要的溶质和放射性核素传输机制，因此确定准确的扩散系数对于安全评估至关重要。研究了 HTO、36Cl−、35SO42− 和 75SeO32− 在压实膨润土中的扩散行为，作为干密度（1.40 和 1.65 g/cm3）和温度（25 至 80 °C）的函数，解决了可变热条件下实验扩散数据的缺乏问题。表观扩散系数 (Da) 使用两个参数确定实验方法：75SeO32− 和 35SO42− 的扩散，HTO 和 36Cl− 的瞬时平面源。结果表明，Da 随温度升高而增大，随压实密度降低，其顺序为：Da (HTO) > Da (Cl−) > Da (SO42−) > Da (SeO32−)。Da 值作为温度的函数遵循阿累尼乌斯定律，确定的活化能反映了材料中溶质传输的有效能垒。对于阴离子物质，由于阴离子排斥，Da 值低于 HTO，二价 (SO42−) 比单价 (Cl−) 更明显。亚硒酸盐相对于硫酸盐的较低扩散归因于其较高的表面反应性，可能涉及通过三元Ca-表面-SeO3络合物的吸附，增加了扩散能垒。这些结果阐明了压实膨润土中的阴离子传输，并为 DGR 性能评估提供了不同温度下的扩散和活化能数据。

articles.title_en: DFANet: Prototype-driven dynamic feature alignment for natural-to-remote-sensing cross-domain few-shot semantic segmentation
articles.title_cn: DFANet：原型驱动的动态特征对齐用于自然到遥感跨域少样本语义分割
articles.abstract_en: Cross-domain few-shot semantic segmentation (CD-FSS) aims to segment novel classes under limited supervision and domain shifts. In this work, we focus on a more challenging yet practically important subtask, namely natural-to-remote-sensing CD-FSS, where knowledge learned from natural-scene data is transferred to diverse remote sensing target domains. Compared with generic unseen-domain transfer, this setting is particularly challenging due to the complex background structures, large scale variations, and substantial imaging discrepancies in remote sensing imagery, which make accurate segmentation in such scenarios difficult. To address these issues, we propose DFANet, a unified framework tailored for natural-to-remote-sensing CD-FSS. We first design a multi-dimensional prototype reconstruction (MPR) module, which refines class prototypes through query-guided attention to enhance prototype discriminability under complex scene structures and ambiguous foreground-background boundaries. We then introduce a dynamic feature alignment (DFA) module to align support and query features from both local spatial structures and global channel statistics, thereby alleviating cross-scene feature mismatches caused by large scale variations and appearance differences. Furthermore, we develop a test-time anchored support finetuning (TASF) strategy, which performs lightweight target-domain adaptation using a few annotated support samples as anchors to further reduce the residual domain discrepancy. On three representative remote sensing datasets, including Deepglobe, Vaihingen, and Potsdam, DFANet achieves average MIoU scores of 40.24%, 47.07%, and 48.95% under 1-shot, 5-shot and 10-shot settings, respectively, outperforming existing CD-FSS methods for natural-to-remote-sensing evaluation. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhangxiaogang-111/DFANet.
articles.abstract_cn: 跨域少样本语义分割（CD-FSS）旨在有限监督和域转移下分割新类别。在这项工作中，我们关注一个更具挑战性且实际重要的子任务，即自然到遥感跨域少样本语义分割，其中从自然场景数据中学到的知识被转移到多样化的遥感目标域。与一般的未见域转移相比，由于遥感图像中复杂的背景结构、大尺度变化和显著的成像差异，这一设置特别具有挑战性，使得在这些场景中的准确分割变得困难。为解决这些问题，我们提出了DFANet，一个专门为自然到遥感CD-FSS设计的统一框架。我们首先设计了一个多维原型重建（MPR）模块，通过查询引导的注意力细化类别原型，以增强在复杂场景结构和模糊前景-背景边界下的原型判别性。然后，我们引入了一个动态特征对齐（DFA）模块，从局部空间结构和全局通道统计两方面对齐支持特征和查询特征，从而缓解由大尺度变化和外观差异引起的跨场景特征不匹配。此外，我们开发了一种测试时锚定支持微调（TASF）策略，使用少量标注的支持样本作为锚点进行轻量级目标域适应，以进一步减少残余域差异。在三个代表性遥感数据集上，包括Deepglobe、Vaihingen和Potsdam，DFANet在1-shot、5-shot和10-shot设置下分别实现了平均MIoU分数40.24%、47.07%和48.95%，优于现有的自然到遥感评估的CD-FSS方法。代码公开于https://github.com/zhangxiaogang-111/DFANet。

articles.title_en: SDiT: Scalable and efficient spiking diffusion transformers for image generation
articles.title_cn: SDiT：用于图像生成的可扩展且高效的脉冲扩散变换器
articles.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have demonstrated potential for energy-efficient computation, but their application to image generation remains limited due to the high training cost and limited scalability. In this work, we propose, to the best of our knowledge, the first scalable training framework for SNN-based diffusion transformers, particularly in terms of temporal efficiency and memory consumption. We design a Spiking Diffusion Transformer (SDiT) with a modular structure that supports scaling up the model size. To address the high memory and time costs caused by multistep spike processing, we introduce a simple and general training method called Multistep Compression and Re-encoding (MCRE), which reduces training overhead by compressing temporal information and decoupling the backward computation. We further propose an Attaching-Scaling Mechanism (ASM) to mitigate the information degradation caused by rate discretization in deep layers. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets show that our method achieves superior image quality and training efficiency compared to existing SNN-based generative models.
articles.abstract_cn: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）已展现出节能计算的潜力，但由于训练成本高和可扩展性有限，其在图像生成中的应用仍然受限。在这项工作中，我们提出了据我们所知首个基于SNN的扩散变换器的可扩展训练框架，特别是在时间效率和内存消耗方面。我们设计了一个具有模块化结构的脉冲扩散变换器（SDiT），支持模型规模的扩展。为了解决多步脉冲处理带来的高内存和时间成本，我们引入了一种简单且通用的训练方法，称为多步压缩与重编码（MCRE），通过压缩时间信息和解耦反向计算来降低训练开销。我们进一步提出了一种附加缩放机制（ASM），以缓解深层中速率离散化引起的信息退化。在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，与现有的基于SNN的生成模型相比，我们的方法在图像质量和训练效率方面均取得了优越的性能。

articles.title_en: Elevated arsenic in topsoils developed on an iron-rich sedimentary formation: From multi-scale spatial patterns to human bioaccessibility
articles.title_cn: 铁质沉积岩发育的表层土壤中砷的升高：从多尺度空间格局到人体生物可给性
articles.abstract_en: Elevated arsenic (As) contents can occur in topsoil underlain by iron-rich sedimentary rocks, sometimes exceeding regulatory quality standards. This poses environmental and land-management concerns and requires accurate delineation of affected areas. However, the mechanisms controlling the spatial variability of topsoil As content remain poorly understood, often leading to overly and costly sampling strategies that hinder effective management. In this study, we investigate the pedogeological processes controlling the spatial distribution of As and other potentially toxic elements (CrNiPbZn) in topsoils formed from the Aubange Formation, Belgium. Total elemental contents were analyzed across the regional, local and plot scales (0.6, 7.9 and 370 samples⋅km−2). Topsoil As contents ranged from 9.7 to 165 mg kg−1, locally exceeding regulatory quality standards. Spatial continuity of AsCrNiPbZn contents was observed at the regional scale but not at the local scale, likely reflecting the effect of long-wave lithospheric uplift and paleoclimatic conditions that promoted lateritic weathering and element reconcentration within Fe oxyhydroxides. At the plot-scale, spatial patterns of AsCrNiPbZn contents are characterized by short-range heterogeneity which we attribute to colluvial redistribution, loess cover variability and differences in parent material weathering intensity. Arsenic enrichment in soil may additionally be influenced by rock porosity during paleoweathering. Incorporation of As into Fe oxyhydroxides reduces As bioaccessibility (from 14% to 3%), suggesting a limited soil–human transfer potential despite high total As contents. Overall, the results highlight the central role of pedogeological processes in controlling natural topsoil As distributions and bioaccessibility, with implications for risk-based soil assessment and management in naturally As-enriched soils.
articles.abstract_cn: 在铁质沉积岩下伏的表层土壤中可能出现砷（As）含量升高，有时超过监管质量标准。这引发了环境和土地管理方面的担忧，需要准确划定受影响区域。然而，控制表层土壤砷含量空间变异性的机制仍知之甚少，常常导致过度且昂贵的采样策略，阻碍有效管理。在本研究中，我们调查了控制比利时Aubange组地层形成的表层土壤中砷及其他潜在有毒元素（CrNiPbZn）空间分布的成土地质过程。在区域、局部和地块尺度（0.6、7.9和370个样品·km−2）分析了总元素含量。表层土壤砷含量范围为9.7至165 mg kg−1，局部超过监管质量标准。砷铬镍铅锌含量的空间连续性在区域尺度上观察到，但在局部尺度上未观察到，这可能反映了长波岩石圈抬升和古气候条件促进了红土风化及元素在铁氧氢氧化物中的再富集效应。在地块尺度上，砷铬镍铅锌含量的空间格局以短程异质性为特征，我们将其归因于坡积再分布、黄土覆盖变异性及母质风化强度的差异。土壤中砷的富集还可能受古风化过程中岩石孔隙度的影响。砷掺入铁氧氢氧化物降低了砷的生物可给性（从14%降至3%），表明尽管总砷含量高，但土壤-人体转移潜力有限。总体而言，结果强调了成土地质过程在控制自然表层土壤砷分布和生物可给性中的核心作用，对自然富砷土壤的风险评估和管理具有意义。

articles.title_en: MobilePupil: An end-to-end binocular fusion framework for event-based eye tracking
articles.title_cn: MobilePupil：一种用于基于事件的眼动追踪的端到端双目融合框架
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Eye tracking is a fundamental technology for next-generation Extended Reality (XR) interactions. However, robustly capturing rapid saccadic dynamics remains challenging due to the prohibitive bandwidth and latency constraints of conventional frame-based sensors. Existing event-based methods tend to prioritize monocular processing paradigms, while giving insufficient attention to the inherent stereoscopic synergy, which makes it challenging to maintain tracking robustness under high-frequency noise and occlusion artifacts. In this paper, we propose MobilePupil, a binocular event-based eye-tracking framework that combines uncertainty-aware fusion with multi-scale feature refinement. The fusion module estimates the reliability of each ocular stream and adaptively balances their contributions, while the refinement module preserves pupil geometry for ellipse regression. Experiments on EV-Eye show improved localization accuracy and robustness under event sparsity and occlusion. Our code is available at https://github.com/aprlost/MobilePupil .
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 眼动追踪是下一代扩展现实（XR）交互的基础技术。然而，由于传统基于帧的传感器在带宽和延迟方面的严格限制，稳健地捕捉快速扫视动态仍然具有挑战性。现有的基于事件的方法倾向于优先考虑单目处理范式，而对固有的立体协同作用关注不足，这使得在高频噪声和遮挡伪影下保持追踪稳健性变得困难。在本文中，我们提出了MobilePupil，一种双目基于事件的眼动追踪框架，结合了不确定性感知融合与多尺度特征细化。融合模块估计每个眼部流（ocular stream）的可靠性并自适应地平衡其贡献，而细化模块保留瞳孔几何形状以进行椭圆回归。在EV-Eye上的实验表明，在事件稀疏性和遮挡条件下，定位精度和稳健性有所提高。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/aprlost/MobilePupil 获取。

articles.title_en: <ce:italic>Vallisneria spiralis</ce:italic> increases the denitrification to DNRA ratio in organic sediments
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors. In organic-rich sediments macrophyte assemblages can exert contrasting effects on bacteria-mediated nitrogen (N) cycle pathways. For instance, their specific impacts on the balance between N dissipation and recycling remain poorly explored. Benthic N cycling was investigated in microcosms containing organic-enriched wetland sediments with and without the submerged macrophyte Vallisneria spiralis . After acclimation, light and dark benthic fluxes, N uptake and microbial N transformations (coupled nitrification-denitrification, potential denitrification and dissimilatory nitrate reduction to ammonium, DNRA) were measured via 15 N-based techniques or calculated. V. spiralis showed successful adaptation and growth, and significantly stimulated N removal via assimilation and coupled nitrification-denitrification, particularly under light. Vegetated sediments displayed up to sevenfold higher daily N retention and loss compared to bare sediments. The presence of V. spiralis shifted nitrate reduction pathways towards denitrification rather than DNRA, increasing the daily integrated denitrification-to-DNRA ratio from 1.6 in bare sediments to 3.5 in vegetated sediments. Permanent N removal over recycling is consistent with the suppression of denitrification inhibitors and lower C:NO 3 - in the rhizosphere than in bare sediments, favouring denitrification over DNRA. Moreover, large N availability in organic sediments softens macrophytes-microbes competition, resulting in simultaneous high plant uptake and N 2 production.

articles.title_en: Postoperative complications after injection laryngoplasty for minor laryngeal clefts
articles.title_cn: 轻微喉裂注射喉成形术后并发症
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Objective: To describe the incidence, clinical presentation, and management of postoperative complications following injection laryngoplasty for minor laryngeal clefts and to assess their impact on postoperative dysphagia evolution. Methods: A unicentric retrospective case-control study of pediatric patients who underwent injection laryngoplasty for minor laryngeal clefts (hyaluronic acid-based injectable or sodium carboxymethylcellulose) between January 2018 and October 2025 in a tertiary pediatric center was conducted. Demographics, comorbidities, intraoperative variables, postoperative dysphagia outcomes, and Penetration-Aspiration Scale scores were analyzed. Ordinal logistic regression was used to evaluate the overall dysphagia trajectory. Results: Among 48 patients, 10 (20.8%) developed postoperative complications. Case and control groups were comparable in age, sex, weight percentiles, gestational age and most comorbidities. Operative duration, injected volume, and intraoperative antibiotic use were similar (all p > 0.2). Swallowing outcomes (resolution, improvement, persistence, or worsening) did not differ between groups. Ordinal logistic regression showed no association between complications and the dysphagia trajectory (Odds ratio, OR 5.1, p = 0.2). PAS severity categories were also similar (p = 0.8). Patients with hyaluronic acid appeared to have more complications (26.5%) compared to methylcellulose (7.1%), despite not reaching statistical significance. Conclusion: Despite a higher-than-expected complication rate, postoperative inflammatory or infectious complications were not linked to worse swallowing function or higher PAS scores. These findings inform risk-benefit discussions and support informed shared decision-making with families regarding minor cleft treatment options.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 目的：描述轻微喉裂注射喉成形术后并发症的发生率、临床表现和处理，并评估其对术后吞咽困难演变的影响。方法：在一家三级儿科中心进行了一项单中心回顾性病例对照研究，纳入2018年一月至2025年十月期间因轻微喉裂接受注射喉成形术（基于透明质酸的可注射物或羧甲基纤维素钠）的儿科患者。分析了人口统计学特征、合并症、术中变量、术后吞咽困难结局和穿透-误吸量表评分。采用有序逻辑回归评估整体吞咽困难轨迹。结果：在48例患者中，10例（20.8%）出现术后并发症。病例组和对照组在年龄、性别、体重百分位数、胎龄和大多数合并症方面具有可比性。手术持续时间、注射量和术中抗生素使用情况相似（均p > 0.2）。吞咽结局（缓解、改善、持续或恶化）在两组间无差异。有序逻辑回归显示并发症与吞咽困难轨迹之间无关联（比值比，OR 5.1，p = 0.2）。PAS严重程度类别也相似（p = 0.8）。使用透明质酸的患者似乎有更多并发症（26.5%），而甲基纤维素组为（7.1%），尽管未达到统计学显著性。结论：尽管并发症发生率高于预期，但术后炎症或感染性并发症与较差的吞咽功能或较高的PAS评分无关。这些发现为风险-获益讨论提供了信息，并支持与家属就轻微喉裂治疗方案进行知情的共同决策。

articles.title_en: CLDA: Co-occurrence-aware low-rank deconfusion with adaptive gating for text-anchored image clustering
articles.title_cn: CLDA：基于共现感知低秩去混淆与自适应门控的文本锚定图像聚类
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Image clustering aims to partition images into semantically coherent groups without supervision. Recent externally guided methods leverage textual priors to overcome the limitations of purely internal supervision. However, they remain susceptible to logits confusion arising from co-occurring categories, which leads to blurred clustering boundaries. This paper proposes CLDA, a novel framework that introduces logits-level deconfusion for text-anchored image clustering. To mitigate cross-category interference, CLDA suppresses off-diagonal logits via low-rank deconfusion, enhanced by co-occurrence-aware priors derived from EMA statistics, and adaptively fuses features with a lightweight gating mechanism. Cross-modal neighborhood consistency and regularization further improve training.
