Extensive experiments demonstrate that CLDA effectively removes spurious signals while preserving semantic structure, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 图像聚类旨在无监督情况下将图像划分为语义连贯的组。近期外部引导方法利用文本先验来克服纯内部监督的局限性。然而，这些方法仍易受共现类别引起的逻辑混淆影响，导致聚类边界模糊。本文提出CLDA，一种新颖框架，为文本锚定图像聚类引入逻辑级别去混淆。为减轻跨类别干扰，CLDA通过低秩去混淆抑制非对角线逻辑，并利用从EMA统计中导出的共现感知先验增强，同时通过轻量级门控机制自适应融合特征。跨模态邻域一致性和正则化进一步改善训练。大量实验表明，CLDA有效去除虚假信号同时保留语义结构，在多个基准上达到最先进性能。

articles.title_en: Effects of secondary hydrothermal fluids on gallium distribution and coordination in hot springs silica using Ga K-edge XANES
articles.title_cn: 二次热液流体对热泉硅华中镓分布及配位的影响——基于Ga K-edge XANES研究
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Gallium (Ga), a critical element in the electronics industry, is enriched in hot spring silica deposits (sinter) at concentrations comparable to, and in some cases greater than, bauxite, coal, and sphalerite deposits from which it is currently extracted. Focusing on well characterized Holocene and Pleistocene New Zealand sinters, we utilize synchrotron-X-ray fluorescence (sXRF) and Ga K-edge X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy to examine the spatial distribution of Ga as well as its changing coordination number. Ga +3 is the only observed oxidation state in the analyzed sinters. Gallium is predominantly found in tetrahedral coordination in sinter deposited from alkali chloride fluids, with analyses best matching Ga-aluminosilicate standards. However, Ga coordination is octahedral in sinter samples that have undergone alteration by acidic fluids/gases, associated with a change in hydrology from alkali-chloride to acid-sulfate fluid conditions. High Ga concentrations are found associated with both these coordination environments, with a heterogeneous distribution. Octahedral Ga is observed both as particles and in larger regions affected by Fe-rich fluid overprinting. The combined use of sXRF and XANES demonstrates an ability to fingerprint diagenesis and alteration in these complex geothermal settings where tetrahedral and octahedral Ga co-exist. The transition from tetrahedral to octahedral Ga also appears to mimic the inferred natural process forming lateritic bauxite deposits, where remobilized tetrahedral Ga is reconcentrated and adsorbed to oxides. A similar process may occur for sinter Ga enrichment, whereby introduced Ga in acidic conditions is adsorbed to oxide phases as the Fe-rich secondary fluids infiltrate porous sinter material.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 镓（Ga）是电子工业中的关键元素，在热泉硅华沉积物（sinter）中富集，其浓度与目前从中提取镓的铝土矿、煤和闪锌矿矿床相当，在某些情况下甚至更高。本研究聚焦于特征明确的新西兰全新世和更新世硅华，利用同步辐射X射线荧光（sXRF）和Ga K-edge X射线吸收近边结构（XANES）光谱，考察镓的空间分布及其配位数变化。在分析的硅华中，Ga +3是唯一观察到的氧化态。在由碱性氯化物流体沉积的硅华中，镓主要以四面体配位存在，分析结果与Ga-铝硅酸盐标准最为匹配。然而，在经历酸性流体/气体蚀变的硅华样品中，镓的配位为八面体，这与水文条件从碱性氯化物向酸性硫酸盐流体的转变相关。高浓度的镓与这两种配位环境均有关联，且分布不均匀。八面体镓既以颗粒形式存在，也出现在受富铁流体叠加影响的较大区域中。sXRF和XANES的联合使用展示了在这些四面体和八面体镓共存的复杂地热环境中识别成岩作用和蚀变的能力。从四面体到八面体镓的转变似乎也模拟了推断的天然红土型铝土矿矿床形成过程，其中再活化的四面体镓被重新富集并吸附到氧化物上。硅华中镓的富集可能发生类似过程，即在酸性条件下引入的镓，随着富铁次生流体渗入多孔硅华材料，被吸附到氧化物相上。

articles.title_en: Deep degassing in the southeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau: Fluid fluxes, sources, and tectonic implications of the Ganzi-Litang suture zone
articles.title_cn: 青藏高原东南缘深部脱气：甘孜-理塘缝合带的流体通量、来源及构造意义
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd The Ganzi-Litang suture zone (GLSZ), a key tectonic boundary in the southeastern Tibetan Plateau, plays a crucial role in understanding plateau uplift and evolution through its deep cycling processes. This study presents a systematic geochemical investigation of gases from 17 hot springs along this suture zone, analyzing He and CO 2 concentrations and isotopic compositions ( 3 He/ 4 He, δ 13 C–CO 2 ) to elucidate deep fluid sources, migration mechanisms, and their tectonic connections. Results show that the 3 He/ 4 He ratios (Rc/Ra) of spring gases range from 0.08 to 0.91, indicating a predominance of crustal radiogenic helium with a minor (1–11%Ra) but significant mantle-derived component, confirming the fault system as an effective conduit for upward migration of mantle volatiles. CO 2 is primarily sourced from metamorphic decarbonation of crustal carbonate rocks and thermal decomposition of organic sediments (combined contribution >98%). The large variation in CO 2 / 3 He ratios (10 7 –10 12 ), negatively correlated with He concentration, reveals preferential degassing of He and subsequent CO 2 consumption via calcite precipitation during hydrothermal ascent. A one-dimensional model reveals a high mantle-derived fluid ascent rate of up to 782.9 mm/y. The 3 He flux (10 3 –10 4 atoms m −2 s −1 ) is significantly higher than that of stable continental blocks, indicating active deep degassing. Temporal variations in gas composition correlate with seismic events, and spatial correlation exists between high 3 He/ 4 He anomalies and deep crustal low-velocity zones. This study reveals profound crust-mantle interaction within the GLSZ, highlighting its role as a key pathway for deep volatile migration, and provides crucial geochemical constraints on the tectonic evolution and crustal dynamics of the southeastern Tibetan Plateau.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 甘孜-理塘缝合带（GLSZ）是青藏高原东南部的一个关键构造边界，通过其深部循环过程在理解高原隆升和演化中起着至关重要的作用。本研究对沿该缝合带的17个温泉气体进行了系统的地球化学调查，分析了He和CO 2浓度及同位素组成（ 3 He/ 4 He，δ 13 C–CO 2 ），以阐明深部流体来源、迁移机制及其构造联系。结果表明，温泉气体的 3 He/ 4 He比值（Rc/Ra）范围从0.08到0.91，表明以地壳放射性成因氦为主，并含有少量（1-11%Ra）但显著的地幔来源组分，证实了断层系统是地幔挥发分向上迁移的有效通道。CO 2 主要来源于地壳碳酸盐岩的变质脱碳作用和有机沉积物的热分解（合计贡献>98%）。CO 2 / 3 He比值（10 7-10 12 ）的大幅变化与He浓度呈负相关，揭示了在热液上升过程中He的优先脱气以及随后通过方解石沉淀消耗CO 2 的过程。一维模型揭示了高达782.9毫米/年的地幔来源流体上升速率。 3 He通量（10 3-10 4 原子米 −2 秒 −1 ）显著高于稳定大陆地块，表明存在活跃的深部脱气作用。气体组成的时间变化与地震事件相关，高 3 He/ 4 He异常与地壳深部低速带之间存在空间相关性。本研究揭示了GLSZ内强烈的壳幔相互作用，强调了其作为深部挥发分迁移关键通道的作用，并为青藏高原东南部的构造演化和地壳动力学提供了重要的地球化学约束。

articles.title_en: Outcomes of single-stage excision in infected preauricular sinus: a retrospective cohort study
articles.title_cn: 感染性耳前瘘管一期切除术的结果：一项回顾性队列研究
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Background: Preauricular sinus is a common congenital malformation that can become infected. The traditional treatment paradigm has been to settle any infection followed by delayed second-stage excision. This has been thought to achieve better post-operative outcomes and lower risk of recurrence. More recently, however, there have been studies reporting similar outcomes with emergency single-stage ‘hot’ excision. There are also few microbiological studies; hence, there is need to elucidate the bacteriology in an Australian population. Method: A 10-year retrospective review of preauricular sinuses treated with surgery by the Otolaryngology department at the Royal Children's Hospital, Melbourne. Results: Seventy-six sinuses were treated with surgical excision. 70.7% of sinuses had been previously infected. Elective excision occurred in 85.5%, while the remaining 14.5% underwent single-stage excision. 36.8% of sinuses were actively infected at the time of excision even though they may have been elective cases. There were two cases of sinus recurrence in elective cases. There was no significant difference in recurrence rates with regards to previous infections, management of infections, active infection at the time of excision nor elective versus emergency single-stage excision. The most common microorganisms were anaerobes, staphylococcus aureus, and upper respiratory tract flora. Multiple organisms were implicated in 77.6% of cases. Conclusion: Traditionally, the treatment paradigm of infected preauricular sinuses has been to settle the infection followed by delayed second-stage excision. This study demonstrates that single-stage excision of actively infected sinuses is a safe and viable treatment option. We suggest the addition of anti-anaerobic antimicrobials in the treatment of infection.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 背景：耳前瘘管是一种常见的先天性畸形，可能发生感染。传统治疗模式是先控制感染，然后进行延迟的二期切除。这被认为可以获得更好的术后效果和更低的复发风险。然而，近期有研究报告称，急诊一期“热”切除也能取得相似的结果。此外，微生物学研究较少；因此，有必要阐明澳大利亚人群中的细菌学特征。方法：对墨尔本皇家儿童医院耳鼻喉科手术治疗的耳前瘘管进行为期10年的回顾性审查。结果：共有七十六个瘘管接受了手术切除。70.7%的瘘管曾有感染史。选择性切除占85.5%，其余14.5%接受了一期切除。36.8%的瘘管在切除时处于活动性感染状态，尽管它们可能是选择性病例。选择性病例中有两例瘘管复发。在既往感染、感染管理、切除时活动性感染以及选择性切除与急诊一期切除方面，复发率无显著差异。最常见的微生物是厌氧菌、金黄色葡萄球菌和上呼吸道菌群。77.6%的病例涉及多种微生物。结论：传统上，感染性耳前瘘管的治疗模式是先控制感染，然后进行延迟的二期切除。本研究表明，对活动性感染的瘘管进行一期切除是一种安全且可行的治疗选择。我们建议在感染治疗中加入抗厌氧菌抗菌药物。

articles.title_en: BiNE-MC: Bipartite network representation learning with multi-order collaborative constrains
articles.title_cn: BiNE-MC：具有多阶协同约束的二分图表示学习
articles.abstract_en: Bipartite graphs are a special type of heterogeneous graph widely used to model the interaction relationships (edges) between two types of entities (nodes). Due to the sparsity of bipartite graph interactions, between heterogeneous nodes, traditional methods fitting direct interactions can hardly mine high-order constraint information among homogeneous nodes, and cannot cover high-order semantic information from implied heterogeneous node interactions, consequently leading to overfitting and locally suboptimal solutions. In this paper, we propose a multi-order collaborative constraint bipartite graph representation learning method called BiNE-MC, which decomposes the bipartite graph interaction structure into the direct interaction constraints between heterogeneous nodes, the high-order similarity constraints between homogeneous nodes, and the high-order collaborative constraints between heterogeneous nodes. BiNE-MC can explore more interaction semantic information of the bipartite graph and achieve more accurate representation learning of the bipartite graph. We conducted extensive experiments on four real datasets for the tasks of link prediction and recommendations. The experimental results illustrate that BiNE-MC outperforms the state-of-the-art bipartite graph representation learning models in all the tasks. Our codes are available at https://github.com/iCandy-Rabbit/BiNE_MC.
articles.abstract_cn: 二分图是一种特殊类型的异质图，广泛用于建模两类实体（节点）之间的交互关系（边）。由于二分图交互的稀疏性，在异质节点之间，传统方法拟合直接交互难以挖掘同质节点之间的高阶约束信息，也无法覆盖隐含异质节点交互中的高阶语义信息，从而导致过拟合和局部次优解。在本文中，我们提出了一种称为BiNE-MC的多阶协同约束二分图表示学习方法，该方法将二分图交互结构分解为异质节点之间的直接交互约束、同质节点之间的高阶相似性约束以及异质节点之间的高阶协同约束。BiNE-MC可以探索二分图更多的交互语义信息，并实现更准确的二分图表示学习。我们在四个真实数据集上进行了广泛实验，用于链接预测和推荐任务。实验结果表明，BiNE-MC在所有任务中均优于最先进的二分图表示学习模型。我们的代码可在https://github.com/iCandy-Rabbit/BiNE_MC获取。

articles.title_en: The unexpected role of conditionality in shaping relational values: Insights from an incentive-based conservation program in Bolivia
articles.title_cn: 条件性在塑造关系价值中的意外作用：来自玻利维亚一项基于激励的保护项目的见解
articles.abstract_en: As global change accelerates, Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES) programs have become increasingly important tools for addressing the interconnected challenges of land degradation, biodiversity loss, water scarcity, and climate change. PES programs provide incentives to individuals or communities, conditional on people adopting sustainable natural resource management practices to support or increase ecosystem service provisioning. Although conditionality is considered a “PES-defining feature,” little is known about how conditionality is perceived by community members and how such perceptions influence their participation in and experience with PES programs. To address this gap, we conducted an extensive qualitative study of Watershared, an incentive-based conservation program in Bolivia, to investigate (1) how community members perceive conditionality in PES and its two components—monitoring and sanction, and (2) how removing conditionality influences PES participants’ perceptions of the program and relationship with the implementing organization. We found that Watershared participants perceived monitoring as more than just a compliance check mechanism; they saw it as a form of technical support and relationship building, which strengthened their relational values toward both nature and the program itself. Participants were generally unconcerned about sanctioning, with many viewing sanctioning as unnecessary or unenforceable, despite the implementing organization having imposed sanctions previously. Watershared participants with unconditional contracts generally noticed the removal of conditionality, with some interpreting it as a lack of care and reciprocity from the implementing organization. These results highlight how relational values were developed and supported through the two components of conditionality in PES. These results suggest that the role of conditionality in PES may be less about surveillance and penalty to ensure conservation, but more about serving as an avenue to activate and strengthen community members’ relational values toward nature and the PES-implementing organization, which may, in turn, improve program effectiveness and future participation. In the face of intensifying global environmental change, such relational values tied to conditionality in PES, as identified in this research, are critical for fostering and sustaining cooperation, trust, and long-term commitment to conservation.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着全球变化的加速，生态系统服务付费（PES）项目已成为应对土地退化、生物多样性丧失、水资源短缺和气候变化等相互关联挑战的日益重要的工具。PES项目向个人或社区提供激励，条件是采用可持续的自然资源管理实践，以支持或增加生态系统服务的供给。尽管条件性被认为是“PES的定义性特征”，但关于社区成员如何看待条件性以及这些看法如何影响他们参与PES项目及其体验，知之甚少。为弥补这一空白，我们对玻利维亚的Watershared（一个基于激励的保护项目）进行了广泛的定性研究，以调查（1）社区成员如何感知PES中的条件性及其两个组成部分——监测和制裁，以及（2）移除条件性如何影响PES参与者对项目的看法及与实施组织的关系。我们发现，Watershared参与者将监测视为不仅仅是合规检查机制；他们将其视为一种技术支持和关系建设形式，这增强了他们对自然和项目本身的关系价值。参与者普遍不关心制裁，许多人认为制裁是不必要或无法执行的，尽管实施组织此前曾施加过制裁。拥有无条件合同的Watershared参与者通常注意到条件性的移除，一些人将其解释为实施组织缺乏关怀和互惠。这些结果突显了关系价值如何通过PES中条件性的两个组成部分得以发展和支持。这些结果表明，PES中条件性的作用可能较少关乎确保保护的监督和惩罚，而更多是作为激活和加强社区成员对自然及PES实施组织的关系价值的途径，这可能进而提高项目有效性和未来参与度。面对日益加剧的全球环境变化，本研究所识别的与PES中条件性相关的关系价值，对于促进和维持合作、信任及对保护的长期承诺至关重要。

articles.title_en: Multi-component soil gas geochemical exploration for deep mineral deposits: A case study from Anhui, Eastern China
articles.title_cn: 深部矿床多组分土壤气体地球化学勘查：以中国东部安徽为例
articles.abstract_en: Significant mineral exploration potential exists within the metallogenic belts concealed beneath extensive surface cover in Anhui region, Eastern China. However, mineral exploration in this region is challenged by thick overburden, which limits the effective integration of conventional exploration methods. To address these challenges, a novel, efficient, and cost-effective soil-gas geochemical prospecting approach was evaluated using a Portable Multi-Component Gas Rapid Analyzer (PMGRA) at several representative deposits, including the Hekou Au–Pb, the Jiangshan Au–Pb–Zn, the Zhongjiashan Pb–Zn (Au–Ag), and the Dongsunjia Cu deposits.Soil-gas measurements indicate that the enrichment coefficients of H2S (0.9-9.4) and SO2 (0.8-7.4), together with the newly introduced gases H2 (1.0-22.8) and CS2 (0.5-17.9), are consistently elevated above concealed sulfide mineralization. Their spatial distributions are strongly controlled by orebody geometry. CO2 anomalies predominantly reflect subsurface fault systems, and the spatial coincidence of CO2 anomalies with H2 and sulfur-bearing gas anomalies represents a reliable criterion for identifying ore-bearing structures. Certain segments within the non-mineralized zones of the exploration-line profiles across the Hekou Au–Pb, Jiangshan Au–Pb–Zn, and Zhongjiashan Pb–Zn (Au–Ag) deposits exhibit pronounced anomalies of H2S, SO2, CS2, and H2. These observations indicate that the exploration area retains substantial prospecting potential and suggest the possible presence of additional concealed ore bodies or previously unrecognized mineralized zones. Further detailed investigations are therefore required to verify and delineate these prospective targets. H2S, SO2, CS2, and H2 are the most effective and sensitive pathfinders for the Dongsunjia Cu deposit compared to the other Au–Pb–Zn–Ag deposits. Overall, soil-gas analysis of H2S, SO2, H2, CS2, and CO2 using PMGRA is effective for detecting deep-buried sulfide orebodies in covered terrains and provides a practical approach for mineral exploration.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国东部安徽地区被广泛地表覆盖的成矿带内存在显著的矿产勘查潜力。然而，该地区的矿产勘查受到厚覆盖层的挑战，限制了常规勘查方法的有效整合。为解决这些问题，本研究使用便携式多组分气体快速分析仪（PMGRA）在若干代表性矿床（包括河口Au–Pb、江山Au–Pb–Zn、钟家山Pb–Zn（Au–Ag）和东孙家Cu矿床）评估了一种新颖、高效且经济有效的土壤气体地球化学勘查方法。土壤气体测量表明，H2S（0.9-9.4）和SO2（0.8-7.4）的富集系数，以及新引入的气体H2（1.0-22.8）和CS2（0.5-17.9），在隐伏硫化物矿化上方持续升高。其空间分布受矿体几何形态的强烈控制。CO2异常主要反映地下断裂系统，CO2异常与H2和含硫气体异常的空间重合是识别含矿构造的可靠标准。在跨越河口Au–Pb、江山Au–Pb–Zn和钟家山Pb–Zn（Au–Ag）矿床的勘探线剖面中，非矿化带的某些区段表现出H2S、SO2、CS2和H2的显著异常。这些观测结果表明，勘查区仍保有相当大的找矿潜力，并暗示可能存在其他隐伏矿体或先前未识别的矿化带。因此，需要进一步的详细调查来验证和圈定这些远景靶区。与其他Au–Pb–Zn–Ag矿床相比，H2S、SO2、CS2和H2是东孙家Cu矿床最有效和灵敏的指示元素。总体而言，使用PMGRA对H2S、SO2、H2、CS2和CO2进行土壤气体分析，对于在覆盖区探测深埋硫化物矿体是有效的，并为矿产勘查提供了一种实用方法。

articles.title_en: Molecular and macroscopic insights into hydrocarbon contamination removal from minerals using maple-derived saponin with focus on hydrocarbon chemistry and mineral type
articles.title_cn: 基于枫树皂苷的烃类污染物从矿物中去除的分子与宏观机制研究：聚焦烃化学与矿物类型
articles.abstract_en: This study introduces a novel saponin derived from municipally-collected maple leaves for effective hydrocarbon contaminant separation from polluted minerals that are common soil components. To gain in-depth mechanistic insight, four hydrocarbons of crude oil, asphaltene, stearic acid, and paraffin, were used to simulate the removal of various contaminants from pure silica (quartz) and calcium carbonate (calcite) minerals. The contaminating hydrocarbons were characterized using FTIR and NMR spectroscopy to elucidate their chemical composition and molecular structure. 1H NMR and FTIR analyses revealed that the maple-derived saponin is predominantly composed of glycosides and carbohydrates. To investigate both the macroscopic and molecular mechanisms of contaminant removal, static removal tests, hydrocarbon solubility measurements, FTIR analysis, saponin adsorption studies, and contact angle measurements were performed. The maple-derived saponin demonstrated substantial efficacy, removing 71-88% of hydrocarbons within 24 h at 25 °C during static separation tests. Hydrocarbon removal was higher from silica than from calcium carbonate, indicating stronger intermolecular attractions with the latter. FTIR analysis revealed selective trends in contaminating compound desorption, with asphaltenes from calcium carbonate showing higher polarity, higher aromaticity, and longer aliphatic chains. Contact angle measurements showed the saponin's effectiveness in improving the substrate hydrophilicity across mineral and hydrocarbon types. The highest wettability improvement was observed in stearic acid-contaminated silica (109.92%), and the lowest was in paraffin-contaminated silica (24.87%). This study demonstrates the viability of a cost-effective, maple-derived saponin for removing petroleum contaminants from diverse mineral substrates, holding promise for soil preservation, particularly in cold climates where maple forests are abundant.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究引入了一种从市政收集的枫叶中提取的新型皂苷，用于有效分离常见土壤组分矿物中的烃类污染物。为深入理解机理，使用原油、沥青质、硬脂酸和石蜡四种烃类模拟从纯硅石（石英）和碳酸钙（方解石）矿物中去除各种污染物。通过FTIR和NMR光谱对污染烃类进行表征，以阐明其化学组成和分子结构。1H NMR和FTIR分析表明，枫叶来源的皂苷主要由糖苷和碳水化合物组成。为研究污染物去除的宏观和分子机制，进行了静态去除试验、烃溶解度测量、FTIR分析、皂苷吸附研究和接触角测量。枫叶来源的皂苷表现出显著效果，在静态分离试验中，24小时内、25°C条件下去除了71-88%的烃类。从硅石中去除的烃类多于碳酸钙，表明后者存在更强的分子间吸引力。FTIR分析揭示了污染化合物解吸的选择性趋势，其中碳酸钙中的沥青质显示出更高的极性、更高的芳香性和更长的脂肪链。接触角测量显示，皂苷在改善不同矿物和烃类类型底物的亲水性方面有效。润湿性改善最高出现在硬脂酸污染的硅石中（109.92%），最低出现在石蜡污染的硅石中（24.87%）。本研究证明了枫叶来源的皂苷作为一种经济有效的方案，用于从多种矿物底物中去除石油污染物，对土壤保护具有前景，尤其是在枫林丰富的寒冷气候地区。

articles.title_en: Visual token compression via run-length pruning in multimodal large language models
articles.title_cn: 多模态大语言模型中的视觉令牌压缩：基于游程剪枝的方法
articles.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have extended their capabilities from static images to video understanding. However, representing videos as frame-level token sequences introduces substantial computational overhead, making token compression important for efficient reasoning. In this work, we propose Run-Length Pruning (RLP), a training-free method for reducing temporal redundancy in video-language modeling. RLP identifies and prunes visual tokens with limited variation across consecutive frames. To better preserve essential semantics under aggressive pruning, we further introduce a token distillation mechanism that selectively restores informative tokens based on semantic similarity. By producing compact yet informative video representations, RLP significantly improves inference efficiency while maintaining, and in some cases slightly improving, task accuracy. Extensive experiments on multiple video-language benchmarks show that RLP achieves competitive performance while reducing the number of visual tokens by up to 80% and accelerating prefill latency by up to 2.5 × . These results suggest that improving token quality, rather than simply increasing token quantity, is an effective direction for efficient video-language understanding.
articles.abstract_cn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的最新进展已将其能力从静态图像扩展到视频理解。然而，将视频表示为帧级令牌序列会引入大量的计算开销，使得令牌压缩对于高效推理变得重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了游程剪枝（RLP），一种无需训练的方法，用于减少视频语言建模中的时间冗余。RLP识别并剪除在连续帧间变化有限的视觉令牌。为了在激进剪枝下更好地保留关键语义，我们进一步引入了一种令牌蒸馏机制，该机制基于语义相似性选择性地恢复信息丰富的令牌。通过生成紧凑而信息丰富的视频表示，RLP显著提高了推理效率，同时保持，在某些情况下甚至略微提升，任务准确性。在多个视频语言基准上的广泛实验表明，RLP在减少视觉令牌数量高达80%并将预填充延迟加速高达2.5倍的同时，实现了具有竞争力的性能。这些结果表明，提高令牌质量，而非简单增加令牌数量，是高效视频语言理解的有效方向。

articles.title_en: Geochemical divergence of oxygen and sulfur compounds in high-maturity bitumen: Implications for thermal maturity assessment
articles.title_cn: 高成熟沥青中氧、硫化合物的地球化学分异：对热成熟度评价的启示
articles.abstract_en: Bitumen contains abundant nitrogen-, sulfur-, and oxygen-bearing (NSO) compounds whose molecular structures record critical geological information. To enhance the evaluation of high-to over-mature stages rock or sediment samples, due to the highly thermal destruction of molecular biomarkers, this study analyzes high-maturity bitumen from the Tarim Basin, China. The molecular geochemical results reveal that the evolution of organic matter at high-maturity stages is dominated by thermal cracking, ring-opening, and hydrogenation reactions. This process leads to a reversal in the molecular distribution trends of oxygen-containing compounds compared to those observed at low-to medium-maturity stages: complex “precursor” molecules with high double bond equivalents (DBE) and high carbon numbers are consumed, while simpler “product” molecules with low DBE and low carbon numbers become relatively enriched. In contrast, aromatic sulfur compounds (S1class) exhibit no significant differences in their DBE distribution patterns across samples of varying maturity due to their higher thermal stability. This suggests that they may exist in a “dynamic equilibrium” between condensation and cracking, which diminishes their utility as maturity indicators. Based on these systematic evolutionary patterns, this study proposed a series of novel maturity parameters i.e., the DBE1-5O2/DBE8-15O2 and C6-23DBE0-21O/C24-45DBE0-21O ratios. These novel parameters demonstrate excellent linear correlations with aromatic maturity parameters based on alkylphenanthrene, alkylnaphthalene, etc., whose effectiveness has been extensively validated, and can serve as effective complementary tools for the evaluation of high-to over-mature source rocks and crude oils, providing new molecular geochemical approaches for deep hydrocarbon exploration.
articles.abstract_cn: 沥青中含有丰富的含氮、含硫和含氧（NSO）化合物，其分子结构记录了关键的地质信息。为了加强对高成熟至过成熟阶段岩石或沉积物样品的评价，由于分子生物标志物遭受强烈的热破坏，本研究分析了中国塔里木盆地的高成熟沥青。分子地球化学结果表明，高成熟阶段有机质的演化以热裂解、开环和加氢反应为主。这一过程导致含氧化合物的分子分布趋势与低至中成熟阶段观察到的趋势相反：具有高双键当量（DBE）和高碳数的复杂“前体”分子被消耗，而具有低DBE和低碳数的较简单“产物”分子相对富集。相比之下，芳香族含硫化合物（S1类）在不同成熟度样品的DBE分布模式上没有显著差异，这归因于其较高的热稳定性。这表明它们可能存在于缩合与裂解之间的“动态平衡”中，从而削弱了其作为成熟度指标的有效性。基于这些系统的演化模式，本研究提出了一系列新的成熟度参数，即DBE1-5O2/DBE8-15O2和C6-23DBE0-21O/C24-45DBE0-21O比值。这些新参数与基于烷基菲、烷基萘等的芳香族成熟度参数表现出优异的线性相关性，后者的有效性已得到广泛验证，可作为高成熟至过成熟烃源岩和原油评价的有效补充工具，为深层油气勘探提供新的分子地球化学方法。

articles.title_en: Percutaneous contralateral vocal fold lateralization in pediatric bilateral vocal fold paralysis
articles.title_cn: 经皮对侧声带外侧化术治疗儿童双侧声带麻痹
articles.abstract_en: ObjectiveTo describe a percutaneous contralateral vocal fold lateralization as an endoscopic technical modification procedure originally described by Lichtenberger for the management of pediatric bilateral vocal fold paralysis (BVFP), employing readily available materials, and to evaluate clinical outcomes in a public tertiary referral center. MethodsThis longitudinal observational case series included nine pediatric patients diagnosed with BVFP who had previously undergone tracheostomy and were managed at a tertiary university hospital in Central-West Brazil. Endoscopic vocal fold lateralization was performed using a 16-gauge peripheral intravenous catheter (Abocath®) as a substitute for the conventional Lichtenberger endo-extralaryngeal needle carrier. All procedures were conducted under general anesthesia with suspension laryngoscopy and endoscopic guidance. Postoperative primary outcome included respiratory status following decannulation over a minimum follow-up of six months, and secondary outcomes: phonatory quality, swallowing function, evidence of aspiration and other complications. ResultsThe mean age at surgery was 4 years. The predominant etiology was idiopathic (7 cases), one neurologic and other cardiac causes. All patients achieved successful decannulation (100%). Transient postoperative dysphonia was observed in all cases. No major complications, including aspiration pneumonia or lower airway infections, were documented. Two patients required revision surgery, one with contralateral and other ipsilateral lateralization. Adequate glottic airway patency was achieved in all cases, with preservation of swallowing function and satisfactory phonatory outcomes. ConclusionThe proposed adaptation of the Lichtenberger vocal fold lateralization technique using a 16-gauge intravenous catheter is a safe, effective, and reproducible alternative for pediatric patients with BVFP. This low-cost modification facilitates successful decannulation while preserving laryngeal function, representing a valuable strategy in resource-limited settings and supporting vocal fold lateralization as a first-line surgical option in tracheostomized children with BVFP.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的：描述一种经皮对侧声带外侧化术，作为Lichtenberger最初描述的内镜技术改良方法，用于治疗儿童双侧声带麻痹（BVFP），采用易获得的材料，并在公共三级转诊中心评估临床结局。方法：本纵向观察性病例系列纳入九名诊断为BVFP的儿科患者，这些患者此前已接受气管切开术，并在巴西中西部一所三级大学医院接受管理。使用16号外周静脉导管（Abocath®）替代传统的Lichtenberger内镜-喉外针持器进行内镜下声带外侧化术。所有手术均在全身麻醉下，通过悬吊喉镜和内镜引导进行。术后主要结局指标包括拔管后至少六个月的呼吸状态，次要结局指标包括发声质量、吞咽功能、误吸证据及其他并发症。结果：手术时平均年龄为4岁。主要病因为特发性（7例），一例为神经性，其他为心脏原因。所有患者均成功拔管（100%）。所有病例均观察到短暂性术后发声困难。未记录到重大并发症，包括误吸性肺炎或下呼吸道感染。两名患者需要翻修手术，一例为对侧外侧化，另一例为同侧外侧化。所有病例均达到足够的声门气道通畅性，吞咽功能得以保留，发声结局满意。结论：使用16号静脉导管的Lichtenberger声带外侧化术改良方法，对于BVFP儿科患者是一种安全、有效且可重复的替代方案。这种低成本改良有助于成功拔管，同时保留喉功能，在资源有限的环境中代表了一种有价值的策略，并支持声带外侧化术作为气管切开的BVFP儿童的一线手术选择。

articles.title_en: Scalable and expressive physics-informed neural networks via functional tensor decomposition
articles.title_cn: 基于函数张量分解的可扩展且富有表现力的物理信息神经网络
articles.abstract_en: Copyright © 2026. Published by Elsevier B.V. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a promising framework for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding physical laws into neural network training. In our prior work, we introduced Functional Tensor Decomposition PINNs (FTD-PINNs), which leverage tensor decomposition to improve the scalability and efficiency of PINNs, especially for high-dimensional PDEs. This work extends our previous study on Functional Tensor Decomposition PINNs by systematically examining how decomposition structure and backend activations affect performance, efficiency, and stability across representative partial differential equations. Using Helmholtz and Klein-Gordon systems as benchmarks, we compare three decomposition modes (CP, Tucker, Tensor-Train) combined with four activation backends (Tanh, Tanh + PE, SIREN, and WIRE). Multi-seed and compute-aware evaluations reveal consistent accuracy-efficiency trade-offs: Tensor-Train provides the most balanced decomposition, while frequency-aware backends such as WIRE and SIREN improve convergence for oscillatory regimes. Pareto analyses across rank and collocation density highlight a clear inflection point of diminishing returns and show that backend choice shifts the optimal configuration across PDE types. Together, these results extend the original FTD-PINN framework with a broader empirical foundation and provide practical guidance for selecting decomposition ranks, collocation densities, and backend activations for efficient PINN design.
articles.abstract_cn: 版权所有 © 2026。由Elsevier B.V.出版。物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通过将物理定律嵌入神经网络训练中，为求解偏微分方程（PDEs）提供了一个有前景的框架。在我们先前的工作中，我们引入了函数张量分解PINNs（FTD-PINNs），利用张量分解来提高PINNs的可扩展性和效率，特别是对于高维PDEs。本研究通过系统地考察分解结构和后端激活函数如何影响代表性偏微分方程的性能、效率和稳定性，扩展了我们先前关于函数张量分解PINNs的研究。以亥姆霍兹和克莱因-戈登系统为基准，我们比较了三种分解模式（CP、Tucker、张量列）与四种激活后端（Tanh、Tanh + PE、SIREN和WIRE）的组合。多种子和计算感知评估揭示了一致的精度-效率权衡：张量列提供了最平衡的分解，而频率感知后端如WIRE和SIREN改善了振荡区域的收敛性。跨秩和配置密度的帕累托分析突显了收益递减的明显拐点，并表明后端选择改变了不同PDE类型的最优配置。总之，这些结果以更广泛的实证基础扩展了原始FTD-PINN框架，并为选择分解秩、配置密度和后端激活以进行高效PINN设计提供了实用指导。

articles.title_en: The politician, the press and the public: How politicians’ perceptions of the media shape UK aid allocations
articles.title_cn: 政治家、媒体与公众：政治家对媒体的认知如何影响英国援助分配
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors This paper examines politicians’ attitudes and beliefs about the press, their potential role in shaping aid policy and how these views differ from the public's. We address these questions using survey data from 107 UK MPs and 2047 members of the UK public. We find a positive association between MPs’ beliefs that the news media influence public opinion, reflect public opinion, and are central to a political career—and a belief that the news media should influence aid policy. This suggests that politicians’ attitudes and beliefs about the media can play a role in shaping aid policy. We also find that MPs are significantly more likely to think that the media influences public attitudes towards aid spending than the public. This suggests that politicians could potentially be overweighing news coverage when making decisions about aid spending. Overall, these findings help fill an important gap in our understanding of what happens ‘upstream’ of aid allocations and add further nuance to our understanding of the media's political effects.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者。本文考察了政治家对新闻界的态度和信念、它们在塑造援助政策中的潜在作用，以及这些观点与公众观点的差异。我们利用来自107名英国议员和2047名英国公众成员的调查数据来探讨这些问题。我们发现，议员们认为新闻媒体影响公众舆论、反映公众舆论，并且对政治生涯至关重要——这与他们认为新闻媒体应影响援助政策的信念之间存在正相关关系。这表明，政治家对媒体的态度和信念可以在塑造援助政策中发挥作用。我们还发现，议员们比公众更有可能认为媒体影响公众对援助支出的态度。这表明，政治家在做出援助支出决策时可能过度重视新闻报道。总体而言，这些发现有助于填补我们对援助分配‘上游’过程理解中的一个重要空白，并为我们理解媒体的政治效应增添了进一步的细微差别。

articles.title_en: HollowNet: Real-time drogue detection and pose estimation via embedded vision for robust autonomous aerial refueling
articles.title_cn: HollowNet：基于嵌入式视觉的实时锥套检测与姿态估计，用于稳健的自主空中加油
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Nowadays, unmanned aerial vehicles have a significant impact on the low-altitude economy and national defense. Autonomous aerial refueling (AAR) is a critical technology to extend drone endurance and enhance combat capabilities. However, existing methods mainly rely on two-stage frameworks. These suffer from computational redundancy and limited robustness under dynamic aerial conditions. In this paper, we propose HollowNet, a real-time embedded vision network for end-to-end drogue detection and pose estimation in AAR. The network integrates a single-stage detector with a decoupled head to simultaneously predict bounding boxes and LED keypoints on the drogue. We further optimize the object keypoint similarity loss by incorporating geometric constraints of the drogue target. A unified drogue positioning system, combining detection and pose estimation, is introduced to output precise docking coordinates. The feasibility of our system is validated on an aerial refueling virtual simulation platform, and on an RK3588-based embedded system it achieves 50 FPS, enabling real-time performance. It attains an mAP50–95 of 82.11% on real AAR datasets, delivering the best speed-accuracy balance among all benchmarks.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 如今，无人机对低空经济和国防具有重大影响。自主空中加油（AAR）是延长无人机续航时间和增强作战能力的关键技术。然而，现有方法主要依赖于两阶段框架。这些方法在动态空中条件下存在计算冗余和鲁棒性有限的问题。在本文中，我们提出了HollowNet，一种用于AAR中端到端锥套检测和姿态估计的实时嵌入式视觉网络。该网络集成了单阶段检测器与解耦头，以同时预测锥套上的边界框和LED关键点。我们通过结合锥套目标的几何约束进一步优化了目标关键点相似性损失。引入了一个统一的锥套定位系统，结合检测和姿态估计，以输出精确的对接坐标。我们的系统在空中加油虚拟仿真平台上进行了验证，在基于RK3588的嵌入式系统上实现了50 FPS，实现了实时性能。在真实AAR数据集上达到了mAP50–95的82.11%，在所有基准测试中提供了最佳的速度-精度平衡。

articles.title_en: Meromictic stratification and geochemical gradients in a flooded abandoned apatite and mica mine (Quebec, Canada)
articles.title_cn: 废弃磷灰石和云母矿淹没后的分层混合与地球化学梯度（加拿大魁北克）
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Mining resources are important in Canada, which has led to many abandoned mines prior to the 1991 mining regulations. Flooded mines that do not pose immediate risks to the environment or human health remain understudied. This study investigates the hydrochemistry and density stratification of a flooded apatite and mica mine (an open pit lake connected to underground levels) in Quebec, focusing on depth-dependent gradients and seasonal variations. Vertical profiling revealed a meromictic structure consisting of three layers: an oxic mixolimnion extending to a depth of 8 – 9 m, a transition zone characterized by a thermocline and chemocline, and a permanently anoxic monimolimnion below 11 m. Seasonal variations were confined to the mixolimnion, whereas deeper water remained chemically and physically stable throughout the sampling period, from early May to the end of October. Stable water isotope data further support the stratification, with shallow samples showing evaporation, deep samples aligning with the Local Meteoric Water Line (LMWL), and very few intermediate data points. The open-pit morphometry, the steep slopes surrounding the lake, and density differences were very likely responsible for the development of meromixis. δ 34 S–SO 4 values indicate active microbial sulfate reduction in the chemocline and the anoxic monimolimnion, while the precipitation of carbonates and metal sulfides control the chemistry of the monimolimnion. Phosphorus and nitrogen accumulated in the mixolimnion following the establishment of stable water column stratification. These findings identify the Blackburn Mine as a valuable model for investigating hydrochemical and biogeochemical processes in flooded mica and apatite mines, and for improving our understanding of density and thermal stratification in subsurface aquatic environments.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 矿产资源在加拿大具有重要意义，这导致在1991年采矿法规出台之前有许多废弃矿山。不对环境或人类健康构成直接风险的淹没矿山仍未得到充分研究。本研究调查了魁北克一处淹没的磷灰石和云母矿（一个与地下水平相连的露天坑湖）的水化学和密度分层，重点关注深度梯度和季节变化。垂直剖面显示了一种分层混合结构，由三层组成：延伸到8-9米深度的含氧混合层、以温跃层和化学跃层为特征的过渡带，以及11米以下永久缺氧的底部滞水层。季节变化仅限于混合层，而更深的水体在从五月初到十月底的整个采样期间保持化学和物理稳定。稳定水同位素数据进一步支持了分层，浅层样本显示蒸发，深层样本与当地大气降水线（LMWL）一致，中间数据点很少。露天坑的形态、湖泊周围的陡坡以及密度差异很可能是分层混合形成的原因。δ 34 S–SO 4 值表明在化学跃层和缺氧底部滞水层中存在活跃的微生物硫酸盐还原，而碳酸盐和金属硫化物的沉淀控制了底部滞水层的化学性质。在稳定水体分层建立后，磷和氮在混合层中积累。这些发现将布莱克本矿确定为研究淹没云母和磷灰石矿中水化学和生物地球化学过程，以及提高我们对地下水生环境中密度和热分层理解的宝贵模型。

articles.title_en: Latent preference mining and noise-aware for multimodal recommendation
articles.title_cn: 面向多模态推荐的潜在偏好挖掘与噪声感知
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. With the rapid advancement of the information age, multimodal data has become increasingly crucial in recommendation systems. However, current multimodal recommendation algorithms still face two fundamental challenges: (1) ineffectively balancing the trade-off between information gain and noise interference introduced by multimodal data; and (2) difficulty in enhancing model generalization under data-constrained conditions. To address these issues, we propose LMNM-a L atent preference mining and M ultimodal N oise-aware method for M ultimodal recommendation. Specifically, we integrate mined latent user preferences as implicit feedback into the user-item bipartite graph, while leveraging explicit feedback to enhance and optimize the item-relation graph. Furthermore, we design a multi-channel noise-aware encoder equipped with semantic filters to effectively suppress multimodal noise, and incorporate stochastic perturbations during optimization to improve model generalizability. Extensive experiments on three real-world public datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed model. Code: https://github.com/YijieZhu-e/LMNM
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 随着信息时代的快速发展，多模态数据在推荐系统中变得越来越重要。然而，当前的多模态推荐算法仍面临两个基本挑战：（1）无法有效平衡多模态数据带来的信息增益与噪声干扰之间的权衡；（2）在数据受限条件下难以增强模型泛化能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出了LMNM——一种用于多模态推荐的潜在偏好挖掘与多模态噪声感知方法。具体而言，我们将挖掘出的潜在用户偏好作为隐式反馈整合到用户-项目二部图中，同时利用显式反馈来增强和优化项目关系图。此外，我们设计了一个配备语义滤波器的多通道噪声感知编码器，以有效抑制多模态噪声，并在优化过程中引入随机扰动以提高模型泛化能力。在三个真实世界公开数据集上的大量实验证明了我们提出模型的有效性。代码：https://github.com/YijieZhu-e/LMNM

articles.title_en: Hospital allocation and politicians: Evidence from Malaysia
articles.title_cn: 医院分配与政治家：来自马来西亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd Equitable access to healthcare requires efficient allocation of health infrastructure, yet politics may distort these decisions. This paper studies how politicians distort public hospital allocations in postcolonial Malaysia from 1959 to 2013. Malaysia first allocates hospital funding to districts, then selects specific locations within funded districts for construction. Using six decades of data on hospital construction and elections, I find that constituencies represented by deputy ministers are significantly more likely to receive new hospitals, but only at the location selection stage within districts. District-level funding decisions effectively direct resources to districts far from existing hospitals. I provide suggestive evidence that measurable guidelines for funding decisions exist but not for construction site selection. These results suggest that defining clear guidelines in hospital allocation can limit political distortions.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 公平获取医疗服务需要高效的卫生基础设施分配，然而政治可能会扭曲这些决策。本文研究了在1959年至2013年间，政治家如何扭曲马来西亚后殖民时期的公立医院分配。马来西亚首先将医院资金分配给各地区，然后在获得资金的地区内选择具体建设地点。利用六十年间医院建设和选举的数据，我发现由副部长代表的选区显著更有可能获得新医院，但这仅发生在地区内的选址阶段。地区层面的资金分配决策有效地将资源引导至远离现有医院的地区。我提供了暗示性证据表明，资金分配决策存在可衡量的指导方针，但建设选址则没有。这些结果表明，在医院分配中明确清晰的指导方针可以限制政治扭曲。

articles.title_en: Definition of regional background values of trace element in soils of Castilla-La Mancha region, Spain
articles.title_cn: 西班牙卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰地区土壤微量元素区域背景值的定义
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors The present study defines geochemical threshold values (GTV) and background values (GBV), in addition to analysing of the spatial distribution of major and trace elements in uncontaminated soils in the Castilla-La Mancha (CLM) region (Spain). A total of 869 samples were analysed from the entire region by X-Ray Fluorescence to determine the presence of Ti, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, As, Rb, Sr, Zr, and Pb. A principal components analysis (PCA) was performed in conjunction with the observation of the regional lithology. This process resulted in the delineation of seven geochemical zones. The calculation of GTVs was undertaken using different approaches for the complete dataset and by geochemical zones (percentile-based techniques (p95 and p98); Tukey's inner fences (TIF); median+2xmedian absolute deviation (mMAD); and cumulative probability plot (CP)). The results obtained from the CP plot are considered the most robust for defining the GTVs of CLM, because of the capacity to observe subpopulations and conduct a lithological comparison of potential geochemical anomalies. In order to calculate the GBVs, outliers above the GTVs were eliminated to create geochemical interpolated maps for CLM. These maps and values were then used to make comparisons with regional, national and European references levels. The results obtained indicate significant enrichment of Ti, Mn, Fe, Zn, Zr and Pb, suggesting an association with metallogenetic districts. Elevated Rb values were identified within the granitic units, whereas Cr and Ni are strongly associated with the Campo de Calatrava volcanic field. In contrast, the Cenozoic gypsum-rich evaporitic deposits are characterised by Sr enrichment. This research enhances the existing GTV and GBV forms for CLM, providing a robust foundation for future studies in the domain of soil investigation, environmental management and land use.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者除了分析卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰 (CLM) 地区（西班牙）未污染土壤中主要元素和微量元素的空间分布之外，本研究还定义了地球化学阈值 (GTV) 和背景值 (GBV)。通过 X 射线荧光分析了整个区域的总共 869 个样品，以确定 Ti、Cr、Mn、Fe、Ni、Cu、Zn、As、Rb、Sr、Zr 和 Pb 的存在。主成分分析（PCA）与区域岩性观察结合进行。这一过程划定了七个地球化学区域。 GTV 的计算是使用不同的方法对完整数据集和地球化学区域进行的（基于百分位数的技术（p95 和 p98）；Tukey 内栅 (TIF)；中值+2x中值绝对偏差 (mMAD)；和累积概率图 (CP)）。从 CP 图获得的结果被认为是定义 CLM 的 GTV 的最可靠的结果，因为它能够观察亚群并对潜在的地球化学异常进行岩性比较。为了计算 GBV，消除了 GTV 之上的异常值，以创建 CLM 地球化学插值图。然后使用这些地图和数值与地区、国家和欧洲的参考水平进行比较。获得的结果表明 Ti、Mn、Fe、Zn、Zr 和 Pb 显着富集，表明与成矿区有关。在花岗岩单元内发现 Rb 值升高，而 Cr 和 Ni 与 Campo de Calatrava 火山田密切相关。相比之下，新生代富石膏蒸发岩矿床则以Sr富集为特征。这项研究增强了 CLM 现有的 GTV 和 GBV 形式，为土壤调查、环境管理和土地利用领域的未来研究奠定了坚实的基础。

articles.title_en: PhyReNet: Physics-guided Retinex network with illumination-aware contrastive learning for low-light image enhancement
articles.title_cn: PhyReNet：物理引导的Retinex网络结合光照感知对比学习用于低光照图像增强
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) remains an ill-posed challenge due to the coupling of low visibility and illumination-dependent noise. Existing dual-stream Retinex frameworks often process illumination and reflectance separately, while current contrastive learning approaches rely on synthetic geometric augmentations that create domain gaps. To address these limitations, we propose PhyReNet , a physics-guided Retinex framework that injects low-light imaging priors into both feature interaction and contrastive representation learning. Specifically, Luminance-Informed Attention Guidance (LIAG) transforms illumination-stream features into learned spatial modulation parameters for reflectance restoration, while Physically-Induced Low-Light Perturbation (LPP) constructs hard negatives through physics-guided exposure attenuation and noise injection instead of artificial structural shuffling. Retinex self-reconstruction and gradient constraints further regularize the decomposition. Experiments on LOL-v1 and LOL-v2 show that PhyReNet achieves high structural fidelity, attaining a PSNR of 29.24 dB and SSIM of 0.9228 on LOL-v2, with an accuracy-efficiency trade-off discussed explicitly.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 低光照图像增强（LLIE）由于低可见性与光照相关噪声的耦合，仍然是一个不适定挑战。现有的双流Retinex框架通常分别处理光照和反射率，而当前的对比学习方法依赖于合成几何增强，这造成了域差距。为解决这些限制，我们提出了PhyReNet，一种物理引导的Retinex框架，将低光照成像先验注入特征交互和对比表示学习中。具体而言，亮度信息注意力引导（LIAG）将光照流特征转换为学习到的空间调制参数用于反射率恢复，而物理诱导的低光照扰动（LPP）通过物理引导的曝光衰减和噪声注入构建硬负样本，而非人工结构打乱。Retinex自重建和梯度约束进一步正则化分解。在LOL-v1和LOL-v2上的实验表明，PhyReNet实现了高结构保真度，在LOL-v2上达到PSNR 29.24 dB和SSIM 0.9228，并明确讨论了精度-效率权衡。

articles.title_en: Assessing groundwater-surface water interactions in an anthropized alluvial aquifer by combining hydrochemical and isotopic data with a statistical approach
articles.title_cn: 结合水化学与同位素数据及统计方法评估人为冲积含水层中地下水与地表水的相互作用
articles.abstract_en: To better understand the dynamics of groundwater in an anthropized alluvial aquifer in the Lower Rhône Valley, we applied multivariate statistical methods including hierarchical clustering analysis (HCA) to two datasets. The first dataset included conservative tracers (Cl−, Br− and stable water isotopes, δ2H and δ18O) and comprised 667 water samples. The second dataset included major and minor ions (Ca2+, Mg2+, K+, Na+, Cl−, SO42, alkalinity, NO3−, Br− and U(VI)) and stable water isotopes (δ2H and δ18O), comprising 374 water samples. Cluster analysis and dimension reduction techniques applied to the conservative tracer dataset revealed three groups of groundwater distributed between two recharge sources, as shown by the resulting distribution maps of clusters and boxplots. 1) The first group was characterized by Rhône recharge and was located along the Rhône River boundary. This group was characterized by highly depleted δ2H (mean = - 66.7‰) and δ18O (mean = −9.5‰) signatures. 2) Rainfall Recharge: Groundwater located along the northern and northwestern parts of the site. This group was characterized by highly enriched δ2H (mean = −41.4‰) and δ18O (mean = −6.4‰) signatures. 3) The third group, Mixing Recharge, was predominantly distributed in the southern part of the site and was characterized by intermediate δ2H and δ18O signatures. Additionally, the HCA analysis revealed the influence of 2022 Saharan dust event on the signatures of rainwater, the Rhône River, and thus, groundwater, with high deuterium excess, calcium and chloride concentrations. Cluster analysis of the second dataset identified water samples with high uranium and chloride concentrations, consistent with historical pollution in the area. Conversely, the results revealed temporal variations in groundwater and surface water linked to rainfalls events. Changes in the HCA cluster index and chloride concentrations suggest vertical infiltration or lateral inflow. This approach provides a better understanding of local-scale groundwater dynamics in an anthropized alluvial aquifer and offers valuable insights for groundwater management and modeling.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了更好地理解下罗讷河谷人为冲积含水层中地下水的动态，我们应用了包括层次聚类分析（HCA）在内的多元统计方法对两个数据集进行了分析。第一个数据集包含保守示踪剂（Cl−、Br−和稳定水同位素δ2H和δ18O），共包括667个水样。第二个数据集包含主要和次要离子（Ca2+、Mg2+、K+、Na+、Cl−、SO42−、碱度、NO3−、Br−和U(VI)）以及稳定水同位素（δ2H和δ18O），共包括374个水样。对保守示踪剂数据集进行的聚类分析和降维技术揭示了三个地下水组，分布在两个补给源之间，如所得的聚类分布图和箱线图所示。1）第一组以罗讷河补给为特征，位于罗讷河边界沿线。该组以高度贫化的δ2H（平均值 = 66.7‰）和δ18O（平均值 = -9.5‰）特征为标志。2）降雨补给：位于场地北部和西北部的地下水。该组以高度富集的δ2H（平均值 = -41.4‰）和δ18O（平均值 = -6.4‰）特征为标志。3）第三组，混合补给，主要分布在场地南部，以δ2H和δ18O的中间特征为标志。此外，HCA分析揭示了2022年撒哈拉沙尘事件对雨水、罗讷河以及因此对地下水特征的影响，表现为高氘盈余、钙和氯离子浓度。对第二个数据集的聚类分析识别出具有高铀和氯离子浓度的水样，与该地区的历史污染一致。相反，结果揭示了与降雨事件相关的地下水与地表水的时间变化。HCA聚类指数和氯离子浓度的变化表明存在垂直入渗或侧向流入。该方法提供了对人为冲积含水层局部尺度地下水动态的更好理解，并为地下水管理和建模提供了有价值的见解。

articles.title_en: Migration and transformation of antimony during Fe(II)-induced ferrihydrite recrystallization under anaerobic conditions
articles.title_cn: 厌氧条件下Fe(II)诱导水铁矿重结晶过程中锑的迁移转化
articles.abstract_en: Ferrihydrite can transform into more stable iron oxide minerals, including goethite and lepidocrocite, in the presence of dissolved Fe(II) under anaerobic conditions. During these recrystallization processes, variations in the adsorption capacity of iron oxide minerals, potential crystalline incorporation, and electron transfer processes may influence the fate of coexisting antimony. In the present study, antimony migration and transformation during the Fe(II)-induced recrystallization of ferrihydrite were systematically investigated under anaerobic conditions with different antimony speciation and concentrations. The results revealed that about 42–61% of the total antimony was eventually sequestered in the solid phase in a more stable form than simple surface adsorption occurred, and about 62–80% of the initial Sb(III) was oxidized to Sb(V) in systems containing Sb(III). X-ray diffraction (XRD), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), Fourier transform infrared (FT-IR) results indicated that the presence of both Sb(V) and Sb(III) promoted the Fe(II)-induced recrystallization of ferrihydrite, and this effect gradually weakened with increasing antimony concentration. The influence of Sb(III) was more pronounced. Under conditions with Fe:Sb molar ratios of 100 and 80, goethite was the dominant transformation product, whereas lepidocrocite became the main product at an Fe:Sb molar ratio of 40. These results suggest that Fe(II)-induced recrystallization of ferrihydrite may help reduce the mobility and toxicity of Sb in anoxic aquifers.
articles.abstract_cn: 在厌氧条件下，溶解态Fe(II)存在时，水铁矿可转化为更稳定的氧化铁矿物，包括针铁矿和纤铁矿。在这些重结晶过程中，氧化铁矿物吸附能力的变化、潜在的晶体结合以及电子传递过程可能影响共存锑的归趋。本研究系统考察了不同锑形态和浓度条件下，厌氧环境中Fe(II)诱导水铁矿重结晶过程中锑的迁移转化。结果表明，总锑中约有42-61%最终以比简单表面吸附更稳定的形式被固定于固相中，在含Sb(III)的体系中，初始Sb(III)约有62-80%被氧化为Sb(V)。X射线衍射(XRD)、X射线光电子能谱(XPS)和傅里叶变换红外光谱(FT-IR)结果表明，Sb(V)和Sb(III)的存在均促进了Fe(II)诱导的水铁矿重结晶，且该效应随锑浓度的增加而逐渐减弱，其中Sb(III)的影响更为显著。在Fe:Sb摩尔比为100和80的条件下，针铁矿是主要的转化产物，而在Fe:Sb摩尔比为40时，纤铁矿成为主要产物。这些结果表明，Fe(II)诱导的水铁矿重结晶可能有助于降低缺氧含水层中锑的迁移性和毒性。

articles.title_en: A high-fraction of O<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> incorporation in sulfate derived from hydrogen sulfide oxidation at pH of 8
articles.title_cn: 在pH为8的条件下，硫化氢氧化生成的硫酸盐中高比例的O<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf>掺入
articles.abstract_en: Oxidation of hydrogen sulfide to sulfate is commonly occurring at the redoxcline of oceans and freshwater systems, producing newly formed sulfate with δ18O and δ34S values different from those of the original sulfate. Hydrogen sulfide oxidation leads to the formation of several sulfur oxide species, occurs with various oxidants such as O2 and Fe3+, and proceeds through both biotic and abiotic pathways. A large number of biotic and abiotic sulfide oxidation experiments have been conducted to elucidate the complex pathway using oxygen isotopes. Oxygen atoms in sulfate are derived from both O2 and H2O during sulfide oxidation, which allows us to disentangle the oxidants involved in the reaction and further clarify the detailed mechanism. However, the oxygen isotope behaviors during hydrogen sulfide oxidation, particularly the fractions of oxygen from H2O or O2 being incorporated into sulfate, are inconsistent in literature. Besides, many of the sulfide oxidation experiments have been conducted in low pH condition (around 2), targeting the sulfur cycle in extreme environment such as acid-mine drainages. The low pH condition enhances oxygen exchange with sulfite and water, possibly reducing the fraction of O2-derived oxygen in the product sulfate. To address this issue, we conducted both biotic (using Cupriavidus pinatubonensis JMP134) and abiotic HS− oxidation experiments at pH 8 with 17O-labeled water to quantify the proportion of dissolved O2 in the resulting sulfate. The oxygen isotope analyses revealed that 88.6 ± 1.1% of the oxygen in product sulfate was derived from dissolved O2 during aerobic abiotic HS− oxidation. This fraction exceeds both the 67% concluded in a previous 18O-labeled experimental study and the less than 75% predicted by the abiotic HS− oxidation model, indicating the dominant portion of the sulfate must have been formed via a pathway that bypasses the intermediate sulfite or bisulfite. In addition, we determined the apparent kinetic isotope effect (AKIE) during O2 incorporation into sulfate at 18εSO4−O2 = −12.2 ± 0.7‰. These results suggest that a large O2 fraction could be incorporated into product sulfate during HS− oxidation at close-to-modern seawater pH condition.
articles.abstract_cn: 硫化氢氧化为硫酸盐通常发生在海洋和淡水系统的氧化还原跃层，产生的新形成的硫酸盐具有不同于原始硫酸盐的δ18O和δ34值。硫化氢氧化导致几种硫氧化物物种的形成，与多种氧化剂如O2和Fe3+发生反应，并通过生物和非生物途径进行。大量生物和非生物硫化物氧化实验已开展，以利用氧同位素阐明复杂途径。硫酸盐中的氧原子在硫化物氧化过程中来源于O2和H2O，这使我们能够解开反应中涉及的氧化剂，并进一步阐明详细机制。然而，硫化氢氧化过程中的氧同位素行为，特别是来自H2O或O2的氧掺入硫酸盐的比例，在文献中并不一致。此外，许多硫化物氧化实验在低pH条件（约2）下进行，针对极端环境如酸性矿山排水中的硫循环。低pH条件增强了亚硫酸盐与水之间的氧交换，可能降低了产物硫酸盐中O2来源氧的比例。为解决这一问题，我们在pH 8下使用17O标记水进行了生物（使用Cupriavidus pinatubonensis JMP134）和非生物HS−氧化实验，以量化所得硫酸盐中溶解O2的比例。氧同位素分析显示，在有氧非生物HS−氧化过程中，产物硫酸盐中88.6 ± 1.1%的氧来自溶解O2。这一比例超过了先前一项18O标记实验研究得出的67%以及非生物HS−氧化模型预测的小于75%，表明大部分硫酸盐必定通过绕过中间体亚硫酸盐或亚硫酸氢盐的途径形成。此外，我们确定了O2掺入硫酸盐过程中的表观动力学同位素效应（AKIE），在18εSO4−O2 = −12.2 ± 0.7‰。这些结果表明，在接近现代海水pH条件下，HS−氧化过程中可能有大量O2掺入产物硫酸盐。

articles.title_en: National trends in pediatric concurrent inferior turbinate reduction with tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy
articles.title_cn: 儿童扁桃体切除术与腺样体切除术同期行下鼻甲减容术的全国趋势
articles.abstract_en: ObjectiveTo examine the national trends in tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy (TA) with concurrent inferior turbinate reduction (ITR) over a 10-year period. MethodsRetrospective analysis of a one percent random sample from the Merative MarketScan Commercial Claims and Encounters (CCAE) database from 2015 through 2024. Pediatric patients (<18 years) with an outpatient claim for TA or TA with concurrent ITR were included. The primary outcome included the annual rate of concurrent ITR. Secondary outcomes included the annual rates of concurrent ITR stratified by patient age group, associated preoperative nasal diagnoses, turbinate procedure type, postoperative bleeding complications and readmission rates. ResultsOf 11,174 TA procedures, 586 (5.2%) included a concurrent ITR. The annual rate of these paired procedures remained stable across the study period, with a transient increase during the COVID-19 pandemic (range 4.5-8.3%, Cochran-Armitage p = 0.43). Concurrent ITR increased significantly with patient age (X2 = 123.8, p < 0.0001), with adolescents (13-17 years) at four times the rate of young children (0-3 years) (10.7% vs 2.6%). Submucous resection was performed in 304 of 586 cases (52%). Concurrent ITR was not independently associated with increased risk of postoperative hemorrhage (OR 1.29, 95% CI 0.67–2.27, p = 0.41) or 30-day readmission (OR 0.64, 95% CI 0.16–1.74, p = 0.46). ConclusionConcurrent ITR is performed in approximately 1 in 20 pediatric TAs at a stable overall rate over the past decade. Utilization is higher in older patients, submucous resection is most performed, postoperative bleeding complications and 30-day readmissions are rare.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的：考察过去10年间扁桃体切除术与腺样体切除术（TA）同期行下鼻甲减容术（ITR）的全国趋势。方法：对2015年至2024年Merative MarketScan商业索赔与 encounters（CCAE）数据库中百分之一随机样本进行回顾性分析。纳入有门诊TA或TA伴同期ITR索赔的儿科患者（<18岁）。主要结局包括同期ITR的年发生率。次要结局包括按患者年龄组、相关术前鼻部诊断、鼻甲手术类型、术后出血并发症和再入院率分层的同期ITR年发生率。结果：在11,174例TA手术中，586例（5.2%）包含同期ITR。这些配对手术的年发生率在研究期间保持稳定，在COVID-19大流行期间出现短暂增加（范围4.5-8.3%，Cochran-Armitage检验p = 0.43）。同期ITR随患者年龄显著增加（X2 = 123.8，p < 0.0001），青少年（13-17岁）的发生率是幼儿（0-3岁）的四倍（10.7% vs 2.6%）。黏膜下切除术在586例中进行了304例（52%）。同期ITR与术后出血风险增加（OR 1.29，95% CI 0.67-2.27，p = 0.41）或30天再入院（OR 0.64，95% CI 0.16-1.74，p = 0.46）无独立关联。结论：在过去十年中，大约每20例儿童TA中就有1例进行同期ITR，总体发生率保持稳定。在年龄较大的患者中使用率更高，黏膜下切除术最为常见，术后出血并发症和30天再入院罕见。

articles.title_en: Towards efficient pixel labeling for industrial anomaly detection and localization
articles.title_cn: 面向工业异常检测与定位的高效像素标注方法
articles.abstract_en: Industrial product inspection is commonly performed with anomaly detection (AD) frameworks trained exclusively on non-defective samples. While defective samples can be collected during production, their effective use typically requires pixel-level annotations, which limits scalability. To overcome this challenge, we propose ADClick, an interactive image segmentation (IIS) method that produces pixel-wise anomaly labels from only a few user clicks and a short textual description. This approach enables efficient and precise annotation (e.g., the label AP = 96.1% on MVTec AD). Building on this, we introduce ADClick-Seg, a cross-modal framework that integrates pixel-level priors with language-guided cues through a prototype-based alignment of visual features and textual prompts. This design enables robust anomaly detection and localization across diverse categories. On the challenging multi-class AD setting, ADClick-Seg achieves state-of-the-art results (AP = 80.0%, PRO = 97.5%, Pixel-AUROC = 99.1% on MVTec AD). Code is available at: https://github.com/BeJane/ADClick.
articles.abstract_cn: 工业产品检验通常使用仅由非缺陷样本训练的异常检测（AD）框架进行。虽然生产过程中可以收集缺陷样本，但其有效使用通常需要像素级标注，这限制了可扩展性。为克服这一挑战，我们提出了ADClick，一种交互式图像分割（IIS）方法，仅需少量用户点击和简短文本描述即可生成像素级异常标签。该方法实现了高效且精确的标注（例如，在MVTec AD上标签AP = 96.1%）。在此基础上，我们引入了ADClick-Seg，一种跨模态框架，通过基于原型的视觉特征与文本提示对齐，将像素级先验与语言引导线索相结合。该设计能够在不同类别中实现稳健的异常检测与定位。在具有挑战性的多类别AD设置中，ADClick-Seg取得了最先进的结果（在MVTec AD上AP = 80.0%，PRO = 97.5%，Pixel-AUROC = 99.1%）。代码可在 https://github.com/BeJane/ADClick 获取。

articles.title_en: Connecting the objects: Relational occlusion graphs for amodal segmentation
articles.title_cn: 连接对象：用于非模态分割的关系遮挡图
articles.abstract_en: Amodal instance segmentation predicts complete object masks by inferring occluded regions. Existing methods typically rely on object-centric cues like shape priors or intra-object coherence. We argue that relationships between neighboring objects, such as relative position, overlap, and occlusion patterns, play a crucial role in inferring missing geometries. We propose Amodal Relational Occlusion Graph (AROG) to explicitly model inter-object occlusion. Our framework dynamically constructs a directed and weighted graph from evolving object queries. Each node in this graph represents an object query. Each directed edge encodes the specific occlusion influence from one object to another. We integrate this graph into the self-attention mechanism as a relational inductive bias. This design enables occluded queries to attend selectively to relevant occluders. AROG achieves strong performance across multiple benchmarks and shows that structured relational modeling provides an effective perspective for amodal perception.
articles.abstract_cn: 非模态实例分割通过推断被遮挡区域来预测完整的对象掩码。现有方法通常依赖于对象中心的线索，如形状先验或对象内一致性。我们认为，相邻对象之间的关系，如相对位置、重叠和遮挡模式，在推断缺失几何形状中起着关键作用。我们提出了非模态关系遮挡图（AROG）来显式建模对象间的遮挡。我们的框架从演化的对象查询中动态构建一个有向加权图。该图中的每个节点代表一个对象查询。每条有向边编码从一个对象到另一个对象的特定遮挡影响。我们将此图作为关系归纳偏置集成到自注意力机制中。这种设计使被遮挡的查询能够选择性地关注相关的遮挡物。AROG在多个基准测试中取得了强劲性能，并表明结构化关系建模为非模态感知提供了有效视角。

articles.title_en: Mobile money and the social contract: Experimental evidence from Ghana
articles.title_cn: 移动货币与社会契约：来自加纳的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Author(s) Mobile money platforms are ubiquitous in many emerging economies. Hailed for raising financial inclusion and economic wellbeing, governments have now turned to mobile payments as a source of tax revenue. Transaction levies are often regressive, unpopular, and can encourage a return to cash. We present experimental evidence that they may also harm tax morale, a core component of the social contract between citizen and state. We present results from a survey experiment in Ghana, in which priming a controversial mobile transaction levy significantly lowers support for the state's right to collect taxes and willingness to comply with tax laws. We combine this with focus group discussions and analyse effect heterogeneity to examine two pre-registered explanations: transaction taxes cost citizens more than they expect to gain (reciprocity) and provoke particular backlash from non-government voters (partisanship). Our findings suggest that taxing mobile money can undermine efforts to expand fiscal capacity, while raising important mechanistic and policy questions for future research.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者。移动货币平台在许多新兴经济体中无处不在。因其提高金融包容性和经济福祉而受到赞誉，政府现已转向移动支付作为税收收入的来源。交易税通常是累退的、不受欢迎的，并可能鼓励回归现金。我们提供的实验证据表明，它们也可能损害税收道德，这是公民与国家之间社会契约的核心组成部分。我们展示了在加纳进行的一项调查实验的结果，其中启动一个有争议的移动交易税显著降低了对国家征税权利的支持以及遵守税法的意愿。我们结合焦点小组讨论并分析效应异质性，以检验两个预先注册的解释：交易税使公民付出的成本超过他们预期获得的收益（互惠性），并引发非政府选民的特殊反弹（党派性）。我们的发现表明，对移动货币征税可能削弱扩大财政能力的努力，同时为未来研究提出重要的机制和政策问题。

articles.title_en: Crop rotations modulate chemical transformation of dissolved organic matter during mineral surface-bound Fe(II) oxidation in paddy soils
articles.title_cn: 作物轮作调控水稻土中矿物表面结合Fe(II)氧化过程中溶解性有机质的化学转化
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Fe(II)-bearing minerals oxygenation play important role in chemical mineralization and sequestration of dissolved organic matter (DOM) in paddy soils. However, the regulation of crop rotations in DOM chemical transformation during mineral surface-bound Fe(II) oxidation remains insufficiently understood. In this work, the transformations of DOM from two crop rotation paddy soils (maize-rice, MR-DOM, and soybean-rice, SR-DOM) were investigated during oxidation of surface-bound Fe(II) on goethite, alumina, and kaolinite, respectively. After oxidation of 1 mM mineral-adsorbed Fe(II) for 2 h, CO 2 production in SR-DOM ranged from 42.18 to 101.18 μg C·mg −1 DOC, which was about 1.22∼1.38 times higher than that in MR-DOM. Among the minerals, alumina presented the highest CO 2 release because of promoting higher •OH accumulation, whereas goethite limited CO 2 generation due to strong DOM adsorption, despite enhancing Fe(II) electron utilization for •OH formation. Compared with SR-DOM, stronger adsorption of MR-DOM by minerals resulted in more effective protection of MR-DOM, from mineralization to CO 2 . XPS and FT-ICR-MS analyses showed that greater radical C[Figure Presented]C and C–C bond cleavage reactions occurred in SR-DOM during oxidation, and increased DOM saturation and oxidation states. In contrast to SR-DOM, MR-DOM underwent more oxygen addition reactions during oxidation, leading to an increase in molecular weight and consequently less CO 2 production from •OH mineralization. These findings provide new insights into the distinct processes of carbon sequestration and mineralization during redox cycles in paddy soils with various crop rotations.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 含Fe(II)矿物的氧化在水稻土中溶解性有机质（DOM）的化学矿化和固存中发挥重要作用。然而，作物轮作对矿物表面结合Fe(II)氧化过程中DOM化学转化的调控仍未被充分理解。本研究分别考察了来自两种作物轮作水稻土（玉米-水稻，MR-DOM，和大豆-水稻，SR-DOM）的DOM在针铁矿、氧化铝和高岭石表面结合Fe(II)氧化过程中的转化。在氧化1 mM矿物吸附Fe(II) 2 小时后，SR-DOM中的CO 2 产量范围为42.18至101.18 μg C·mg −1 DOC，约为MR-DOM的1.22∼1.38倍。在矿物中，氧化铝因促进更高的•OH积累而呈现最高的CO 2释放，而针铁矿因强烈的DOM吸附限制了CO 2生成，尽管增强了Fe(II)电子利用以形成•OH。与SR-DOM相比，MR-DOM被矿物的更强吸附导致MR-DOM更有效地被保护，免于矿化为CO 2。XPS和FT-ICR-MS分析表明，在氧化过程中SR-DOM发生了更强烈的自由基C[Figure Presented]C和C–C键断裂反应，并增加了DOM的饱和度和氧化态。与SR-DOM相反，MR-DOM在氧化过程中经历了更多的加氧反应，导致分子量增加，从而减少了•OH矿化产生的CO 2。这些发现为不同作物轮作水稻土在氧化还原循环中碳固存和矿化的不同过程提供了新见解。

articles.title_en: Hydrological convergence and surface–groundwater connectivity are associated with fluorescent groundwater DOM in the Victoria and Kyoga Basins, Uganda
articles.title_cn: 水文汇聚与地表-地下水连通性与乌干达维多利亚和基奥加盆地地下水荧光DOM相关
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Dissolved organic matter (DOM) influences subsurface biogeochemistry yet controls on its composition in many tropical sub-Saharan aquifers remain poorly understood. Here, we integrated satellite-derived land-use/land-cover (LULC) data, terrain metrics, and inorganic tracers (NO 3 − /Cl − , SO 4 2− /Cl − ) to evaluate how LULC patterns and terrain-driven hydrological convergence, expressed as topographic wetness index (TWI), influence bulk and fluorescent groundwater DOM (fDOM) across multiple spatial scales in Uganda. Groundwater DOM was dominated by weakly aromatic, highly processed material of mixed terrestrial and microbial origin (specific ultraviolet absorbance (SUVA) < 0.5 L mg −1 .m −1 ; median humification index (HIX corr ) > 0.5, β:α < 1, and fluorescence index (FI) ∼ 1.6). Total fluorescence (0.1 – 12.3 RU; median 0.3 RU) was dominated by fulvic-like (∼35 %) and tryptophan-like (∼29 %), followed by tyrosine-like (∼18 %) and humic-like (∼17 %) components. The combined influence of LULC and TWI was scale dependent, although LULC categories showed no significant associations with groundwater DOM, except surface-water cover. TWI was positively associated with dissolved organic carbon (DOC), and fDOM components consistent with potential lateral mobilisation and surface–groundwater interaction in hydrologically convergent zones. NO 3 − /Cl − ratios were negatively correlated with DOC (Spearman ρ ∼ −0.56), and positively with SUVA (ρ ∼ 0.46), consistent with preferential depletion of relatively bioavailable DOM fractions and relative enrichment of more aromatic residual DOM under nitrate-enriched conditions. These results show that in the Victoria and Kyoga basins, hydrological convergence, rather than land use alone, likely influences groundwater DOM composition, highlighting surface waters and near-surface hyporheic zones as potential sources and transformation environments for organic matter entering aquifers.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 溶解性有机质（DOM）影响地下生物地球化学，但其在热带撒哈拉以南非洲许多含水层中的组成控制因素仍知之甚少。本研究整合了卫星衍生的土地利用/土地覆盖（LULC）数据、地形指标和无机示踪剂（NO 3 − /Cl − , SO 4 2− /Cl − ），以评估LULC模式和地形驱动的水文汇聚（以地形湿度指数（TWI）表示）如何在乌干达多个空间尺度上影响总体和荧光地下水DOM（fDOM）。地下水DOM以弱芳香性、高度处理过的混合陆源和微生物源物质为主（比紫外吸光度（SUVA）< 0.5 L mg −1 .m −1；中位数腐殖化指数（HIX corr ）> 0.5，β:α < 1，荧光指数（FI）∼ 1.6）。总荧光（0.1-12.3 RU；中位数 0.3 RU）以类富里酸（∼35 %）和类色氨酸（∼29 %）为主，其次是类酪氨酸（∼18 %）和类腐殖质（∼17 %）组分。LULC和TWI的综合影响具有尺度依赖性，尽管LULC类别与地下水DOM无显著关联，但地表水覆盖除外。TWI与溶解性有机碳（DOC）和fDOM组分正相关，这与水文汇聚区潜在的侧向迁移和地表-地下水相互作用一致。NO 3 − /Cl − 比率与DOC呈负相关（Spearman ρ ∼ −0.56），与SUVA呈正相关（ρ ∼ 0.46），这与硝酸盐富集条件下相对生物可利用DOM组分的优先消耗和更芳香性残留DOM的相对富集一致。这些结果表明，在维多利亚和基奥加盆地，水文汇聚而非仅土地利用可能影响地下水DOM组成，突显地表水和近地表潜流带作为有机物进入含水层的潜在来源和转化环境。

articles.title_en: Comparing the adsorption and molecular fractionation of rice straw biochar-derived and leached dissolved organic matter on iron (oxyhydr)oxides
articles.title_cn: 比较水稻秸秆生物炭源和淋溶态溶解性有机质在铁（氢）氧化物上的吸附与分子分馏
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd Iron (oxyhydr)oxides play a crucial role in regulating the biogeochemical cycling of dissolved organic matter (DOM) in natural environments. The pyrolysis of crop straw fundamentally alters the molecular composition of water-extractable organic matter, which results in distinct adsorption fractionation on iron (oxyhydr)oxides and subsequently different effects on soil DOM. Here, we investigated the adsorption and molecular fractionation of dissolved black carbon (DBC) derived from rice straw biochar and as well as leached DOM, during their adsorption onto magnetite, ferrihydrite, and hematite. Our results showed that magnetite consistently had the highest adsorption capacity for DBC and DOM, followed by ferrihydrite and then hematite, highlighting the importance of iron (oxyhydr)oxides surface properties in influencing DBC and DOM adsorption. Molecular analysis revealed pronounced selective fractionation during adsorption. Specifically, adsorption led to reductions in the O/C ratios and aromaticity indices of residual DBC as well as decreases in the O/C ratios of residual DOM, indicating that iron (oxyhydr)oxides selectively capture highly oxidized and unsaturated compounds. Furthermore, DBC showed a preference for removing CRAM- and tannin-like compounds, whereas DOM more strongly depleted carbohydrates, tannin-like compounds, and peptides. These differences imply that returning biochar to soil may encourage the accumulation of condensed aromatic structures through iron oxide adsorption, whereas returning straw may help stabilize oxygen-containing aliphatic compounds in soil DOM. Overall, these results provide new understanding of how DBC and DOM interact with iron (oxyhydr)oxides at interfaces and have important implications for carbon cycling, the transport and transformation of environmental pollutants and soil remediation efforts.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 铁（氢）氧化物在调节自然环境中溶解性有机质（DOM）的生物地球化学循环中起着关键作用。作物秸秆的热解从根本上改变了水可提取有机质的分子组成，导致其在铁（氢）氧化物上的吸附分馏存在差异，进而对土壤DOM产生不同影响。本研究探讨了水稻秸秆生物炭来源的溶解性黑碳（DBC）以及淋溶态DOM在磁铁矿、水铁矿和赤铁矿上的吸附及其分子分馏过程。结果表明，磁铁矿对DBC和DOM的吸附能力始终最高，其次为水铁矿，赤铁矿最低，这凸显了铁（氢）氧化物表面性质在影响DBC和DOM吸附中的重要性。分子分析揭示了吸附过程中显著的选择性分馏。具体而言，吸附导致残余DBC的O/C比和芳香性指数降低，以及残余DOM的O/C比下降，表明铁（氢）氧化物选择性捕获高度氧化和不饱和的化合物。此外，DBC优先去除类CRAM和类单宁化合物，而DOM则更强烈地消耗碳水化合物、类单宁化合物和肽类。这些差异意味着将生物炭还田可能通过铁氧化物吸附促进缩合芳香结构的积累，而秸秆还田则可能有助于稳定土壤DOM中含氧脂肪族化合物。总体而言，这些结果为理解DBC和DOM在界面上与铁（氢）氧化物的相互作用提供了新的认识，并对碳循环、环境污染物的迁移转化以及土壤修复具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: Anomaly-aware Siamese comparative transformer for 3D anomaly detection
articles.title_cn: 基于异常感知的孪生比较变换器用于三维异常检测
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Point cloud anomaly detection is a critical task in industrial quality control, aiming to identify structural deviations that signify product defects. A prevalent strategy involves synthesizing pseudo-anomalies on normal samples to learn a mapping that compensates for these deviations. However, this paradigm encounters two major challenges: (1) an insufficient emphasis on localizing precise anomalous regions, which often leads to spurious detections, and (2) a neglect of the comparative signals inherent in normal sam- ples, hindering the development of robust decision boundaries. To address these issues, we propose the Anomaly-Aware Siamese Comparative Transformer (AACoT). AACoT integrates a normal reference branch to enable anomaly-aware feature modeling through a comparative attention mechanism. Furthermore, a Siamese detector is introduced to enforce prediction consistency on normal samples, thereby sharpening the normal–anomaly boundary and enhancing segmentation precision. Extensive evaluations on the Anomaly-ShapeNet and Real3D-AD benchmarks demonstrate that AACoT achieves state-of-the-art performance in both anomaly detection and localization.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 点云异常检测是工业质量控制中的关键任务，旨在识别表明产品缺陷的结构偏差。一种普遍策略是在正常样本上合成伪异常，以学习补偿这些偏差的映射。然而，这种范式面临两大挑战：（1）对精确定位异常区域的重视不足，常常导致虚假检测；（2）忽视了正常样本中固有的比较信号，阻碍了稳健决策边界的发展。为解决这些问题，我们提出了异常感知的孪生比较变换器（AACoT）。AACoT集成了一个正常参考分支，通过比较注意力机制实现异常感知的特征建模。此外，引入了一个孪生检测器，以强制正常样本上的预测一致性，从而锐化正常-异常边界并提高分割精度。在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD基准上的广泛评估表明，AACoT在异常检测和定位方面均达到了最先进的性能。

articles.title_en: Transport and remobilization of Eu(III)-silicate colloids in a simulated fractured granite-groundwater system
articles.title_cn: 模拟裂隙花岗岩-地下水系统中Eu(III)-硅酸盐胶体的迁移与再活化
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The migration of actinides (An) in deep geological repositories is significantly influenced by colloid-facilitated transport, particularly via the formation of An-silicate colloids. This study investigates the transport and release behaviors of Eu(III)-silicate colloids (used as an analog for trivalent actinides) in a simulated water-saturated granite fracture system. Transport experiments were conducted in a laboratory-scale fracture flow system to evaluate the effects of pH (7.3-8.5), ionic strength (1-400 mM), and fulvic acid (FA, 2.0-10.0 mg/L) on colloid mobility, while retention-release experiments were performed to assess their remobilization potential. Mechanisms were elucidated using size-fractionated analysis, with consideration of colloidal heterogeneity, and DLVO theory. The results indicate that Eu(III)-silicate colloids exhibit high mobility under conditions of high pH (8.5) and low ionic strength (1 mM), achieving a recovery rate of 97.9%. This enhanced transport is driven by strong electrostatic repulsion and minimized hydrodynamic size. The presence of FA further promotes mobility through steric stabilization and the formation of soluble Eu(III)-FA complexes. The transport mechanism transitions from Langmuirian blocking to ripening when Eu(III)-silicate colloids become unstable and aggregate under elevated ionic strength (e.g., >200 mM NaCl at pH 8.5). Colloidal fractions with higher Si/Eu ratios demonstrated superior transport capability due to their smaller size and stronger surface charge, indicating that the heterogeneity of Eu(III)-silicate colloids plays an important role in their transport behavior. Furthermore, retained colloids at pH 8.0 and 300 mM NaCl can be remobilized by perturbations such as decreasing ionic strength, increasing pH, or increasing flow velocity. This release process is governed by a dual mechanism involving both direct detachment from the fracture surface and the disaggregation of larger aggregates. However, prolonged retention times were found to inhibit remobilization due to the aging effect, which strengthens adhesion and leads to a transition towards more stable attachment. These findings provide critical insights into the environmental fate of An (III)-silicate colloids and emphasize the potential risks associated with their remobilization in fractured granite environments.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 深层地质处置库中锕系元素（An）的迁移受到胶体促进传输的显著影响，特别是通过形成An-硅酸盐胶体。本研究在模拟水饱和花岗岩裂隙系统中，考察了Eu(III)-硅酸盐胶体（作为三价锕系元素的类似物）的迁移和释放行为。在实验室规模的裂隙流动系统中进行了传输实验，以评估pH（7.3-8.5）、离子强度（1-400 mM）和富里酸（FA，2.0-10.0 mg/L）对胶体迁移性的影响，同时进行了滞留-释放实验以评估其再活化潜力。通过粒径分级分析，结合胶体异质性及DLVO理论，阐明了相关机制。结果表明，在高pH（8.5）和低离子强度（1 mM）条件下，Eu(III)-硅酸盐胶体表现出高迁移性，回收率达到97.9%。这种增强的迁移由强静电排斥和最小化流体动力学尺寸驱动。FA的存在通过空间稳定化和可溶性Eu(III)-FA络合物的形成进一步促进迁移。当Eu(III)-硅酸盐胶体在高离子强度（例如，pH 8.5下>200 mM NaCl）下变得不稳定并聚集时，传输机制从Langmuirian阻塞转变为熟化。具有较高Si/Eu比的胶体组分因其较小的尺寸和更强的表面电荷而表现出更优的传输能力，表明Eu(III)-硅酸盐胶体的异质性在其传输行为中发挥重要作用。此外，在pH 8.0和300 mM NaCl条件下滞留的胶体可通过降低离子强度、升高pH或增加流速等扰动而再活化。该释放过程由双重机制控制，涉及从裂隙表面的直接脱离和大聚集体的解聚。然而，长时间滞留时间因老化效应而抑制再活化，老化效应增强了粘附力并导致向更稳定附着状态的转变。这些发现为An(III)-硅酸盐胶体在裂隙花岗岩环境中的环境归趋提供了关键见解，并强调了其再活化相关的潜在风险。

articles.title_en: Can mine tailings be recycled in soil ecosystems? A mineralogical and chemical examination of their suitability for recycling
articles.title_cn: 尾矿能否在土壤生态系统中循环利用？对其适用性的矿物学和化学检验
articles.abstract_en: Mine tailings represent a valuable secondary resource with strong potential for material recovery. This study presents a detailed mineralogical and chemical characterization of mineral materials from three Norwegian deposits - mine tailings from Rana iron formation (R tailings), and lab-scale tailings from mineral processing of the Fen carbonatite complex (C tailings) and Nussir copper deposit (N tailings) to evaluate their potential as valuable materials in soils, including soil reconstruction, technosol developments, mine-site reclamation, and nutrient source in agronomic plant production. Mineralogy was analyzed using scanning electron microscope-based automated mineralogy (SEM-AM), and bulk elemental composition was determined via X-ray fluorescence (XRF). SEM-AM results show that the Fen sample is dominated by soluble carbonates (>90%), being a source of Ca, Mg, Fe, with limited contribution of P from apatite (1.4%). Rana tailings are dominated by quartz and silicates (>60%), with ∼10% carbonates and ∼10% Fe-oxides. Nussir sample, containing 37% carbonates and 7.3% biotite, offers valuable sources of Ca and Mg. XRF analysis detected trace elements of potential concern for soil ecosystems, including Mn, Ba, Sr, La, Ce, Nd in Fen sample, and Mn in Rana and Nussir samples that require further speciation and bioavailability analyses. All three materials exhibit fine particle size (C tailings <150 μm, R tailings <400 μm, N tailings <140 μm), high alkalinity (pH 9-10), and an absence of sulfide minerals, reducing the risk of acid mine drainage. Based on well-established analytical methods for mineral characterization, the findings suggest that mine tailings can potentially be recycled within the soil ecosystems as a soil amendment and nutrient source, although further studies are needed to assess element bioavailability and long-term environmental impacts.
articles.abstract_cn: 尾矿代表了一种有价值的二次资源，在材料回收方面具有巨大潜力。本研究对来自三个挪威矿床的矿物材料进行了详细的矿物学和化学表征——Rana铁建造的尾矿（R尾矿），以及来自Fen碳酸岩杂岩体（C尾矿）和Nussir铜矿床（N尾矿）矿物加工的实验室规模尾矿，以评估其作为土壤中有价值材料的潜力，包括土壤重建、技术土壤开发、矿区复垦以及农艺植物生产中的养分来源。使用基于扫描电子显微镜的自动矿物学（SEM-AM）分析矿物学，并通过X射线荧光（XRF）测定整体元素组成。SEM-AM结果表明，Fen样品以可溶性碳酸盐为主（>90%），是Ca、Mg、Fe的来源，磷灰石（1.4%）对P的贡献有限。Rana尾矿以石英和硅酸盐为主（>60%），约10%为碳酸盐，约10%为铁氧化物。Nussir样品含有37%的碳酸盐和7.3%的黑云母，提供了有价值的Ca和Mg来源。XRF分析检测到对土壤生态系统潜在关注的微量元素，包括Fen样品中的Mn、Ba、Sr、La、Ce、Nd，以及Rana和Nussir样品中的Mn，这些需要进一步的形态和生物可利用性分析。所有三种材料均表现出细颗粒尺寸（C尾矿<150 μm，R尾矿<400 μm，N尾矿<140 μm）、高碱度（pH 9-10）以及不含硫化物矿物，降低了酸性矿山排水的风险。基于成熟的矿物表征分析方法，研究结果表明尾矿有可能作为土壤改良剂和养分来源在土壤生态系统中循环利用，尽管需要进一步研究来评估元素的生物可利用性和长期环境影响。

articles.title_en: A stochastic energy-based formulation of attention for robust and interpretable transformers
articles.title_cn: 一种基于随机能量的注意力公式，用于稳健且可解释的变换器
articles.abstract_en: Transformers rely heavily on scaled dot–product softmax attention, yet this mechanism often produces overly sharp and noise–amplifying weight distributions that limit robustness, interpretability, and generalization. Motivated by the need for a stable and geometry–aware alternative, this work introduces the Stochastic Kernel Attention Transform (SKaT), a principled attention operator that replaces softmax with a locality–preserving Gaussian kernel augmented with variance–controlled stochastic perturbations. SKaT is formulated as the solution to a regularized stochastic energy functional, yielding smooth, coherent, and exploration–enabled attention maps. Integrated into lightweight CNN and transformer backbones, SKaT is evaluated across five diverse benchmarks such as MNIST, CIFAR–10, CIFAR–100, IMDB, and ESC–50, spanning image, text, and audio modalities. Experimental results show that SKaT consistently surpasses no–attention, softmax, deterministic kernel attention, and linear attention baselines, with particularly strong gains on noisy and fine–grained classification tasks. Robustness experiments with occlusions, additive noise, and word dropout further reveal significantly lower degradation compared to softmax. Qualitative analyses, including attention heatmaps and SHAP–based token attributions, highlight SKaT’s ability to capture semantically aligned, phrase–level and region–level importance patterns. The proposed SKaT provides a theoretically grounded, computationally efficient, and empirically validated alternative for stable and interpretable pattern recognition.
articles.abstract_cn: 变换器严重依赖缩放点积softmax注意力，然而这种机制常常产生过于尖锐且放大噪声的权重分布，限制了稳健性、可解释性和泛化能力。受对稳定且几何感知的替代方案的需求驱动，本工作引入了随机核注意力变换（SKaT），这是一种原则性的注意力算子，用保持局部性的高斯核替代softmax，并辅以方差控制的随机扰动。SKaT被表述为正则化随机能量泛函的解，产生平滑、连贯且支持探索的注意力图。集成到轻量级CNN和变换器骨干网络中，SKaT在五个多样化的基准上进行了评估，如MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、IMDB和ESC-50，涵盖图像、文本和音频模态。实验结果表明，SKaT持续优于无注意力、softmax、确定性核注意力和线性注意力基线，在噪声和细粒度分类任务上尤其表现出强劲的提升。鲁棒性实验，包括遮挡、加性噪声和词丢弃，进一步显示与softmax相比，性能下降显著更低。定性分析，包括注意力热图和基于SHAP的标记归因，突出了SKaT捕捉语义对齐、短语级和区域级重要性模式的能力。所提出的SKaT为稳定且可解释的模式识别提供了一种理论上有根据、计算上高效且经验上验证的替代方案。

articles.title_en: Expanded records of seagrass distribution and biomass across the Tuamotu Archipelago and Society Islands, French Polynesia
articles.title_cn: 法属波利尼西亚土阿莫土群岛和社会群岛海草分布与生物量的扩展记录
articles.abstract_en: The seagrasses of French Polynesia remain largely undocumented and unmapped, hindering a coherent understanding of their diversity, distribution and potential role in global carbon cycles. We present expanded data from nine sites across six islands and atolls including Bora Bora, Taha’a, Huahine, Moorea, Rangiroa and Fakarava, spanning a distance of more than 680 kilometres. At each location, replicate sites were scoped and new seagrass meadows described for Halophila decipiens and H. ovalis, including leaf morphometrics, seafloor covers (%) and dry weight (DW) biomass (g·m²). The study expands the documented observations of seagrass meadows to a total of 21 across French Polynesia including the first records for Taha’a and Fakarava. Novel data describing differences in leaf morphology of Halophila species and variation in seagrass meadow structure (covers ranging from 1.9% to 47.9%) are presented, along with observations of populations occurring within silty river mouth niches where meadows have not been previously reported within the region. Biomass estimates (ranging from 19.7 to 26 g·m² DW) showed generally greater values in the volcanic Society Islands compared to the Tuamotu Archipelago, though this was modulated by the distribution of species. Our observations expand the documented records of Polynesian seagrass ecosystems and provide new ecological detail for Halophila species across a broad range of Pacific island environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 法属波利尼西亚的海草在很大程度上仍未被记录和测绘，这阻碍了对其多样性、分布及其在全球碳循环中潜在作用的连贯理解。我们提供了来自六个岛屿和环礁（包括波拉波拉岛、塔哈岛、胡阿希内岛、莫雷阿岛、朗伊罗阿环礁和法卡拉瓦环礁）九个地点的扩展数据，跨越超过680公里的距离。在每个地点，对重复样地进行了勘察，并描述了Halophila decipiens和H. ovalis的新海草草甸，包括叶片形态测量、海底覆盖率（%）和干重（DW）生物量（g·m²）。该研究将法属波利尼西亚海草草甸的文献记录扩展到总共21处，包括塔哈岛和法卡拉瓦环礁的首次记录。提供了描述Halophila物种叶片形态差异和海草草甸结构变化（覆盖率从1.9%到47.9%）的新数据，以及关于在粉砂质河口生态位中出现的种群的观察，这些区域此前在该地区未报告过海草草甸。生物量估计（范围从19.7到26 g·m² DW）显示，火山社会群岛的值通常高于土阿莫土群岛，尽管这受到物种分布的调节。我们的观察扩展了波利尼西亚海草生态系统的文献记录，并为广泛太平洋岛屿环境中的Halophila物种提供了新的生态细节。

articles.title_en: Outcomes of pediatric prophylactic thyroidectomy in MEN2: A systematic review
Comparative study of the post-helical crus approach for excision of classic preauricular sinuses
articles.title_cn: 耳轮脚后入路与经典耳前窦道切除术的比较研究
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundThe standard Pre-helical Crus Approach (Pre-HCA) for preauricular sinus excision often leaves a visible scar. ObjectiveTo investigate the feasibility of the Post-helical Crus Approach (Po-HCA) for the excision of classic preauricular sinuses in pediatric patients. MethodsThe differences between Po-HCA and the Pre-HCA were analyzed regarding total incision length, sinus incision length, operative time, postoperative wound infection rate, and recurrence rate. ResultsThe Po-HCA achieved a significantly shorter sinus incision length (0.2 ± 0.004) compared to the Pre-HC (2.02 ± 0.09) (P < 0.05).
