No statistically significant differences were observed between the two groups in total incision length, operative time, postoperative wound infection rate, or recurrence rate (all P > 0.05). ConclusionThe Po-HCA technique offers a safe and effective alternative for excising classic preauricular sinuses in the non-infected stage, with the advantage of a minimal visible scar (0.2) compared to conventional approaches.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景标准的耳轮脚前入路（Pre-HCA）用于耳前窦道切除术常留下可见疤痕。目的探讨耳轮脚后入路（Po-HCA）在儿童患者中切除经典耳前窦道的可行性。方法分析Po-HCA与Pre-HCA在总切口长度、窦道切口长度、手术时间、术后伤口感染率和复发率方面的差异。结果Po-HCA的窦道切口长度显著更短（0.2 ± 0.004），而Pre-HCA为（2.02 ± 0.09）（P < 0.05）。两组在总切口长度、手术时间、术后伤口感染率或复发率方面未观察到统计学显著差异（均P > 0.05）。结论Po-HCA技术为非感染期经典耳前窦道切除提供了一种安全有效的替代方案，与传统方法相比，具有可见疤痕最小（0.2）的优势。

articles.title_en: Cesarean section and maternal atopy increase the risk of allergic rhinitis in offspring: a case-control study
articles.title_cn: 剖宫产与母体特应性增加后代过敏性鼻炎的风险：一项病例对照研究
articles.abstract_en: ObjectiveTo assess the interaction between cesarean section (CS) and maternal history of allergic diseases (MHAD) in influencing the risk of allergic rhinitis in the offspring. MethodsA case-control study was conducted with a 1:1 frequency matching by sex. A total of 239 children diagnosed with AR were enrolled in the case group, and 239 children without a history of AR served as the control group. Logistic regression models were used to analyze the association between maternal CS, MHAD, and the risk of AR in offspring. Interaction effects were evaluated using both the multiplicative and additive models. ResultsThe CS (50.7%) and MHAD (36.8%) rates in the case group were significantly higher than those in the control group (35.1% and 27.6%, respectively). Logistic regression analysis revealed that maternal CS (OR = 1.916, 95%CI:1.322-2.778, P < 0.001) and MHAD (OR = 1.585, 95%CI:1.071–2.344, P = 0.021) were independent risk factors for AR in offspring. Furthermore, a significant multiplicative interaction was observed between maternal CS and MHAD (OR = 3.472, 95% CI:1.497-8.053, P = 0.004), with the combined effect increasing the risk by 5.619 times. ConclusionMaternal CS and MHAD synergistically increase the risk of AR in children. These findings underscore the importance of considering both maternal CS and MHAD when developing public health strategies and preventive interventions to reduce the incidence of AR in the offspring.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的评估剖宫产（CS）与母体过敏性疾病史（MHAD）在影响后代过敏性鼻炎风险中的交互作用。方法采用按性别1:1频数匹配的病例对照研究。病例组纳入239名确诊为AR的儿童，对照组纳入239名无AR病史的儿童。采用Logistic回归模型分析母体CS、MHAD与后代AR风险之间的关联。交互作用通过乘法和加法模型进行评估。结果病例组中CS（50.7%）和MHAD（36.8%）的比例显著高于对照组（分别为35.1%和27.6%）。Logistic回归分析显示，母体CS（OR = 1.916，95%CI：1.322-2.778，P < 0.001）和MHAD（OR = 1.585，95%CI：1.071-2.344，P = 0.021）是后代AR的独立危险因素。此外，母体CS与MHAD之间存在显著的乘法交互作用（OR = 3.472，95%CI：1.497-8.053，P = 0.004），联合效应使风险增加5.619倍。结论母体CS和MHAD协同增加儿童AR的风险。这些发现强调了在制定公共卫生策略和预防干预措施以减少后代AR发病率时，考虑母体CS和MHAD的重要性。

articles.title_en: Language outcomes following pediatric cochlear implantation: Associations with clinical, socioeconomic, and rehabilitation factors
articles.title_cn: 儿童人工耳蜗植入后的语言结果：与临床、社会经济和康复因素的关联
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Objective: Language outcomes after pediatric cochlear implantation vary widely and are not fully explained by established clinical factors such as age at implantation and neurodevelopmental comorbidities. This study examined the associations between selected clinical, socioeconomic, and appointment-related factors and receptive and expressive language outcomes following cochlear implantation. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of children with congenital bilateral severe-to-profound sensorineural hearing loss who underwent cochlear implantation, received post implantation Auditory Verbal Therapy and completed post-implant language assessments using the Preschool Language Scale, Fifth Edition. Receptive and expressive language age-equivalent scores were analyzed over two years after activation (n = 36). A subset of children with at least two post-implant language assessments available (n = 17) was included in secondary analyses estimating language development rates. Associations between language outcomes and first-year post-activation appointment measures, clinical factors, and socioeconomic variables were evaluated using nonparametric tests and linear regression. Results: Post-activation appointment count emerged as the factor most consistently associated with language outcomes. Higher appointment attendance was associated with higher receptive and expressive language scores beginning approximately one year after activation and persisting through later hearing-age intervals. Neurodevelopmental diagnosis was associated with lower receptive and expressive language scores at hearing age 4. In longitudinal analyses, appointment volume remained significantly associated with expressive language development rate after adjustment for available covariates. Receptive language outcomes demonstrated greater variability across hearing ages, and no variables were significantly associated with receptive language development rate. Conclusions: Higher appointment attendance was consistently associated with more favorable language outcomes following pediatric cochlear implantation. Whether this association reflects increased rehabilitation exposure, broader family and social factors, or a combination of these influences remains uncertain.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 目的：儿童人工耳蜗植入后的语言结果差异很大，且不能完全由既定的临床因素（如植入年龄和神经发育合并症）解释。本研究探讨了选定的临床、社会经济和预约相关因素与人工耳蜗植入后接受性和表达性语言结果之间的关联。方法：我们对患有先天性双侧重度至极重度感音神经性听力损失、接受人工耳蜗植入、术后接受听觉口语治疗并使用学前语言量表第五版完成植入后语言评估的儿童进行了一项回顾性队列研究。在激活后两年内分析了接受性和表达性语言年龄当量分数（n = 36）。至少两次植入后语言评估可用的儿童亚组（n = 17）被纳入估计语言发展率的二次分析。使用非参数检验和线性回归评估语言结果与激活后第一年预约措施、临床因素和社会经济变量之间的关联。结果：激活后预约次数成为与语言结果最一致相关的因素。较高的预约出勤率与激活后约一年开始并持续到较晚听力年龄区间的较高接受性和表达性语言分数相关。神经发育诊断与听力年龄4时较低的接受性和表达性语言分数相关。在纵向分析中，在调整可用协变量后，预约量仍与表达性语言发展率显著相关。接受性语言结果在不同听力年龄表现出更大的变异性，且没有变量与接受性语言发展率显著相关。结论：较高的预约出勤率与儿童人工耳蜗植入后更有利的语言结果一致相关。这种关联是否反映了康复暴露增加、更广泛的家庭和社会因素，或这些影响的组合仍不确定。

articles.title_en: Prevalence of high risk for obstructive sleep apnea and its impact on quality of life in children with overweight and obesity
articles.title_cn: 超重和肥胖儿童阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停高风险的患病率及其对生活质量的影响
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Study objectives: To determine the prevalence of high risk for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) in children with overweight and obesity and evaluate its impact on quality of life. Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional study of children aged 2–12 years diagnosed with overweight or obesity according to World Health Organization body mass index-for-age z-scores (BMIz). OSA risk and quality of life were assessed using the Thai version of the Pediatric Obstructive Sleep Apnea Screening Tool (POSAST) and the OSA-18 questionnaire, respectively. Physical examination included standardized tonsillar assessment using the Brodsky grading scale. Logistic regression models adjusted for potential confounders were applied in the data analyses. Results: Among 68 children with overweight and obesity, the prevalence of high OSA risk was 41.2% based on POSAST criteria. Tonsillar hypertrophy was the strongest predictor of high OSA risk (adjusted OR: 10.92, 95% CI: 3.04–39.15, p < 0.001). Twenty-one percent of children experienced moderate to severe quality-of-life impairment. High OSA risk (adjusted OR: 14.59, 95% CI: 1.94–109.86, p = 0.009) and attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (adjusted OR: 11.84, 95% CI: 1.52–92.14, p = 0.02) were independently associated with diminished quality of life after controlling for age, sex, and obesity severity. Conclusions: High OSA risk is prevalent among Thai children with overweight and obesity and significantly impairs their quality of life. Tonsillar hypertrophy represents a major treatable risk factor. These findings underscore the need for systematic OSA screening in pediatric obesity clinics and integration of quality-of-life assessments into routine clinical practice.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 研究目标：确定超重和肥胖儿童中阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停 (OSA) 高风险的患病率，并评估其对生活质量的影响。方法：我们对根据世界卫生组织年龄体重指数 z 分数 (BMIz) 诊断为超重或肥胖的 2-12 岁儿童进行了横断面研究。分别使用泰国版儿科阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停筛查工具 (POSAST) 和 OSA-18 调查问卷评估 OSA 风险和生活质量。体检包括使用布罗茨基分级量表进行标准化扁桃体评估。在数据分析中应用了针对潜在混杂因素进行调整的逻辑回归模型。结果：根据 POSAST 标准，在超重和肥胖的 68 名儿童中，OSA 高风险患病率为 41.2%。扁桃体肥大是 OSA 高风险的最强预测因子（调整后 OR：10.92，95% CI：3.04-39.15，p < 0.001）。百分之二十一的儿童经历中度至重度生活质量受损。高 OSA 风险（调整后 OR：14.59、95% CI：1.94-109.86、p = 0.009）和注意力缺陷多动障碍（调整后 OR：11.84、95% CI：1.52-92.14、p = 0.02）是独立的在控制年龄、性别和肥胖严重程度后，与生活质量下降相关。结论：泰国超重和肥胖儿童普遍存在高 OSA 风险，并严重影响他们的生活质量。扁桃体肥大是一个主要的可治疗危险因素。这些发现强调了在儿科肥胖诊所进行系统性 OSA 筛查以及将生活质量评估纳入常规临床实践的必要性。

articles.title_en: Global-local synergistic fine-tuning of DINOv3 for underwater instance segmentation
articles.title_cn: 全局-局部协同微调DINOv3用于水下实例分割
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Underwater instance segmentation is crucial for marine exploration but faces severe challenges caused by underwater imaging degradation and complex background interference. Directly applying parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) such as LoRA to fundamental models like DINOv3 suffers from a homogenization defect, making it difficult to simultaneously address domain shift and background noise. To overcome these limitations, we propose a Global-Local Synergistic PEFT for adapting DINOv3 to underwater instance segmentation. Our framework integrates two complementary fine-tuning mechanisms. On one hand, we retain LoRA in selected Transformer layers to globally adapt pre-trained general knowledge to the underwater domain. On the other hand, we introduce a novel Foreground-Guided Region-Restricted Attention (FG-RRA) mechanism into some other layers to enhance foreground representations and suppress complex background interference. By jointly bridging the global domain gap and enhancing localized foreground representations, the proposed method significantly improves the adaptability of DINOv3 for underwater instance segmentation. Extensive experiments and ablation studies on the challenging UIIS dataset demonstrate its effectiveness.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 水下实例分割对海洋探索至关重要，但面临水下成像退化和复杂背景干扰带来的严峻挑战。直接将参数高效微调（PEFT）如LoRA应用于基础模型（如DINOv3）存在同质化缺陷，难以同时解决域偏移和背景噪声问题。为克服这些限制，我们提出了一种全局-局部协同PEFT方法，用于将DINOv3适配到水下实例分割。我们的框架整合了两种互补的微调机制。一方面，我们在选定的Transformer层中保留LoRA，以将预训练的通用知识全局适配到水下领域。另一方面，我们在其他一些层中引入一种新颖的前景引导区域限制注意力（FG-RRA）机制，以增强前景表示并抑制复杂背景干扰。通过联合弥合全局域差距和增强局部前景表示，所提方法显著提高了DINOv3在水下实例分割中的适应性。在具有挑战性的UIIS数据集上的大量实验和消融研究证明了其有效性。

articles.title_en: Employment aspirations of young agroindustry workers in Peru – Poverty, gender and role models
articles.title_cn: 秘鲁年轻农业产业工人的就业期望——贫困、性别与榜样角色
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations Aspirations are a key dimension of wellbeing but remain underexplored among agrifood system workers. This study examines the employment aspirations of 528 young individuals in Peru who intended to work in the horticultural agro-industry, using two-round panel survey data and econometric methods. Between survey rounds, 414 respondents entered employment for the first time, allowing us to analyze how early labor market experiences shape aspirations related to income, occupation, and promotion. We assess how aspirations are influenced by gender, poverty status, and the presence of workplace role models. The findings show that agro-industry jobs can raise aspirations and help reduce gender- and poverty-related gaps. Supervisors—especially those who are female and age-proximate—play a significant role in shaping youth aspirations, particularly for women. The study highlights the potential of targeted employment strategies, such as thoughtful supervisor-worker matching as practical tools to promote more equitable labor outcomes and foster upward mobility among rural youth.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 联合国粮食及农业组织 期望是福祉的一个关键维度，但在农业食品系统工人中仍未得到充分探讨。本研究利用两轮面板调查数据和计量经济学方法，考察了秘鲁528名打算从事园艺农业产业工作的年轻人的就业期望。在调查轮次之间，414名受访者首次进入就业状态，使我们能够分析早期劳动力市场经历如何塑造与收入、职业和晋升相关的期望。我们评估了性别、贫困状况以及工作场所榜样角色的存在如何影响这些期望。研究结果表明，农业产业工作可以提高期望，并有助于缩小与性别和贫困相关的差距。主管——尤其是女性且年龄相近的主管——在塑造青年期望方面发挥着重要作用，特别是对女性而言。该研究强调了有针对性的就业策略的潜力，例如深思熟虑的主管与工人匹配，作为促进更公平的劳动成果和促进农村青年向上流动的实用工具。

articles.title_en: Mandibular distraction osteogenesis in Robin sequence: identifying the optimal timing: A systematic review
You can see me: Retrieval-augmented framework for divergent perception in animal art generation
articles.title_cn: 你能看见我：动物艺术生成中发散感知的检索增强框架
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Generative AI can create striking visuals from text, yet it still struggles with a core aspect of human creativity: interpreting ambiguous forms. Inspired by pareidolia and divergent perception, we present the Silhouette-Enabled Expression with Meaningful Exploration (SEEME) framework, which enables creative generation directly from object silhouettes. SEEME explores two strategies, Visual-RAG and Semantic-RAG, to produce diverse animal art interpretations while preserving shape fidelity. Experiments on our dataset of 28,586 masked animal images, validate the framework’s aesthetic quality and shape fidelity, while revealing trade-offs between generative and retrieval-based approaches. This work opens a new direction for perceptually grounded creative AI, extending machine creativity beyond rendering toward imaginative discovery.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 生成式人工智能可以从文本创造出引人注目的视觉内容，但它仍然难以应对人类创造力的一个核心方面：解读模糊形式。受空想性错视和发散感知的启发，我们提出了剪影启用表达与有意义探索（SEEME）框架，该框架能够直接从物体剪影进行创造性生成。SEEME探索了两种策略，即视觉检索增强生成（Visual-RAG）和语义检索增强生成（Semantic-RAG），以在保持形状保真度的同时产生多样化的动物艺术诠释。在我们包含28,586张掩膜动物图像的数据集上的实验验证了该框架的美学质量和形状保真度，同时揭示了生成式方法与基于检索的方法之间的权衡。这项工作为基于感知的创造性人工智能开辟了新方向，将机器创造力从渲染扩展到想象性发现。

articles.title_en: Recognizing geochemical anomalies by locally selective combination of parallel autoencoders: Integrating AE, VAE, and AE-1SVM for robust metal exploration targeting
articles.title_cn: 通过并行自编码器的局部选择性组合识别地球化学异常：集成AE、VAE和AE-1SVM以实现稳健的金属勘探靶区圈定
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Deep learning (DL) models have become leading techniques for recognizing mineralization-related geochemical anomalies because they can learn deep feature representations of multi-element geochemical data arising from nonlinear Earth systems and complex statistical distributions. Among different DL techniques, autoencoder-backbone models are particularly attractive for geochemical exploration because they operate in an unsupervised manner and thus bypass the practical limitations of supervised strategies that require labeled training datasets. However, a critical challenge in geochemical anomaly detection is the model-based uncertainty imposed by the fact that different autoencoder-based detectors may generate inconsistent anomaly patterns within distinct geological architectures and highly complex frequency distributions. This issue may mislead metal exploration targeting when an anomaly map derived from a single model is used to delimit target areas. To address this model-based uncertainty, in this research, we propose the locally selective combination of parallel autoencoders (LSCPAE), which integrates three autoencoder-backbone anomaly detectors—autoencoder (AE), variational autoencoder (VAE), and autoencoder-based one-class support vector machine (AE-1SVM)—through the locally selective combination of parallel outlier ensembles (LSCP) strategy. The proposed workflow is applied to the stream sediment geochemical data pertaining to the Feizabad district, NE Iran, where anomaly scores from AE, VAE, AE-1SVM, and LSCPAE models are mapped to delineate spatial patterns favorable for gold-copper exploration. Performance appraisal through success rate curves indicates that the LSCPAE-derived anomaly map delivers a superior targeting performance than stand-alone autoencoder-backbone scenarios and soft voting technique (as a global ensemble strategy). The results suggest that the LSCPAE model can effectively reduce model-based uncertainty and provide lower-risk grounds for further metal exploration.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 深度学习（DL）模型已成为识别与矿化相关地球化学异常的主导技术，因为它们能够学习由非线性地球系统和复杂统计分布引起的多元素地球化学数据的深层特征表示。在各类深度学习技术中，自编码器骨干模型在地球化学勘探中尤为引人注目，因为它们以无监督方式运行，从而绕过了需要标记训练数据集的监督策略的实际限制。然而，地球化学异常检测中的一个关键挑战是基于模型的不确定性，这种不确定性源于不同的自编码器检测器可能在不同的地质构造和高度复杂的频率分布中产生不一致的异常模式。当使用单一模型生成的异常图来圈定靶区时，这一问题可能误导金属勘探靶区选择。为解决这种基于模型的不确定性，本研究提出了并行自编码器的局部选择性组合（LSCPAE），该方法通过并行异常集成的局部选择性组合（LSCP）策略，集成了三种自编码器骨干异常检测器——自编码器（AE）、变分自编码器（VAE）和基于自编码器的一类支持向量机（AE-1SVM）。所提出的工作流程应用于伊朗东北部费扎巴德地区的河流沉积物地球化学数据，其中来自AE、VAE、AE-1SVM和LSCPAE模型的异常分数被映射以描绘有利于金铜勘探的空间模式。通过成功率曲线进行的性能评估表明，LSCPAE衍生的异常图比独立自编码器骨干方案和软投票技术（作为全局集成策略）提供了更优越的靶区圈定性能。结果表明，LSCPAE模型能有效降低基于模型的不确定性，并为进一步的金属勘探提供更低风险的基础。

articles.title_en: Generative age-aware data augmentation for cross-generation kinship verification
articles.title_cn: 生成式年龄感知数据增强用于跨代亲属关系验证
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Cross-generation kinship verification is fundamentally limited by the scarcity of training pairs that exhibit extreme age variations. To bridge this gap, we introduce a generative data augmentation framework that explicitly enriches the age diversity within each kinship pair. A face generative model is first used to create a set of synthetic facial variations for each subject, aimed at constructing an age-diverse sample bank prior to training. From this bank, region-aware composition synthesizes novel facial variants, creating a continuous spectrum of age appearances for training. To preserve kinship-relevant identity information across this synthesized spectrum, we introduce a synthetic consistency constraint, which anchors the learning process by enforcing feature-level proximity between original and generated images of the same identity, ensuring that age augmentation strengthens, rather than distorts, the core kinship relationship. When integrated into existing kinship verification frameworks, our approach achieves consistent and significant performance improvements across three large-scale benchmark datasets under various baseline models. Evaluated on the FIW dataset—the most widely used benchmark in kinship recognition—our framework yields an average accuracy gain of 1.1% compared to current state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, with improvements in specific categories reaching up to 2.1% in the most challenging cross-generation tasks.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 跨代亲属关系验证从根本上受到展现极端年龄差异的训练对稀缺性的限制。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了一种生成式数据增强框架，明确丰富每个亲属对中的年龄多样性。首先使用面部生成模型为每个主体创建一组合成面部变化，旨在训练前构建一个年龄多样化的样本库。从该库中，区域感知合成生成新颖的面部变体，为训练创建连续的年龄外观谱系。为在合成谱系中保留与亲属相关的身份信息，我们引入了一种合成一致性约束，通过强制原始图像与生成图像在同一身份下的特征级接近性来锚定学习过程，确保年龄增强强化而非扭曲核心亲属关系。当集成到现有亲属关系验证框架中时，我们的方法在三个大规模基准数据集上、多种基线模型下实现了持续且显著的性能提升。在FIW数据集（亲属关系识别中最广泛使用的基准）上评估，我们的框架相比当前最先进（SOTA）方法平均准确率提升1.1%，在最具挑战性的跨代任务中，特定类别的提升最高可达2.1%。

articles.title_en: Bridging the gap: how renewable energy development reduces urban-rural income inequality in China
articles.title_cn: 弥合差距：可再生能源发展如何缩小中国城乡收入不平等
articles.abstract_en: Renewable energy development is central to climate change mitigation, but whether it also reduces urban–rural income inequality remains unclear. Using panel data for 271 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2005 to 2019, we combine two-way fixed-effects models with an instrumental-variable strategy to estimate the effect of renewable energy development on the urban–rural income gap. The results show that renewable energy development significantly reduces urban–rural income inequality: a one-standard-deviation increase lowers the gap by about 11%, and this finding remains robust across multiple robustness checks. The effect is more evident in regions with richer solar resources, lower fossil energy dependence, and lower urbanization levels. Mechanism analyses further suggest that this effect operates by improving rural employment and enhancing educational accessibility in rural areas. We also find that the inequality-reducing effect is significantly strengthened in regions with more developed green finance, highlighting the enabling role of green finance in renewable expansion. These findings show that renewable energy development can generate both climate and equity gains, with important implications for coordinated urban–rural development. We therefore recommend prioritizing renewable projects in rural areas with strong resource endowments and lower urbanization levels, while strengthening green finance systems to support more inclusive development.
articles.abstract_cn: 可再生能源发展是减缓气候变化的核心，但它是否也能缩小城乡收入不平等仍不清楚。利用2005年至2019年中国271个地级市的面板数据，我们将双向固定效应模型与工具变量策略相结合，估计可再生能源发展对城乡收入差距的影响。结果表明，可再生能源发展显著缩小了城乡收入不平等：一个标准差增加会使差距降低约11%，且这一发现在多种稳健性检验中依然成立。该效应在太阳能资源更丰富、化石能源依赖度更低以及城市化水平较低的地区更为明显。机制分析进一步表明，这一效应通过改善农村就业和提升农村教育可及性发挥作用。我们还发现，在绿色金融更发达的地区，缩小不平等的效应显著增强，凸显了绿色金融在可再生能源扩张中的支持作用。这些发现表明，可再生能源发展可以同时带来气候和公平收益，对城乡协调发展具有重要意义。因此，我们建议优先在资源禀赋强、城市化水平低的农村地区部署可再生能源项目，同时加强绿色金融体系以支持更具包容性的发展。

articles.title_en: Coups d’état and the informal economy
articles.title_cn: 政变与非正规经济
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the effect of coups d’état on the size of the informal economy in a large sample of 98 developing countries observed over the period 1993–2020. Using a matched difference-in-differences approach that combines a two-way fixed effects model with entropy balancing, we find that the occurrence of a coup d’état significantly increases the size of the informal economy. This result is robust across a variety of tests, including event-study analysis, propensity score matching, treatment effect methods based on inverse probability weighting, generalized method of moments estimation, fixed-effects regressions, a falsification test, checks for potential omitted variables, alternative data sources for coups d’état, the exclusion of nonmilitary coups, and accounting for coup d’état spillover effects. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the detrimental effect of coups d’état holds for both successful and failed coups and is influenced by structural factors. Specifically, the effect decreases with higher levels of domestic credit to the private sector, remittances, quality of regulation, and net official development assistance received. Conversely, the effect increases with higher real GDP per capita, democracy, unemployment, oil rents, and income inequality. Higher external debt, lower gross fixed capital formation, and erosion of democracy are the main channels through which coups d’état expand the informal economy in developing countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了在1993-2020年期间观察到的98个发展中国家中，政变对非正规经济规模的影响。采用结合双向固定效应模型与熵平衡的匹配双重差分方法，我们发现政变的发生显著增加了非正规经济的规模。这一结果在多种检验中均保持稳健，包括事件研究分析、倾向得分匹配、基于逆概率加权的处理效应方法、广义矩估计、固定效应回归、证伪检验、潜在遗漏变量检查、政变替代数据来源、排除非军事政变以及考虑政变溢出效应。异质性分析表明，政变的不利影响在成功和失败的政变中均存在，并受结构性因素影响。具体而言，该效应随着国内私人部门信贷、汇款、监管质量和收到的净官方发展援助水平的提高而减弱。相反，该效应随着实际人均GDP、民主程度、失业率、石油租金和收入不平等的提高而增强。较高的外债、较低的固定资本形成总额和民主侵蚀是政变在发展中国家扩大非正规经济的主要渠道。

articles.title_en: Groundwater pH buffering in carbonate aquifers exposed to high-calcium ash backfill
articles.title_cn: 高钙灰回填暴露下碳酸盐含水层的地下水pH缓冲作用
articles.abstract_en: High-calcium ashes are known to produce highly alkaline leachates in laboratory settings, which has raised concerns regarding potential groundwater impacts when such ashes are used in mine backfills. In this study, we evaluated the effect of a high-calcium oil-shale ash backfill on groundwater pH in carbonate aquifers using an integrated approach combining geochemical modelling with a two-year field experiment. The backfill was injected into an abandoned mine drift in northeastern Estonia, and groundwater was monitored using continuous automatic sensors complemented by periodic sampling. Laboratory leaching tests confirmed the ash backfill has the potential to increase leachate pH values to above 12.5. However, geochemical modelling predicted rapid attenuation of alkalinity through buffering by bicarbonate in the carbonate aquifer, resulting in only minor pH changes restricted to the immediate vicinity of the backfill. Field observations corroborated the model predictions, showing no significant increase in pH in monitoring wells located 10 m from the backfill body. Instead of pH elevation, the most notable geochemical response in groundwater was an increase in sulphate concentrations. The results demonstrate that carbonate aquifers possess a strong natural buffering capacity that effectively mitigates the high alkalinity introduced by high-calcium ash backfill leachate. Although based on a single field site and therefore not directly generalisable to all carbonate mining settings, our results indicate that high-calcium industrial byproducts may be reused for mine reclamation with limited pH effects, while SO42− enrichment emerged as the dominant groundwater response. Future backfilling operations should account for the potential increase in dissolved SO42− in adjacent groundwater and incorporate sulphate-focused monitoring and mitigation measures into the design.
articles.abstract_cn: 已知高钙灰在实验室条件下会产生高碱性渗滤液，这引发了对此类灰用于矿山回填时对地下水潜在影响的担忧。在本研究中，我们结合地球化学模拟与为期两年的现场实验，评估了高钙油页岩灰回填对碳酸盐含水层地下水pH的影响。回填物被注入爱沙尼亚东北部一处废弃矿井巷道，并通过连续自动传感器辅以定期采样对地下水进行监测。实验室浸出试验证实，灰回填有潜力将渗滤液pH值提升至12.5以上。然而，地球化学模拟预测，通过碳酸盐含水层中碳酸氢盐的缓冲作用，碱度将快速衰减，导致pH仅发生微小变化，且仅限于回填体附近区域。现场观测结果与模型预测一致，显示距回填体10米处的监测井中pH无显著升高。地下水中最显著的地球化学响应并非pH升高，而是硫酸盐浓度的增加。结果表明，碳酸盐含水层具有强大的自然缓冲能力，可有效缓解高钙灰回填渗滤液引入的高碱度。尽管本研究基于单一现场，不能直接推广至所有碳酸盐矿区环境，但我们的结果表明，高钙工业副产品可用于矿山修复且pH影响有限，而SO42−富集成为地下水的主要响应。未来的回填作业应考虑邻近地下水中溶解性SO42−的潜在增加，并在设计中纳入以硫酸盐为重点的监测和缓解措施。

articles.title_en: REE and radioelement enrichment in heavy-mineral coastal placers: An integrated geophysical–geochemical synthesis from the eastern coast of India
articles.title_cn: 重矿物海岸砂矿中的REE与放射性元素富集：来自印度东海岸的综合地球物理-地球化学研究
articles.abstract_en: This study presents a data integrated synthesis with new analytical results for mineral exploration along the eastern fringe of Peninsular India, focusing on heavy mineral rich coastal placer systems of Odisha. Rather than a standalone case study, the work combines previously published datasets with newly acquired field measurements and laboratory analyses to develop a unified understanding of the spatial distribution, subsurface architecture and geochemical characteristics of these placers. Non-invasive two-dimensional electrical resistivity imaging conducted along >40 km of coastline (including newly acquired profiles) delineates laterally continuous low-resistivity zones (0.1-1.1 Ω m) extending to depths of ∼20-25 m, interpreted as heavy mineral concentrations dominated by ilmenite and rutile. Near river mouths, these conductive zones occur as deeper, discontinuous pockets, reflecting localized depositional controls. Previously published radiometric datasets are integrated to the geoelectrical framework which enabled a robust multi-proxy comparison. The beach placers show elevated thorium and comparatively low uranium and potassium concentrations. Laboratory geochemical analyses, expanded through new datasets, indicate substantial enrichment of rare earth elements (REEs), with an average total REE concentration of 4243 ppm, approximately 29 times the upper continental crustal average (LREE > HREE). Inter-method comparison of REE concentrations obtained through ICP-MS and instrumental neutron activation analysis yields strong correlations (R2 = 0.6–0.8), confirming analytical robustness. A consistent positive relationship between thorium and total REE concentrations highlights the potential of thorium as an effective first-pass proxy for REE exploration. By explicitly integrating legacy datasets with new observations, this study establishes a process-based, multi-proxy exploration framework, advancing regional placer exploration models and providing an approach applicable to analogous coastal systems worldwide.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究针对印度半岛东部边缘的矿产勘探，聚焦于奥里萨邦富含重矿物的海岸砂矿系统，提出了一种数据集成综合方法并包含新的分析结果。本研究并非孤立的案例研究，而是将已发表的数据集与新获取的野外测量和实验室分析相结合，以形成对这些砂矿的空间分布、地下结构和地球化学特征的统一认识。沿超过40公里的海岸线进行的非侵入性二维电阻率成像（包括新获取的剖面）描绘了横向连续的低电阻率区域（0.1-1.1 Ω·m），延伸至约20-25米的深度，被解释为以钛铁矿和金红石为主的重矿物富集区。在河口附近，这些导电区域表现为更深、不连续的囊状体，反映了局部的沉积控制作用。将先前发表的辐射测量数据集整合到地电框架中，实现了稳健的多代理比较。海滩砂矿显示出较高的钍浓度，以及相对较低的铀和钾浓度。通过新数据集扩展的实验室地球化学分析表明，稀土元素（REEs）显著富集，平均总REE浓度为4243 ppm，约为上地壳平均值的29倍（轻稀土 > 重稀土）。通过ICP-MS和仪器中子活化分析获得的REE浓度之间的方法间比较显示出强相关性（R² = 0.6-0.8），证实了分析的稳健性。钍与总REE浓度之间的一致正相关关系凸显了钍作为REE勘探有效初步代理的潜力。通过明确整合遗留数据集与新观测结果，本研究建立了一个基于过程的多代理勘探框架，推进了区域砂矿勘探模型，并提供了一种适用于全球类似海岸系统的方法。

articles.title_en: Use of palliative care services in NICU patients undergoing tracheostomy: Enhancing decision-making and care with an underutilized discipline
articles.title_cn: 在 NICU 接受气管切开术的患者中使用姑息治疗服务：通过未充分利用的学科加强决策和护理
articles.abstract_en: IntroductionPalliative care provides a proactive, family-centered approach for infants with life-threatening conditions. We examined the frequency of palliative care consultations among NICU tracheostomy patients and their associated demographics, hypothesizing that it is mainly used for high-risk infants but could benefit a broader group. MethodsCharts of all NICU patients who underwent tracheostomy between 1/1/2012-12/31/2020 at a tertiary care NICU were reviewed for demographics, comorbidities, and palliative care consults. Outcomes were compared for preoperative consult vs. no-consult groups using chi-square and fisher's exact tests, with significance set at p < 0.05. ResultsAmong 171 infants, 13.5% received perioperative palliative care consults. Sex did not differ, but race did (p < 0.001), with African-American/Black infants predominating. Infants receiving palliative care consults had greater gestational age (36.7 vs 32.5 weeks, p = 0.02), more neurologic indications (43.5% vs 17.5%, p = 0.01), and fewer cardiac (21.9% vs 57.1%, p = 0.002) and pulmonary comorbidities (34.8% vs 59.1%, p = 0.04). Median rates of perioperative consults were higher in the consulted group (15 vs 13, p = 0.04). No differences were seen in rates of discharge on a ventilator (95.6% vs 80.5%, p = 0.1), 1-year decannulation (0% vs 3.4%, p = 1), or mortality (4.4% vs 12.2%, p = 0.5). At 5 years, palliative care patients were less likely to be decannulated (4.35% vs 35.81%, p = 0.001), with no differences in mortality (47.83% vs 32.43%, p = 0.2). ConclusionsPalliative care was underutilized in NICU tracheostomy patients. Consults were more frequent in neurologic cases and less common in cardiac, pulmonary, or anatomic obstruction, despite similarly complex post-discharge courses. Expanding palliative care access in this population could improve family-centered decision-making, coordination, and long-term planning.
articles.abstract_cn: 简介姑息治疗为患有危及生命的婴儿提供了一种积极主动、以家庭为中心的方法。我们研究了 NICU 气管切开患者的姑息治疗咨询频率及其相关人口统计数据，假设它主要用于高危婴儿，但可能使更广泛的群体受益。方法对1/1/2012-12/31/2020期间在三级护理 NICU 接受气管造口术的所有 NICU 患者的人口统计、合并症和姑息治疗咨询情况进行了回顾。使用卡方检验和 Fisher 精确检验比较术前咨询组与未咨询组的结果，显着性设置为 p < 0.05。结果 171 名婴儿中，13.5% 接受了围手术期姑息治疗咨询。性别没有差异，但种族有差异（p < 0.001），其中非洲裔美国人/黑人婴儿占主导地位。接受姑息治疗咨询的婴儿胎龄较长（36.7 vs 32.5周，p = 0.02），更多神经系统症状（43.5% vs 17.5%，p = 0.01），心脏症状较少（21.9% vs 57.1%，p = 0.002）和肺部合并症（34.8% vs 59.1%，p = 0.04）。会诊组围手术期会诊的中位率较高（15 vs 13，p = 0.04）。呼吸机出院率（95.6% vs 80.5%，p = 0.1）、1年拔管率（0% vs 3.4%，p = 1）或死亡率（4.4% vs 12.2%，p = 0.5）没有差异。在5年，姑息治疗患者拔管的可能性较小（4.35% vs 35.81%，p = 0.001），死亡率没有差异（47.83% vs 32.43%，p = 0.2）。结论 NICU 气管切开患者的姑息治疗未得到充分利用。尽管出院后的疗程同样复杂，但神经系统病例的会诊频率更高，而心脏、肺部或解剖学阻塞的病例则较少见。扩大这一人群的姑息治疗可及性可以改善以家庭为中心的决策、协调和长期规划。

articles.title_en: Enhancing visual feature attribution via weighted integrated gradients
articles.title_cn: 通过加权积分梯度增强视觉特征归因
articles.abstract_en: Integrated Gradients (IG) is a widely used attribution method in explainable AI, particularly in computer vision applications where reliable feature attribution is essential. A key limitation of IG is its sensitivity to the choice of baseline (reference) images. Multi-baseline extensions such as Expected Gradients (EG) assume uniform weighting over baselines, implicitly treating all baseline images as equally informative. In high-dimensional vision models, this assumption often leads to noisy or unstable explanations. This paper proposes Weighted Integrated Gradients (WG), a principled approach that evaluates and weights baselines to enhance attribution reliability. WG introduces an unsupervised criterion for baseline suitability, enabling adaptive selection and weighting of baselines on a per-input basis. The method preserves the core axiomatic properties of IG in a generalized weighted-baseline form. Under an expected, proxy-based fitness–relevance monotonicity assumption, WG provides a probabilistic justification for assigning larger weights to more informative baselines. Experiments on commonly used image datasets and models show that WG improves over EG under our protocol, with up to 36% gains across evaluated convolutional and Transformer architectures. These gains come with additional fitness-evaluation cost, so WG should be viewed as an attribution-fidelity trade-off rather than a faster alternative to EG. By moving beyond the assumption that all baselines contribute equally, Weighted Integrated Gradients offers a clearer and more reliable approach to explaining computer-vision models, improving both understanding and practical usability in explainable AI.
articles.abstract_cn: 积分梯度（IG）是可解释人工智能中广泛使用的归因方法，尤其在计算机视觉应用中，可靠的特性归因至关重要。IG的一个关键限制是其对基线（参考）图像选择的敏感性。多基线扩展如期望梯度（EG）假设基线均匀加权，隐含地认为所有基线图像具有同等信息量。在高维视觉模型中，这一假设常导致解释噪声大或不稳定。本文提出加权积分梯度（WG），一种原则性方法，评估并加权基线以增强归因可靠性。WG引入了一种无监督的基线适用性标准，能够针对每个输入自适应选择和加权基线。该方法在广义加权基线形式下保留了IG的核心公理性质。在预期的、基于代理的适应度-相关性单调性假设下，WG为分配更大权重给信息量更大的基线提供了概率上的合理性。在常用图像数据集和模型上的实验表明，在我们的协议下，WG优于EG，在评估的卷积和Transformer架构中最高提升达36%。这些提升伴随着额外的适应度评估成本，因此WG应被视为归因保真度的权衡，而非EG的更快替代方案。通过超越所有基线贡献相等的假设，加权积分梯度为解释计算机视觉模型提供了一种更清晰、更可靠的方法，提高了可解释人工智能中的理解和实际可用性。

articles.title_en: Environmental controls on methyl <ce:italic>tert</ce:italic>-butyl ether (MTBE) interphase redistribution in compacted low-permeability soils
articles.title_cn: 环境控制对压实低渗透性土壤中甲基叔丁基醚（MTBE）相间再分配的影响
articles.abstract_en: Methyl tert-butyl ether (MTBE), a volatile and relatively water-soluble LNAPL compound, can partition into free, dissolved, vapor, and adsorbed states after release; however, quantitative evidence for how environmental controls drive redistribution in low-permeability soils remains limited. This study develops a sequential multi-phase NAPL extraction and analysis framework to quantify MTBE interphase distribution in compacted soils subjected to controlled thermal, hygroscopic, and compaction conditions. The method enables direct quantification of all four phase reservoirs, allowing phase-specific evaluation of environmental impacts on interphase redistribution. Across the full range of conditions tested, the vapor phase accounted for nearly all contaminant mass, whereas free phase accumulation was thermodynamically unfavorable under the tested conditions. Adsorbed and dissolved fractions acted as environmentally responsive reservoirs that were systematically displaced toward the vapor domain, indicating that vapor management governs mass reduction in compacted low-permeability matrices. Interphase redistribution showed strong directional responses, increasing temperature suppressed adsorbed and dissolved fractions through desorption, volatilization, and strengthened gas-water partitioning; rising relative humidity reduced sorption and expanded aqueous retention; and increasing dry density restricted pore water connectivity and favored gas-associated storage. Machine learning analysis confirmed temperature as the dominant driver of adsorbed phase behavior, while dissolved phase variability depended jointly on temperature, humidity, and dry density, revealing marked non-additive interactions. Molecular simulations corroborated weakened adsorption affinity, moisture-enhanced diffusion pathways, and confinement-regulated mobility, providing nanoscale evidence for desorption-controlled phase evolution. The combined experimental, modeling, and molecular results provide a mechanistic basis for designing MTBE remediation strategies in low-permeability source zones, especially those emphasizing vapor-phase removal and environmental regulation. Extension to other LNAPL compounds should consider compound-specific differences in volatility, aqueous solubility, and hydrophobicity.
articles.abstract_cn: 甲基叔丁基醚（MTBE）是一种挥发性且相对水溶性的LNAPL化合物，释放后可分配至自由态、溶解态、蒸气态和吸附态；然而，关于环境控制如何驱动低渗透性土壤中再分配的定量证据仍然有限。本研究开发了一种顺序多相NAPL提取与分析框架，以量化在受控热、吸湿和压实条件下压实土壤中MTBE的相间分布。该方法能够直接量化所有四个相储层，从而实现对环境影响的相特定评估。在测试的全部条件范围内，蒸气相几乎占所有污染物质量，而自由相积累在测试条件下热力学上不利。吸附和溶解部分作为环境响应储层，被系统地驱向蒸气域，表明蒸气管理主导了压实低渗透性基质中的质量减少。相间再分配表现出强烈的方向性响应：温度升高通过解吸、挥发和增强的气-水分配抑制了吸附和溶解部分；相对湿度上升减少了吸附并扩大了水相保留；干密度增加限制了孔隙水连通性并有利于气体相关储存。机器学习分析确认温度是吸附相行为的主要驱动因素，而溶解相变异性依赖于温度、湿度和干密度的联合作用，揭示了显著的非加性交互作用。分子模拟证实了吸附亲和力减弱、水分增强的扩散路径以及限制调控的迁移性，为解吸控制的相演化提供了纳米尺度证据。实验、建模和分子结果的结合为设计低渗透性源区MTBE修复策略提供了机制基础，尤其是强调蒸气相去除和环境调控的策略。扩展到其他LNAPL化合物应考虑挥发性、水溶性和疏水性方面的化合物特定差异。

articles.title_en: Hydrochar-Amended bioreactors for passive treatment of acid mine drainage
articles.title_cn: 水热炭改良生物反应器用于酸性矿山排水的被动处理
articles.abstract_en: This study was based on a batch bioreactor experiment to investigate the effectiveness of using hydrochar as an amendment to promote the growth of sulfate-reducing bacteria (SRB) in acid mine drainage (AMD) treatment, with a primary focus on Copper (Cu), Zinc (Zn) and Cadmium (Cd) removal. This study evaluated the effect of hydrochar amendment in reducing bioreactors utilizing a mixture of organic substrates such as cow manure, maple woodchips, and cornflour acquired from a local granary, blended with hydrochar in triplicate, varying the amount of hydrochar: 0%, 5%, 10%, and 20% of the total volume in the bioreactors. Bioreactors were operated for 98 days, and water quality parameters (pH, ORP, sulfate, total sulfur, metal concentration, COD) were analyzed periodically to determine the effect of variation in bioreactor substrate. Additionally, 16S rRNA sequencing was used to determine the presence of SRB in the bioreactors at the end of the tests. The results suggested that bioreactors without hydrochar content performed better in raising pH and removing metals, likely as metal sulfides, with removal percentages of Cu (89–100%), Zn (97–100%), Cd (100%), and sulfate (50–100%), following the removal trend of Cd > Zn > Cu. Statistical analysis results demonstrated no significant influence of hydrochar on metal removal (p > 0.05), but time had a significant effect (p < 0.05), indicating that removal effectiveness improved with time regardless of hydrochar quantity. The presence of SRB was confirmed in all bioreactors, although their relative abundance varied across treatments.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究基于批量生物反应器实验，探讨使用水热炭作为改良剂促进酸性矿山排水（AMD）处理中硫酸盐还原菌（SRB）生长的有效性，主要关注铜（Cu）、锌（Zn）和镉（Cd）的去除。本研究评估了水热炭改良在还原性生物反应器中的效果，使用有机底物混合物如牛粪、枫木屑和从当地粮仓获取的玉米粉，与水热炭混合，设置三个重复，改变水热炭的量：占总反应器体积的0%、5%、10%和20%。生物反应器运行了98天，定期分析水质参数（pH、氧化还原电位、硫酸盐、总硫、金属浓度、化学需氧量）以确定反应器底物变化的影响。此外，使用16 rRNA测序在测试结束时确定生物反应器中SRB的存在。结果表明，不含水热炭的生物反应器在提高pH和去除金属方面表现更好，可能以金属硫化物的形式去除，去除百分比为Cu（89-100%）、Zn（97-100%）、Cd（100%）和硫酸盐（50-100%），遵循Cd > Zn > Cu的去除趋势。统计分析结果显示，水热炭对金属去除无显著影响（p > 0.05），但时间有显著影响（p < 0.05），表明无论水热炭量如何，去除效率随时间提高。所有生物反应器中均确认存在SRB，尽管其相对丰度在不同处理间有所变化。

articles.title_en: Long-term quality of life outcomes after tympanostomy tube by surgical indication
articles.title_cn: 鼓膜置管术后按手术指征分层的长期生活质量结局
articles.abstract_en: ObjectiveTo compare longitudinal quality of life (QOL) outcomes among pediatric patients undergoing tympanostomy tube placement (TTP) for recurrent acute otitis media alone (rAOM), both rAOM and other indication(s), and other indication(s) alone, using the Otitis Media–6 (OM-6) questionnaire. MethodsWe conducted a retrospective cohort study of children aged 0-6 years who underwent TTP at a tertiary pediatric center between January 2020 and August 2024. Inclusion required completion of both preoperative and postoperative OM-6 surveys. The primary outcome was change in total OM-6 score over time, assessed at 0-2, 2-6, 6-12, 12-18, and 18-24 months postoperatively. Analysis used inverse probability weighting and linear mixed-effects regression (LMER) adjusted for sociodemographic and clinical covariates. ResultsAmong 7800 subjects, 4511 (57.8%) underwent surgery for rAOM alone, 2462 (31.6%) for mixed indications, and 827 (10.6%) for other indications alone. At baseline, children in the rAOM and mixed groups had significantly worse QOL than those with other indications alone. Across all follow-up intervals, children with rAOM or mixed indications demonstrated significantly greater improvement in total OM-6 scores compared with other-indication alone. Domain-specific analyses showed greater improvement in caregiver concerns, activity limitations, emotional distress, and physical suffering among children with rAOM, whereas hearing-related improvement was greatest in the other-indication groups. ConclusionTTP resulted in sustained long-term QOL improvements across all indication groups. Despite worse baseline scores in the rAOM group, this group had proportionally greater improvement in total OM-6 scores, leading to similar long-term total OM-6 scores across indications.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的：使用中耳炎–6（OM-6）问卷，比较单纯复发性急性中耳炎（rAOM）、rAOM合并其他指征、以及单纯其他指征的儿科患者接受鼓膜置管术（TTP）后的纵向生活质量（QOL）结局。方法：我们开展了一项回顾性队列研究，纳入在一月 2020至八月 2024期间于一家三级儿科中心接受TTP的0-6岁儿童。纳入标准要求完成术前和术后OM-6调查。主要结局是总OM-6评分随时间的变化，在术后0-2、2-6、6-12、12-18和18-24个月进行评估。分析采用逆概率加权和线性混合效应回归（LMER），并调整社会人口学和临床协变量。结果：在7800名受试者中，4511名（57.8%）因单纯rAOM接受手术，2462名（31.6%）因混合指征接受手术，827名（10.6%）因单纯其他指征接受手术。在基线时，rAOM组和混合组的儿童生活质量显著差于单纯其他指征组。在所有随访间隔中，rAOM或混合指征组儿童的总OM-6评分改善显著大于单纯其他指征组。领域特异性分析显示，rAOM组儿童在照顾者担忧、活动受限、情绪困扰和身体痛苦方面的改善更大，而听力相关改善在单纯其他指征组中最大。结论：TTP在所有指征组中均带来持续长期的生活质量改善。尽管rAOM组基线评分较差，但该组总OM-6评分的改善比例更大，导致各指征组在长期总OM-6评分上相似。

articles.title_en: Predicting abnormal auditory brainstem response outcomes using risk factors
articles.title_cn: 利用风险因素预测异常听觉脑干反应结果
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundAuditory brainstem response (ABR) testing diagnoses hearing loss in children unable to complete behavioral audiometry. ABR evaluations have been scheduled for 60-min operating room (OR) blocks regardless of hearing loss risk, resulting in poor utilization and prolonged wait times. At Akron Children's Hospital, wait times averaged 82 days. However, 63% of cases demonstrated normal hearing and were completed in under 60 min. No validated tool predicts abnormal ABR results prior to scheduling. A predictive model based on clinical risk factors could optimize OR block utilization and improve access. MethodsWe conducted a retrospective study of 239 children who underwent sedated ABR testing between February 2024 and September 2025. Risk factors collected from electronic health records included autism, cardiac diagnosis, congenital CMV, hyperbilirubinemia, neurologic diagnoses, trauma, universal newborn hearing screening (UNHS) referral, family history of hearing loss, parental speech/hearing concern, NICU stay, prematurity, and syndrome diagnosis. Candidate models were compared using stratified 4-fold cross-validation; logistic regression was selected as the primary model and evaluated using discrimination, calibration, and clinical utility. ResultsThe model demonstrated moderate discrimination (AUC ≈ 0.68). UNHS referral and syndrome diagnosis showed increased abnormal ABR risk. Autism diagnosis was associated with decreased risk. At a 35% risk threshold, the model identified 53% of abnormal cases with 75% specificity and 49% positive predictive value. ConclusionsA pre-test risk stratification model can moderately discriminate children at higher risk for abnormal ABR, with potential to improve OR block utilization, patient access, and workflow efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景：听觉脑干反应（ABR）测试用于诊断无法完成行为测听的儿童的听力损失。无论听力损失风险如何，ABR评估均被安排为60分钟的手术室（OR）时间段，导致利用率低下和等待时间延长。在阿克伦儿童医院，平均等待时间为82天。然而，63%的病例显示听力正常，并在60分钟内完成。目前尚无经过验证的工具在安排前预测异常ABR结果。基于临床风险因素的预测模型可能优化手术室时间段利用率并改善可及性。方法：我们对239名在二月 2024至九月 2025期间接受镇静下ABR测试的儿童进行了回顾性研究。从电子健康记录中收集的风险因素包括自闭症、心脏诊断、先天性巨细胞病毒、高胆红素血症、神经学诊断、创伤、普遍新生儿听力筛查（UNHS）转诊、听力损失家族史、父母言语/听力担忧、新生儿重症监护病房（NICU）住院、早产和综合征诊断。使用分层4折交叉验证比较候选模型；选择逻辑回归作为主要模型，并使用区分度、校准度和临床实用性进行评估。结果：该模型显示出中等区分度（AUC ≈ 0.68）。UNHS转诊和综合征诊断显示异常ABR风险增加。自闭症诊断与风险降低相关。在35%风险阈值下，该模型识别出53%的异常病例，特异性为75%，阳性预测值为49%。结论：预测试风险分层模型可以中等程度地区分异常ABR高风险儿童，并有可能改善手术室时间段利用率、患者可及性和工作流程效率。

articles.title_en: Roots are not essential for restoring <ce:italic>Posidonia australis</ce:italic> using fragments
articles.title_cn: 根系对于利用片段恢复南方大叶藻并非必需
articles.abstract_en: Restoration of seagrass meadows using naturally-detached rhizome fragments is increasingly important for conservation, yet many fragments lack intact root systems. This study examined whether root removal affects short- to medium-term growth of Posidonia australis fragments under controlled aquarium conditions. Plagiotropic fragments (∼12 cm long) that either had their roots intact or roots removed (-roots) were grown in sediment for eight months. Photosynthetic capacity (Fv/Fm) remained consistently high (>0.73) for both treatments throughout the experiment and no significant differences were detected in shoot numbers, leaf length, leaf extension rates, or above-ground biomass. All -roots fragments regenerated root systems, ultimately producing 13% greater below-ground biomass than fragments with intact roots, although this difference was not statistically significant. Results suggests that naturally-detached rootless fragments could be valuable restoration propagules, potentially simplifying transplanting logistics and expanding the range of useable material. Field validation across different seasons and sediment conditions is recommended.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用自然脱落的根状茎片段恢复海草草甸对于保护日益重要，然而许多片段缺乏完整的根系。本研究探讨了在受控水族箱条件下，根系去除是否影响南方大叶藻片段的短期至中期生长。将具有完整根系或去除根系的斜生片段（约12厘米长）在沉积物中培养八个月。在整个实验期间，两种处理的光合能力（Fv/Fm）均保持较高水平（>0.73），且在芽数、叶长、叶片延伸速率或地上生物量方面未检测到显著差异。所有去除根系的片段均再生了根系，最终产生的地下生物量比具有完整根系的片段多13%，尽管这一差异在统计上不显著。结果表明，自然脱落的无根片段可能是宝贵的恢复繁殖体，可能简化移植后勤并扩大可用材料的范围。建议在不同季节和沉积物条件下进行田间验证。

articles.title_en: The spatial allocation effects of central transfers: evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 中央转移支付的空间配置效应：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Coordinating the fiscal relations between the central and local governments is a worldwide governance challenge. Based on a spatial general equilibrium framework, we quantify the aggregate effects of tax-sharing adjustments (i.e. fiscal revenue division) and the spatial allocation of central transfers (i.e. fiscal expenditure assignment) through labor migration. Calibrating the model for China, we find that adjusting the tax-sharing ratio induces co-directional changes in regional disparity, aggregate output, and welfare. Changes in the spatial allocation structure of central transfers during 2016–2021 mitigated labor misallocation, reducing regional disparities by 1.09% and increasing aggregate output by 4.44%, but causing welfare to decline by 3.03%. A reduction in labor migration costs amplifies the spatial allocation effects of central transfers. Moreover, the spatial allocation effects of different types of central transfers show significant differences.
articles.abstract_cn: 协调中央与地方政府之间的财政关系是一个世界性的治理挑战。基于空间一般均衡框架，我们通过劳动力迁移量化了税收分享调整（即财政收入划分）和中央转移支付的空间配置（即财政支出分配）的总体效应。以中国为模型进行校准，我们发现调整税收分享比例会引起区域差距、总产出和福利的同向变化。2016-2021年间中央转移支付空间配置结构的变化缓解了劳动力错配，使区域差距缩小了1.09%，总产出增加了4.44%，但导致福利下降了3.03%。劳动力迁移成本的降低会放大中央转移支付的空间配置效应。此外，不同类型中央转移支付的空间配置效应表现出显著差异。

articles.title_en: Resolving barium matrix interferences in rare earth element analysis of seep barites: Implications for europium anomalies and fluid sources
articles.title_cn: 解决海相重晶石稀土元素分析中的钡基体干扰：对铕异常和流体来源的启示
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd Barite is an important archive for tracing fluid-rock interactions in marine systems. However, accurate determination of rare earth elements (REEs) in barite by ICP-MS is strongly hindered by polyatomic ion interferences derived from high barium (Ba) matrix, particularly affecting europium (Eu) measurements. This analytical limitation has restricted the application of REE geochemistry in studies of barites from seeps (hereafter seep barites). Here we investigate barite-carbonate pairs from seeps in the Gulf of Mexico and develop a robust analytical protocol for reliable REE determination. The procedure integrates (1) selective removal of carbonate phases by mild acetic acid leaching, (2) complete digestion of the purified barite fraction using a mixed HNO 3 –HF–HClO 4 acid system, and (3) efficient separation of Ba from REEs using DGA resin chromatography prior to ICP-MS analysis. Comparison of REE data before and after Ba removal demonstrates that extremely positive Eu anomalies observed in untreated samples (Eu/Eu∗ up to 122) may result from BaO + /BaOH + interferences, highlighting the importance of careful matrix separation for reliable Eu determination. After matrix separation, the barite samples display moderate positive Eu anomalies (Eu/Eu∗ = 1.25–3.85), consistent negative Ce anomalies, and heavy REE-enriched patterns. These corrected REE signatures indicate precipitation from pore fluids interacting with surrounding sediments under suboxic to oxic conditions, rather than from high temperature hydrothermal fluids. Our results suggest that some previously reported extreme Eu anomalies in barite, particularly where Ba removal or interference correction was not documented, may warrant careful re-evaluation as potential analytical artifacts, and emphasize the necessity of matrix separation for reliable REE analysis in Ba-rich minerals.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 重晶石是示踪海洋系统中流体-岩石相互作用的重要档案。然而，通过ICP-MS准确测定重晶石中的稀土元素（REEs）受到来自高钡（Ba）基体的多原子离子干扰的强烈阻碍，尤其影响铕（Eu）的测量。这一分析限制制约了REE地球化学在渗漏重晶石（以下简称渗漏重晶石）研究中的应用。在此，我们研究了墨西哥湾渗漏区的重晶石-碳酸盐对，并开发了一种稳健的分析方案，以实现可靠的REE测定。该流程包括（1）通过温和醋酸淋滤选择性去除碳酸盐相，（2）使用混合HNO 3 –HF–HClO 4 酸体系完全消解纯化后的重晶石部分，以及（3）在ICP-MS分析前使用DGA树脂色谱法高效分离Ba与REEs。Ba去除前后REE数据的比较表明，未处理样品中观察到的极端正Eu异常（Eu/Eu∗高达122）可能源于BaO + /BaOH + 干扰，凸显了仔细进行基体分离对于可靠Eu测定的重要性。基体分离后，重晶石样品显示出中等程度的正Eu异常（Eu/Eu∗ = 1.25-3.85）、一致的负Ce异常以及重REE富集模式。这些校正后的REE特征表明，其沉淀来自与周围沉积物在次氧化至氧化条件下相互作用的孔隙流体，而非高温热液流体。我们的结果表明，先前报道的一些重晶石极端Eu异常，特别是在未记录Ba去除或干扰校正的情况下，可能值得作为潜在的分析假象进行仔细重新评估，并强调了基体分离对于富Ba矿物中可靠REE分析的必要性。

articles.title_en: Group-aware hierarchical spatio-temporal fusion for pedestrian trajectory prediction in crowds
articles.title_cn: 群体感知的层次化时空融合用于人群中的行人轨迹预测
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Pedestrian trajectory prediction is critical for autonomous driving, pedestrian behavior analysis, and crowd management. Multi-target pedestrian trajectory prediction has long been a focus of research due to the complex interactions between pedestrians and their surrounding environment. However, existing prediction models often suffer from limited consideration of group-aware relational factors, restricted modeling of long-term spatio-temporal dependencies, and insufficient focus on critical information, such as the number of pedestrians. These issues significantly affect the accuracy, real-time performance, and generalizability of predictions. To address these challenges, this paper proposes Group-aware Spatio-Temporal Fusion Prediction Network (GSTFPN), a group-aware multi-target pedestrian trajectory prediction framework. First, GSTFPN establishes a differentiable group-aware mechanism by constructing pedestrian group relationships based on three key factors: spatial distance, movement direction, and velocity consistency. Second, GSTFPN introduces a dual-branch spatio-temporal dependency module using adaptive sparse thresholding and spatio-temporal decoupling mechanisms, enhancing the model’s capacity to capture long-term spatio-temporal dependencies. Additionally, GSTFPN introduces the Number-Adaptive Fuse (NAFuse) method, which adaptively adjusts the weights of individual, intra-group, and inter-group features based on the number of targets. This enables dynamic adaptation to group structures and interaction patterns, thereby improving prediction accuracy and robustness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GSTFPN effectively captures and perceives group relationships among high-density pedestrians and accurately predicts multi-target pedestrian trajectories in complex environments.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 行人轨迹预测对于自动驾驶、行人行为分析和人群管理至关重要。由于行人与其周围环境之间的复杂交互，多目标行人轨迹预测长期以来一直是研究重点。然而，现有的预测模型往往存在对群体感知关系因素考虑不足、对长期时空依赖性的建模受限以及对关键信息（如行人数量）关注不够的问题。这些问题显著影响预测的准确性、实时性和泛化能力。为解决这些挑战，本文提出了群体感知时空融合预测网络（GSTFPN），一种群体感知的多目标行人轨迹预测框架。首先，GSTFPN通过基于三个关键因素（空间距离、运动方向和速度一致性）构建行人群体关系，建立了一个可微分的群体感知机制。其次，GSTFPN引入了一个双分支时空依赖模块，采用自适应稀疏阈值和时空解耦机制，增强了模型捕获长期时空依赖的能力。此外，GSTFPN引入了数量自适应融合（NAFuse）方法，该方法根据目标数量自适应调整个体、群体内和群体间特征的权重。这使得模型能够动态适应群体结构和交互模式，从而提高预测准确性和鲁棒性。大量实验表明，GSTFPN能够有效捕获和感知高密度行人中的群体关系，并在复杂环境中准确预测多目标行人轨迹。

articles.title_en: Point-line transformer with dynamic polyline anchors for lane detection
articles.title_cn: 基于动态折线锚点的点线变换器用于车道检测
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. This paper presents a multi-scale point-line transformer for lane detection, targeting improved robustness in far-field scenarios with high curvature and perspective distortion. The proposed approach introduces dynamic polyline anchors that represent lanes as polylines with adaptive knee points, enabling flexible modeling of complex lane geometries. A point-line decoder iteratively refines these anchors through a global branch for capturing long-range lane structures and a local branch for enhancing fine-grained details. Experiments on the TuSimple and CULane benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive performance and consistent improvements in challenging scenarios, particularly for distant and curved lanes.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 本文提出了一种多尺度点线变换器用于车道检测，旨在提高远场场景中高曲率和透视失真情况下的鲁棒性。所提出的方法引入了动态折线锚点，将车道表示为具有自适应拐点的折线，从而能够灵活建模复杂的车道几何形状。点线解码器通过全局分支迭代细化这些锚点以捕捉长距离车道结构，并通过局部分支增强细粒度细节。在TuSimple和CULane基准上的实验表明，所提出的方法在具有挑战性的场景中，特别是对于远处和弯曲车道，取得了有竞争力的性能和一致的改进。

articles.title_en: Two ultra-brief indicators of somatic symptom intensity and interference recommended by the EURONET-SOMA network: Validity and sensitivitiy to change across medical conditions from the SOMACROSS research unit
articles.title_cn: EURONET-SOMA网络推荐的两个超简短躯体症状强度与干扰指标：来自SOMACROSS研究单元的跨医学条件效度与变化敏感性
articles.abstract_en: Aims Ultra-brief patient-reported outcome measures are increasingly needed for routine clinical practice and psychosomatic research. The EURONET-SOMA network recommends two single-item numeric rating scales (0–10) to assess somatic symptom intensity and interference with daily activities over the past 7 days. Their psychometric properties have not yet been evaluated. Methods Data were drawn from the SOMACROSS research unit (N = 1,336) comprising patients with eight different medical conditions. Participants completed the two EURONET-SOMA items at baseline, 6-month, and 12-month follow-up, alongside established questionnaires assessing somatic symptom severity (PHQ-15), symptom-related psychological distress (SSD-12), depression (PHQ-9), anxiety (GAD-7), and health-related quality of life (SF-12). Construct validity was examined via expected correlations with related and unrelated measures. Known-groups validity was tested by comparing EURONET-SOMA scores across PHQ-15–defined symptom severity groups. Sensitivity to naturally occurring change was evaluated using correlations of change scores and standardized response means. Results Both items showed good distributional properties with full use of the response range (intensity: M = 4.15, SD = 2.64, skewness = 0.16, kurtosis = −0.98; interference: M = 3.92, SD = 2.85, skewness = 0.26, kurtosis = −1.03). The two items were highly intercorrelated (r = .91), indicating substantial conceptual overlap. Intensity and interference were strongly associated with somatic symptom severity (PHQ-15: r = .68) and symptom-related psychological distress (SSD-12: r = .62–.63). Symptom interference showed particularly strong negative associations with physical quality of life (SF-12 PCS: r = −.67), whereas associations with depression and anxiety were moderate (PHQ-9: r = .60; GAD-7: r = .51), supporting discriminant validity. Both items differentiated clearly between PHQ-15 severity groups (all group comparisons p < .001). Changes in both items over 6 and 12 months were strongly associated with changes in PHQ-15 and SSD-12 scores, supporting sensitivity to change. Discussion The findings support the construct and known-groups validity of the EURONET-SOMA items across heterogeneous psychosomatic samples. Despite their high intercorrelation, differential associations with physical quality of life suggest that intensity and interference capture related but not identical aspects of somatic symptom burden. Conclusions The EURONET-SOMA single-item measures demonstrate good validity and sensitivity to change and represent efficient, low-burden indicators of somatic symptom burden and functional impact, suitable for routine clinical use and large-scale psychosomatic research.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的：常规临床实践和心身研究越来越需要超简短的患者报告结局测量工具。EURONET-SOMA网络推荐使用两个单项数字评定量表（0-10）来评估过去7天内躯体症状强度和对日常活动的干扰。其心理测量学特性尚未得到评估。方法：数据来自SOMACROSS研究单元（N = 1,336），包含八种不同医学条件的患者。参与者在基线、6个月和12个月随访时完成两个EURONET-SOMA条目，同时完成评估躯体症状严重程度（PHQ-15）、症状相关心理困扰（SSD-12）、抑郁（PHQ-9）、焦虑（GAD-7）和健康相关生活质量（SF-12）的既定问卷。通过预期与相关和不相关测量的相关性检验结构效度。通过比较EURONET-SOMA评分在PHQ-15定义的症状严重程度组间的差异来检验已知组效度。使用变化评分的相关性和标准化反应均值评估对自然发生变化的敏感性。结果：两个条目均表现出良好的分布特性，反应范围得到充分利用（强度：M = 4.15，SD = 2.64，偏度 = 0.16，峰度 = −0.98；干扰：M = 3.92，SD = 2.85，偏度 = 0.26，峰度 = −1.03）。两个条目高度相关（r = .91），表明存在显著的概念重叠。强度与干扰与躯体症状严重程度（PHQ-15：r = .68）和症状相关心理困扰（SSD-12：r = .62–.63）强相关。症状干扰与身体生活质量（SF-12 PCS：r = −.67）呈特别强的负相关，而与抑郁和焦虑的相关性为中等（PHQ-9：r = .60；GAD-7：r = .51），支持区分效度。两个条目在PHQ-15严重程度组间区分明显（所有组间比较p < .001）。两个条目在6和12个月的变化与PHQ-15和SSD-12评分的变化强相关，支持变化敏感性。讨论：研究结果支持EURONET-SOMA条目在异质性心身样本中的结构效度和已知组效度。尽管高度相关，但与身体生活质量的不同关联表明，强度与干扰捕捉了躯体症状负担相关但不完全相同的方面。结论：EURONET-SOMA单项测量表现出良好的效度和变化敏感性，是躯体症状负担和功能影响的有效、低负担指标，适用于常规临床使用和大规模心身研究。

articles.title_en: Number of group psychotherapy sessions predicts inflammation changes in patients with coronary artery disease and comorbid depression
articles.title_cn: 团体心理治疗次数可预测冠心病合并抑郁症患者的炎症变化
articles.abstract_en: Background and aims Inflammation contributes to the bidirectional relationship between depression and coronary artery disease (CAD). However, the impact of group psychotherapy on inflammation has not been elucidated. This study aimed to investigate whether group psychotherapy is associated with inflammation changes in CAD patients with comorbid depression. Method A total of 337 patients (mean age 59.2 years ±9.4) from the SPIRR-CAD trial provided questionnaire results and inflammatory data at baseline (T0) and at 18-month follow-up (T3) of a group psychotherapy program, with a maximum of 25 sessions vs. usual care. Inflammatory markers included high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP), tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), and interleukin-6 (IL-6). An inflammatory factors score (IFS) was calculated. Depression severity was assessed using the Hamilton Depression Rating-Scale. Results At baseline, elevated hsCRP, TNF-α, and IL-6 were present in 41.2%, 33.2%, and 21.1% of patients, respectively. From T0 to T3, hsCRP, TNF-α, depression scores, and IFS decreased significantly. Patients attending 10–25 sessions had a 4.59-fold higher likelihood of IFS reduction or stable low levels than those with 1–9 sessions, independent of comorbidities. Discussion and conclusion Results show a significant association between a higher number of group psychotherapy sessions and reduced inflammation in CAD patients with persistently elevated depression scores. Independent from the influence of the absence of diabetes mellitus, a higher number of group psychotherapy sessions reduces inflammation, highlighting its role at the interface of cardiology, inflammation, and mental health.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景与目的 炎症在抑郁症与冠状动脉疾病（CAD）之间的双向关系中发挥作用。然而，团体心理治疗对炎症的影响尚未阐明。本研究旨在探讨团体心理治疗是否与合并抑郁症的冠心病患者的炎症变化相关。方法 来自SPIRR-CAD试验的共337名患者（平均年龄59.2岁±9.4）提供了团体心理治疗项目基线（T0）和18个月随访（T3）时的问卷结果和炎症数据，该项目最多进行25次治疗，对照组接受常规护理。炎症标志物包括高敏C反应蛋白（hsCRP）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和白细胞介素6（IL-6）。计算炎症因子评分（IFS）。使用汉密尔顿抑郁量表评估抑郁严重程度。结果 在基线时，分别有6、41.2%和33.2%的患者出现hsCRP、TNF-α和IL-21.1%升高。从T0到T3，hsCRP、TNF-α、抑郁评分和IFS显著下降。参加10-25次治疗的患者IFS降低或维持低水平的可能性是参加4.59-1次治疗患者的9倍，且与合并症无关。讨论与结论 结果表明，在抑郁评分持续升高的冠心病患者中，团体心理治疗次数较多与炎症减轻显著相关。在不受无糖尿病影响的情况下，较多的团体心理治疗次数可减轻炎症，凸显了其在心脏病学、炎症和心理健康交界领域的作用。

articles.title_en: The course and trajectories of quality of life among patients with persistent symptoms in the HUS Sympa Cohort Study
articles.title_cn: HUS Sympa 队列研究中持续症状患者的生活质量进程与轨迹
articles.abstract_en: Background and aims The term persistent symptoms refers to symptoms that can’t be attributed to any somatic or psychiatric disease. Knowledge of prognosis in terms of quality of life (QoL) is still scarce and often limited to specific symptom groups. Our aim was to assess the QoL and health-related QoL (HRQoL) prognosis of unselected persistent symptoms, with recovery trajectories, and factors affecting recovery, within a prospective cohort. Method The study included adult patients at a specialized outpatient clinic. Outcomes were collected at 0, 3, 6 and 12 months. The primary outcome was QoL by Visual Analogue Scale (VAS 0-10). Secondary outcomes included QoL by EUROHIS-QOL-8 and HRQoL by 15D, and patients’ symptom perceptions by Somatic Symptom Disorder - B Criteria Scale (SSD-12). Linear mixed models analyzed temporal changes, and trajectory analysis modeled recovery patterns. Results At baseline, 566 patients participated, with 288 (50.9%) providing follow-up data. The mean age was 39.9 years (SD 10.9). Trajectory analysis of EUROHIS-QOL-8 identified a recovering group (62.5%) and a stable group (37.5%). Stable trajectories were associated with more comorbidities and higher levels of worry-inducing symptom perceptions (mean SSD-12 score 24-27 out of 48), whereas marked recovery was linked to being employed and having lower SSD-12 (8–15). Mean general QoL improved from 5.0 (SD 2.1) to 5.3 in 12 months. EUROHIS-QOL-8 scores rose from 2.9 (SD 0.7) to 3.2 (SD 0.9), and 15D measures increased from 0.7 (SD 0.1) to 0.8 (SD 0.1). Discussion Approximately two thirds of patients experienced an improvement in quality of life over the 12‑month follow‑up. The factors associated with favorable and unfavorable prognosis in the identified trajectory clusters are consistent with earlier research. In particular, the association between prognosis and SSD‑12 scores was anticipated. However, the strength of this association in our cohort was more pronounced than expected, suggesting that symptom-related cognitions may play an even more central role in recovery trajectories than previously recognized. Conclusion Mean general and HRQoL improved over 12 months. In conclusion, patients with comorbidities and distressing illness beliefs are the most vulnerable group in rehabilitation and require specific attention. References Löwe, B., et al. (2024). Persistent physical symptoms: definition, genesis, and management. The Lancet, 403(10444), 2649–2662. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(24)00623-8. Toussaint, A., et al. (2016). Development and Validation of the Somatic Symptom Disorder–B Criteria Scale (SSD-12). Psychosomatic Medicine, 78(1), 5–12. https://doi.org/10.1097/PSY.0000000000000240.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景与目的 术语“持续症状”指的是无法归因于任何躯体或精神疾病的症状。关于生活质量（QoL）预后的知识仍然稀缺，且通常局限于特定症状群。我们的目标是在前瞻性队列中评估未经选择的持续症状的QoL和健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）预后，包括恢复轨迹及影响恢复的因素。方法 研究纳入了一家专科门诊的成年患者。结果在0、3、6和12个月时收集。主要结局是通过视觉模拟量表（VAS 0-10）测量的QoL。次要结局包括通过EUROHIS-QOL-8测量的QoL、通过15D测量的HRQoL，以及通过躯体症状障碍-B标准量表（SSD-12）评估的患者症状感知。线性混合模型分析了时间变化，轨迹分析模拟了恢复模式。结果 基线时，566名患者参与，其中288名（50.9%）提供了随访数据。平均年龄为39.9岁（标准差10.9）。EUROHIS-QOL-8的轨迹分析识别出一个恢复组（62.5%）和一个稳定组（37.5%）。稳定轨迹与更多合并症和更高水平的引发担忧的症状感知（平均SSD-12得分24-27，满分48）相关，而显著恢复与就业和较低的SSD-12（8-15）相关。一般QoL的平均值从5.0（标准差2.1）改善至12个月时的5.3。EUROHIS-QOL-8得分从2.9（标准差0.7）上升至3.2（标准差0.9），15D测量值从0.7（标准差0.1）增加至0.8（标准差0.1）。讨论 大约三分之二的患者在12个月的随访期间经历了生活质量的改善。在识别出的轨迹簇中，与有利和不利预后相关的因素与早期研究一致。特别是，预后与SSD-12得分之间的关联是预期的。然而，在我们的队列中，这种关联的强度比预期的更为显著，这表明与症状相关的认知可能在恢复轨迹中扮演着比以前认识到的更核心的角色。结论 在12个月内，一般QoL和HRQoL的平均值有所改善。总之，患有合并症和令人痛苦的疾病信念的患者是康复中最脆弱的群体，需要特别关注。参考文献 Löwe, B., 等（2024）。持续性身体症状：定义、成因和管理。《柳叶刀》，403(10444)，2649-2662。https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(24)00623-8。Toussaint, A., 等（2016）。躯体症状障碍-B标准量表（SSD-12）的开发与验证。《心身医学》，78(1)，5-12。https://doi.org/10.1097/PSY.0000000000000240。

articles.title_en: Assessment of biopsychosocial complexity in transgender and gender diverse individuals
articles.title_cn: 跨性别和性别多元个体生物心理社会复杂性的评估
articles.abstract_en: Background Transgender and gender diverse (TGD) individuals face disproportionate stressors and often present with intertwined medical, psychological, and social needs. Yet, their overall biopsychosocial profiles at entry into gender-affirming care remain poorly documented. Aims To describe biopsychosocial complexity among adolescents and adults seeking gender-affirming care and examine its relationship with well-being, defined as psychological distress, gender congruence, and quality of life. Methods Routinely collected data from first consultations at the CHUV gender clinic (June 2023–June 2025) were analyzed for N = 77 participants. Biopsychosocial complexity was assessed with the INTERMED. Psychological distress (DASS-21), gender congruence (TCS), and quality of life (EQ-5D-5L/KIDSCREEN-27) were self-reported. Analyses included non-parametric statistics, Bayesian group comparisons, correlations, exploratory network analyses, and group differences by sex assigned at birth and gender identity. Results Over one third of participants showed high biopsychosocial complexity (INTERMED ≥20). The psychological domain scored highest, followed by biological and social domains; the health system domain was lowest. Greater complexity was associated with higher psychological distress and lower quality of life, but not with gender congruence. Network analyses highlighted strong links between psychological and social domains, distress, and quality of life. Participants assigned female at birth had higher overall, biological, and health system complexity. Those identifying as male showed higher biological and health system complexity and greater gender congruence, with no differences in psychological or social complexity. Discussion Biopsychosocial complexity at care entry relates more to psychological and social vulnerability and interactions with medical pathways than to gender incongruence itself. Comprehensive assessment may support more individualized care throughout gender affirmation. References 1. Campbell, M. M., Fresán, A., Addinall, R. M., Böhmke, W., Grobler, G. articles.abstract_cn: 背景 跨性别和性别多元（TGD）个体面临不成比例的压力源，且常伴有医疗、心理和社会需求的交织。然而，他们在进入性别肯定护理时的整体生物心理社会特征仍鲜有记录。目的 描述寻求性别肯定护理的青少年和成人的生物心理社会复杂性，并考察其与幸福感（定义为心理困扰、性别一致性和生活质量）的关系。方法 分析了CHUV性别诊所首次咨询时常规收集的数据（2023年六月至2025年六月），样本量为77名参与者。使用INTERMED评估生物心理社会复杂性。心理困扰（DASS-21）、性别一致性（TCS）和生活质量（EQ-5D-5L/KIDSCREEN-27）为自我报告。分析包括非参数统计、贝叶斯组间比较、相关性分析、探索性网络分析，以及按出生时指定性别和性别认同的组间差异。结果 超过三分之一的参与者表现出高生物心理社会复杂性（INTERMED ≥20）。心理领域得分最高，其次是生物和社会领域；卫生系统领域得分最低。更高的复杂性与更高的心理困扰和更低的生活质量相关，但与性别一致性无关。网络分析强调了心理和社会领域、困扰及生活质量之间的强关联。出生时指定为女性的参与者在总体、生物和卫生系统复杂性上得分更高。认同为男性的参与者表现出更高的生物和卫生系统复杂性及更高的性别一致性，但在心理或社会复杂性上无差异。讨论 进入护理时的生物心理社会复杂性更多与心理和社会脆弱性及医疗路径的互动相关，而非性别不一致本身。全面评估可能支持在整个性别肯定过程中提供更个体化的护理。参考文献 [1].
